takeaway: 基于 OpenPiton 的 REPTILES 在使用 4 个 Sargantana 核心时平均获得 3.1 倍加速。加入新特性后，Sargantana 在向量加法基准测试中的性能达到原来的 9.3 倍。
innovation: （1）提出开源 RISC-V 多核框架 REPTILES，将多个 Sargantana 核心接入 OpenPiton 的存储层次结构；（2）在 Sargantana 和 OpenPiton 中加入面向 HPC 性能优化的新特性，摘要未说明具体机制。

title: Microarchitectural Co-Optimization for Sustained Throughput of RISC-V Multi-Lane Chaining Vector Processors
abstract: Modern RISC vector processors rely on multi-lane parallelism and chaining to achieve high sustained throughput, yet practical execution often deviates from the ideal reference due to microarchitectural inefficiencies. This work targets the open-source RVV processor Ara and analyzes its sustained-throughput loss under a fixed hardware configuration. We first establish an ideal multi-lane chaining model that decomposes ideal execution into prologue startup, steady-state progression, and tail drain, and uses this reference to characterize real-execution deviations. Based on this model, we attribute Ara's bottlenecks to three critical paths: memory-side data supply and transaction progression, dependence-and-issue control, and operand delivery and result propagation. To address these bottlenecks, we propose coordinated optimizations, including a descriptor-driven memory front end with next-VL prefetch, early read-dependence release with dynamic local issue control, and multi-source forwarding with dual-source operand queues. Experimental results show that, without increasing raw memory bandwidth or changing the main processor configuration, Ara-Opt achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 1.33x over baseline Ara. Under roofline-based normalization, the geometric-mean gap-closed ratio reaches 12.2%. In particular, scal, axpy, ger, and gemm achieve speedups of approximately 2.41x, 1.60x, 1.52x, and 1.42x, with corresponding gap-closed ratios of 93.7%, 88.9%, 78.3%, and 59.3%, respectively. These results show that the proposed optimizations recover lost sustained throughput under essentially unchanged hardware resources and move regular streaming and high-throughput workloads closer to the roofline-based performance bound.
abstract_cn: 现代 RISC 向量处理器依靠多通道（lane）并行和向量链接（chaining）实现高持续吞吐率，但微架构效率不足往往使实际执行偏离理想情况。本文以开源 RISC-V 向量扩展（RVV）处理器 Ara 为对象，分析其在固定硬件配置下的持续吞吐率损失。我们首先建立理想的多通道向量链接模型，将理想执行划分为启动、稳态推进和尾部排空 3 个阶段，并以该模型为参照刻画实际执行的偏差。基于这一模型，我们将 Ara 的瓶颈归因于 3 条关键路径，分别是存储侧数据供给与事务推进、依赖与发射控制，以及操作数交付与结果传播。针对这些瓶颈，本文提出协同优化方案，包括由描述符驱动并支持按下一向量长度（VL）预取的访存前端、结合动态局部发射控制的读依赖提前解除，以及采用双源操作数队列的多源转发。实验结果表明，在原始存储带宽和处理器主要配置保持不变的条件下，Ara-Opt 相较于基线 Ara 获得了 1.33 倍的几何平均加速比。按屋顶线（Roofline）模型归一化后，性能差距弥合比例的几何平均值达到 12.2%。其中，scal、axpy、ger 和 gemm 分别获得约 2.41 倍、1.60 倍、1.52 倍和 1.42 倍加速，对应的性能差距弥合比例分别为 93.7%、88.9%、78.3% 和 59.3%。这些结果表明，所提出的优化可在硬件资源基本不变的条件下挽回损失的持续吞吐率，使规则流式工作负载和高吞吐工作负载更接近基于屋顶线模型的性能上界。
takeaway: 在原始存储带宽和处理器主要配置相同的条件下，Ara-Opt 相较于基线 Ara 的几何平均加速比为 1.33 倍，按屋顶线模型归一化后的性能差距弥合比例几何平均值为 12.2%。其中，scal 获得约 2.41 倍加速，弥合了 93.7% 的性能差距。
innovation: （1）建立涵盖启动、稳态推进和尾部排空的理想多通道向量链接模型，据此定位 Ara 的 3 条瓶颈路径；（2）设计描述符驱动的访存前端，支持按下一向量长度预取；（3）将读依赖提前解除与动态局部发射控制结合；（4）采用双源操作数队列实现多源转发。

title: AccelCIM: Systematic Dataflow Exploration for SRAM Compute-in-Memory Accelerator
abstract: SRAM-based compute-in-memory (CIM) offers high computational density and energy efficiency for deep neural network (DNN) accelerators, but its limited capacity causes on/off-chip data movement overhead for large DNN models. Existing CIM accelerator studies typically assume that DNN models fit entirely on-chip, leaving efficient dataflow design largely untapped. This paper introduces AccelCIM, a systematic dataflow exploration framework for SRAM CIM accelerator, which addresses two key limitations of prior work. (1) It formulates a systematic dataflow design space spanning CIM macro configurations and macro-array organizations. (2) It introduces rigorous design evaluation using cycle-accurate architectural simulation and post-layout PPA analysis. We conduct an extensive design space exploration and apply AccelCIM to representative LLM applications, providing practical insights for the principled design of CIM accelerators.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 基于 SRAM 的存内计算（CIM）可为深度神经网络（DNN）加速器提供高计算密度和高能效，但其容量有限，运行大型 DNN 模型时会产生片上与片外之间的数据搬移开销。现有 CIM 加速器研究通常假设 DNN 模型可完整存放在片上，因此对高效数据流设计的探索仍较为有限。本文提出 AccelCIM，一个面向 SRAM CIM 加速器的系统化数据流探索框架，旨在解决先前工作的两项主要局限。（1）系统构建涵盖 CIM 宏配置和宏阵列组织方式的数据流设计空间。（2）采用周期精确的体系结构仿真和布局布线后功耗、性能与面积（PPA）分析，对设计进行严格评估。我们广泛探索了该设计空间，并将 AccelCIM 应用于具有代表性的大语言模型（LLM）应用，为有据可依地设计 CIM 加速器提供参考。
takeaway: AccelCIM 联合探索 SRAM CIM 宏配置与宏阵列组织方式，并通过周期精确仿真及布局布线后 PPA 分析评估数据流设计。作者将该框架应用于代表性 LLM 应用，为大型模型场景下的 CIM 加速器设计提供参考。
innovation: （1）构建涵盖 CIM 宏配置与宏阵列组织方式的系统化数据流设计空间；（2）结合周期精确的体系结构仿真和布局布线后 PPA 分析，对候选设计进行严格评估。

title: A Lightweight High-Throughput Collective-Capable NoC for Large-Scale ML Accelerators
abstract: The exponential increase in Machine Learning (ML) model size and complexity has driven unprecedented demand for high-performance acceleration systems. As technology scaling enables the integration of thousands of computing elements onto a single die, the boundary between distributed and on-chip systems has blurred, making efficient on-chip collective communication increasingly critical. In this work, we present a lightweight, collective-capable Network on Chip (NoC) that supports efficient barrier synchronization alongside scalable, high-bandwidth multicast and reduction operations, co-designed for the next generation of ML accelerators. We introduce Direct Compute Access (DCA), a novel paradigm that grants the interconnect fabric direct access to the cores' computational resources, enabling high-throughput in-network reductions with a small 16.9% router area overhead. Through in-network hardware acceleration, we achieve 5.3x and 2.8x geomean speedups on multicast and reduction operations involving between 1 and 32 KiB of data, respectively. Furthermore, by keeping communication off the critical path in GEMM workloads, these features allow our architecture to scale efficiently to large meshes, resulting in up to 3.8x and 2.4x estimated performance gains through multicast and reduction support, respectively, compared to a baseline unicast NoC architecture, and up to 1.17x estimated energy savings.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 机器学习（ML）模型的规模和复杂度呈指数增长，推动了对高性能加速系统前所未有的需求。随着工艺进步使数千个计算单元能够集成在单个裸片上，分布式系统与片上系统之间的界限日趋模糊，高效的片上集合通信也愈发关键。本文提出一种与下一代 ML 加速器协同设计的轻量级片上网络（NoC），支持高效的屏障同步以及可扩展、高带宽的组播和归约操作。我们提出直接计算访问（DCA），使互连网络能够直接访问核心的计算资源，以仅 16.9% 的路由器面积开销实现高吞吐量的网内归约。通过网内硬件加速，对涉及 1–32 KiB 数据的组播和归约操作，几何平均加速比分别达到 5.3 倍和 2.8 倍。此外，这些机制使通信避开通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）工作负载的关键路径，让所提架构能够高效扩展至大规模网格。与仅支持单播的基线 NoC 架构相比，组播和归约支持带来的估算性能增益分别最高达 3.8 倍和 2.4 倍，估算能耗节省倍数最高达 1.17 倍。
takeaway: 对涉及 1–32 KiB 数据的操作，网内硬件加速使组播和归约分别获得 5.3 倍和 2.8 倍的几何平均加速，支持高吞吐量网内归约的 DCA 增加了 16.9% 的路由器面积。相较仅支持单播的基线 NoC，在大规模网格上的 GEMM 工作负载中，组播和归约支持带来的估算性能增益分别最高达 3.8 倍和 2.4 倍，估算能耗节省倍数最高达 1.17 倍。
innovation: （1）与 ML 加速器协同设计支持屏障同步、可扩展高带宽组播和归约的轻量级片上网络；（2）提出直接计算访问（DCA），使互连网络可直接调用核心计算资源，实现高吞吐量网内归约。

title: An FPGA-Based SoC Architecture with a RISC-V Controller for Energy-Efficient Temporal-Coding Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer high energy efficiency and event-driven computation, ideal for low-power edge AI. Their hardware implementation on FPGAs, however, faces challenges due to heavy computation, large memory use, and limited flexibility. This paper proposes a compact System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture for temporal-coding SNNs, integrating a RISC-V controller with an event-driven SNN core. It replaces multipliers with bitwise operations using binarized weights, includes a spike-time sorter for active spikes, and skips noninformative events to reduce computation. The architecture runs fully on a Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA, achieving up to 16x memory reduction for weights and lowering computational overhead and latency, with 97.0% accuracy on MNIST and 88.3% on FashionMNIST. This self-contained design provides an efficient, scalable platform for real-time neuromorphic inference at the edge.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）具有高能效和事件驱动计算的特点，适合低功耗边缘 AI。然而，在 FPGA 上实现 SNN 面临计算量大、存储占用高和灵活性有限等挑战。本文提出一种面向时间编码 SNN 的紧凑型片上系统（SoC）架构，集成 RISC-V 控制器与事件驱动的 SNN 核。该架构采用二值化权重，以按位运算替代乘法器，使用脉冲时间排序器对活跃脉冲排序，并跳过不携带有效信息的事件，以减少计算量。该架构完整运行于 Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA，权重存储用量最多降至原来的 1/16，同时降低计算开销和延迟，在 MNIST 和 FashionMNIST 上的准确率分别为 97.0% 和 88.3%。这一自包含设计为边缘端实时神经形态推理提供了一个高效、可扩展的平台。
takeaway: 该时间编码 SNN SoC 完整运行于 Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA，权重存储用量最多降至原来的 1/16，并降低计算开销和延迟。其在 MNIST 和 FashionMNIST 上的准确率分别为 97.0% 和 88.3%。
innovation: （1）构建集成 RISC-V 控制器与事件驱动 SNN 核的紧凑型 SoC；（2）采用二值化权重，以按位运算替代乘法器；（3）使用脉冲时间排序器对活跃脉冲排序；（4）跳过不携带有效信息的事件以减少计算量。

title: HyperCroc: End-to-End Open-Source RISC-V MCU with a Plug-In Interface for Domain-Specific Accelerators
abstract: Domain-Specific architectures with accelerators for machine learning and signal processing require efficient bulk data movement and high-bandwidth access to large datasets. Such capabilities are often absent from minimal open-source microcontrollers (MCUs). We present HyperCroc, an extension to the end-to-end open-source RISC-V Croc system-on-chip (SoC) integrating a silicon-proven HyperBus controller for off-chip DRAM and Flash memory access and a DMA engine, providing a practical MCU-class platform with streamlined plug-in support for domain-specific acceleration. HyperBus offers a low-pin-count PSDRAM interface at up to 400 MB/s, enabling bandwidth-scaled dataset access, while the DMA engine enables autonomous, high-throughput transfers without CPU intervention. HyperCroc preserves Croc's open-source synthesis and physical implementation flow targeting IHP's open 130 nm process design kit (PDK); the full chip can be implemented in under one hour on a consumer-grade workstation. We further report first silicon measurements from MLEM, the first Croc tapeout, confirming that the silicon is fully functional at 72 MHz @ 1.2 V and validating the end-to-end flow.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 配备机器学习和信号处理加速器的领域专用架构，需要高效搬移大块数据，并以高带宽访问大型数据集。精简型开源微控制器（MCU）通常缺乏这些能力。本文提出 HyperCroc，它扩展了端到端开源的 RISC-V Croc 片上系统（SoC），集成经过硅片验证的 HyperBus 控制器和直接存储器访问（DMA）引擎。HyperBus 控制器用于访问片外 DRAM 和 Flash，由此构建的 MCU 级平台可便捷地接入领域专用加速器。HyperBus 提供传输速率最高达 400 MB/s 的低引脚数 PSDRAM 接口，使数据集访问带宽得以扩展。DMA 引擎可在 CPU 无需介入的情况下自主完成高吞吐量传输。HyperCroc 延续了 Croc 面向 IHP 开源 130 nm 工艺设计套件（PDK）的开源综合与物理实现流程，使用消费级工作站即可在不到 1 小时内完成全芯片实现。我们还报告了 Croc 首次流片芯片 MLEM 的首批硅片实测结果，确认芯片在 1.2 V、72 MHz 下功能完整，并验证了端到端流程。
takeaway: HyperCroc 为开源 Croc MCU 增加了最高 400 MB/s 的 PSDRAM 接口和自主 DMA 传输能力，并延续了可在消费级工作站上不到 1 小时完成全芯片实现的开源流程。Croc 首次流片芯片 MLEM 的实测结果确认其在 1.2 V、72 MHz 下功能完整，验证了该端到端流程。
innovation: （1）在 Croc SoC 中集成经硅片验证的 HyperBus 控制器，通过低引脚数接口支持片外 DRAM 和 Flash 访问；（2）集成 DMA 引擎，实现无需 CPU 介入的自主高吞吐量传输；（3）提供便于接入领域专用加速器的 MCU 级平台，并沿用面向 IHP 开源 130 nm PDK 的端到端实现流程。

title: FHECore: Rethinking GPU Microarchitecture for Fully Homomorphic Encryption
abstract:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computation directly on encrypted data but incurs massive computational and memory overheads, often exceeding plaintext execution by several orders of magnitude. While custom ASIC accelerators can mitigate these costs, their long time-to-market and the rapid evolution of FHE algorithms threaten their long-term relevance. GPUs, by contrast, offer scalability, programmability, and widespread availability, making them an attractive platform for FHE. However, modern GPUs are increasingly specialized for machine learning workloads, emphasizing low-precision datatypes (e.g., INT$8$, FP$8$) that are fundamentally mismatched to the wide-precision modulo arithmetic required by FHE. Essentially, while GPUs offer ample parallelism, their functional units, like Tensor Cores, are not suited for wide-integer modulo arithmetic required by FHE schemes such as CKKS. Despite this constraint, researchers have attempted to map FHE primitives on Tensor Cores by segmenting wide integers into low-precision (INT$8$) chunks.
  To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose FHECore, a specialized functional unit integrated directly into the GPU's Streaming Multiprocessor. Our design is motivated by a key insight: the two dominant contributors to latency$-$Number Theoretic Transform and Base Conversion$-$can be formulated as modulo-linear transformations. This allows them to be mapped on a common hardware unit that natively supports wide-precision modulo-multiply-accumulate operations. Our simulations demonstrate that FHECore reduces dynamic instruction count by a geometric mean of $2.41\times$ for CKKS primitives and $1.96\times$ for end-to-end workloads. These reductions translate to performance speedups of $1.57\times$ and $2.12\times$, respectively$-$including a $50\%$ reduction in bootstrapping latency$-$all while inuring a modest $2.4\%$ area overhead.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
全同态加密（FHE）能够直接对加密数据进行计算，但会产生巨大的计算和访存开销，通常比明文执行高出数个数量级。定制 ASIC 加速器可以降低这些开销，但其产品上市周期较长，加之 FHE 算法快速演进，可能削弱此类加速器的长期适用性。GPU 具备可扩展性和可编程性，且易于获取，因此是颇具吸引力的 FHE 执行平台。然而，现代 GPU 越来越多地针对机器学习工作负载进行专门优化，侧重于 INT8、FP8 等低精度数据类型，从根本上难以满足 FHE 对宽位宽模运算的需求。具体而言，GPU 虽然具备充足的并行性，但 Tensor Core 等功能单元并不适合 CKKS 等 FHE 方案所需的宽位宽整数模运算。尽管存在这一限制，研究人员仍尝试将宽位宽整数分割为低精度（INT8）片段，以便将 FHE 原语映射到 Tensor Core 上执行。

为解决这些瓶颈，我们提出 FHECore，一种直接集成到 GPU 流式多处理器（SM）中的专用功能单元。该设计基于一个关键观察：延迟的两项主要来源，即数论变换（NTT）和基转换，均可表述为模线性变换。因此，两者可映射到同一个原生支持宽位宽模乘累加运算的硬件单元上。仿真结果表明，FHECore 将 CKKS 原语和端到端工作负载的动态指令数分别降至原来的 1/2.41 和 1/1.96，两个比值均按几何平均计算。相应的性能加速比分别为 1.57 倍和 2.12 倍，其中自举延迟降低 50%，面积开销仅为 2.4%。
takeaway: 仿真中，集成于 GPU 流式多处理器的 FHECore 使 CKKS 原语和端到端工作负载分别获得 1.57 倍和 2.12 倍的加速，自举延迟降低 50%，面积开销为 2.4%。
innovation: （1）将数论变换和基转换统一表述为模线性变换，使二者可映射到同一硬件单元；（2）提出直接集成于 GPU 流式多处理器的 FHECore，原生支持宽位宽模乘累加运算。

title: Crypto-RV: High-Efficiency FPGA-Based RISC-V Cryptographic Co-Processor for IoT Security
abstract: Cryptographic operations are critical for securing IoT, edge computing, and autonomous systems. However, current RISC-V platforms lack efficient hardware support for comprehensive cryptographic algorithm families and post-quantum cryptography. This paper presents Crypto-RV, a RISC-V co-processor architecture that unifies support for SHA-256, SHA-512, SM3, SHA3-256, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256 AES-128, HARAKA-256, and HARAKA-512 within a single 64-bit datapath. Crypto-RV introduces three key architectural innovations: a high-bandwidth internal buffer (128x64-bit), cryptography-specialized execution units with four-stage pipelined datapaths, and a double-buffering mechanism with adaptive scheduling optimized for large-hash. Implemented on Xilinx ZCU102 FPGA at 160 MHz with 0.851 W dynamic power, Crypto-RV achieves 165 times to 1,061 times speedup over baseline RISC-V cores, 5.8 times to 17.4 times better energy efficiency compared to powerful CPUs. The design occupies only 34,704 LUTs, 37,329 FFs, and 22 BRAMs demonstrating viability for high-performance, energy-efficient cryptographic processing in resource-constrained IoT environments.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 密码运算对于保障物联网（IoT）、边缘计算和自主系统的安全至关重要。然而，现有 RISC-V 平台缺乏对各类密码算法及后量子密码的高效硬件支持。本文提出 RISC-V 协处理器架构 Crypto-RV，在单条 64 位数据通路中统一支持 SHA-256、SHA-512、SM3、SHA3-256、SHAKE-128、SHAKE-256、AES-128、HARAKA-256 和 HARAKA-512。Crypto-RV 引入了 3 项关键架构创新：由 128 个 64 位字构成的高带宽内部缓冲区、采用 4 级流水数据通路的密码专用执行单元，以及面向大规模哈希运算优化的自适应调度双缓冲机制。Crypto-RV 在 Xilinx ZCU102 FPGA 平台上实现，运行频率为 160 MHz，动态功耗为 0.851 W。与基线 RISC-V 核心相比，其加速比为 165–1,061 倍，能效达到高性能 CPU 的 5.8–17.4 倍。该设计仅占用 34,704 个查找表（LUT）、37,329 个触发器（FF）和 22 个块 RAM（BRAM），表明在资源受限的物联网环境中实现高性能、高能效的密码处理是可行的。
takeaway: Crypto-RV 在 Xilinx ZCU102 FPGA 平台上以 160 MHz 运行，动态功耗为 0.851 W，相对基线 RISC-V 核心实现 165–1,061 倍加速，能效达到高性能 CPU 的 5.8–17.4 倍。
innovation: 1. 引入由 128 个 64 位字构成的高带宽内部缓冲区；2. 设计采用 4 级流水数据通路的密码专用执行单元；3. 采用结合自适应调度的双缓冲机制，面向大规模哈希运算进行优化。

title: CIM-Tuner: Balancing the Compute and Storage Capacity of SRAM-CIM Accelerator via Hardware-mapping Co-exploration
abstract: As an emerging type of AI computing accelerator, SRAM Computing-In-Memory (CIM) accelerators feature high energy efficiency and throughput. However, various CIM designs and under-explored mapping strategies impede the full exploration of compute and storage balancing in SRAM-CIM accelerator, potentially leading to significant performance degradation. To address this issue, we propose CIM-Tuner, an automatic tool for hardware balancing and optimal mapping strategy under area constraint via hardware-mapping co-exploration. It ensures universality across various CIM designs through a matrix abstraction of CIM macros and a generalized accelerator template. For efficient mapping with different hardware configurations, it employs fine-grained two-level strategies comprising accelerator-level scheduling and macro-level tiling. Compared to prior CIM mapping, CIM-Tuner's extended strategy space achieves 1.58$\times$ higher energy efficiency and 2.11$\times$ higher throughput. Applied to SOTA CIM accelerators with identical area budget, CIM-Tuner also delivers comparable improvements. The simulation accuracy is silicon-verified and CIM-Tuner tool is open-sourced at https://github.com/champloo2878/CIM-Tuner.git.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 基于 SRAM 的存内计算（CIM）加速器是一类新兴的 AI 计算加速器，具有高能效和高吞吐率。然而，CIM 硬件设计多样，映射策略尚未得到充分探索，这使得 SRAM-CIM 加速器的计算能力与存储容量之间的平衡难以充分探索，可能导致显著的性能下降。为解决这一问题，本文提出自动化工具 CIM-Tuner，通过硬件与映射的联合探索，在面积约束下平衡硬件资源并寻找最优映射策略。CIM-Tuner 采用 CIM 宏单元的矩阵抽象和通用加速器模板，以适配多种 CIM 设计。为在不同硬件配置下实现高效映射，CIM-Tuner 采用由加速器级调度和宏单元级分块组成的细粒度两级策略。相比以往的 CIM 映射方法，CIM-Tuner 通过扩展策略搜索空间，使能效和吞吐率分别达到基线的 1.58 倍和 2.11 倍。在相同面积预算下，将 CIM-Tuner 应用于当前最先进的 CIM 加速器，也能取得幅度相当的提升。芯片实测验证了仿真精度，CIM-Tuner 工具已开源，地址为 https://github.com/champloo2878/CIM-Tuner.git。
takeaway: 相较于以往的 CIM 映射方法，CIM-Tuner 的能效和吞吐率分别达到基线的 1.58 倍和 2.11 倍。在相同面积预算下，将其应用于当前最先进的 CIM 加速器也取得了幅度相当的提升。
innovation: 1. 提出自动化硬件与映射联合探索工具 CIM-Tuner，在面积约束下平衡计算能力与存储容量并寻找最优映射；2. 采用 CIM 宏单元的矩阵抽象和通用加速器模板，以适配多种 CIM 设计；3. 采用结合加速器级调度与宏单元级分块的细粒度两级映射策略，扩展不同硬件配置下的映射搜索空间。

title: PRIMAL: Processing-In-Memory Based Low-Rank Adaptation for LLM Inference Accelerator
abstract: This paper presents PRIMAL, a processing-in-memory (PIM) based large language model (LLM) inference accelerator with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). PRIMAL integrates heterogeneous PIM processing elements (PEs), interconnected by 2D-mesh inter-PE computational network (IPCN). A novel SRAM reprogramming and power gating (SRPG) scheme enables pipelined LoRA updates and sub-linear power scaling by overlapping reconfiguration with computation and gating idle resources. PRIMAL employs optimized spatial mapping and dataflow orchestration to minimize communication overhead, and achieves $1.5\times$ throughput and $25\times$ energy efficiency over NVIDIA H100 with LoRA rank 8 (Q,V) on Llama-13B.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 本文提出 PRIMAL，一种基于存内计算（PIM）、支持低秩适配（LoRA）的大语言模型（LLM）推理加速器。PRIMAL 集成异构 PIM 处理单元（PE），并通过采用二维网格拓扑的 PE 间计算网络（IPCN）将其互连。本文提出一种 SRAM 重编程与电源门控（SRPG）机制，通过重叠重配置与计算，并对空闲资源实施电源门控，实现流水化的 LoRA 更新和亚线性的功耗增长。PRIMAL 采用优化的空间映射和数据流调度来降低通信开销。在 Llama-13B 上以秩为 8 的 LoRA 适配 Q 和 V 时，PRIMAL 的吞吐量和能效分别达到 NVIDIA H100 的 1.5 倍和 25 倍。
takeaway: 在 Llama-13B 上以秩为 8 的 LoRA 适配 Q 和 V 时，PRIMAL 的吞吐量和能效分别达到 NVIDIA H100 的 1.5 倍和 25 倍。
innovation: 1. 构建支持 LoRA 的异构 PIM 推理架构，采用二维网格 IPCN 互连处理单元；2. 提出 SRAM 重编程与电源门控机制，通过重叠重配置与计算并关闭空闲资源的供电，实现流水化 LoRA 更新和亚线性的功耗增长；3. 优化空间映射与数据流调度，降低通信开销。

title: Neuromorphic Processor Employing FPGA Technology with Universal Interconnections
abstract: Neuromorphic computing, inspired by biological neural systems, holds immense promise for ultra-low-power and real-time inference applications. However, limited access to flexible, open-source platforms continues to hinder widespread adoption and experimentation. In this paper, we present a low-cost neuromorphic processor implemented on a Xilinx Zynq-7000 FPGA platform. The processor supports all-to-all configurable connectivity and employs the leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron model with customizable parameters such as threshold, synaptic weights, and refractory period. Communication with the host system is handled via a UART interface, enabling runtime reconfiguration without hardware resynthesis. The architecture was validated using benchmark datasets including the Iris classification and MNIST digit recognition tasks. Post-synthesis results highlight the design's energy efficiency and scalability, establishing its viability as a research-grade neuromorphic platform that is both accessible and adaptable for real-world spiking neural network applications. This implementation will be released as open source following project completion.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 受生物神经系统启发，神经形态计算在超低功耗实时推理应用中具有巨大潜力。然而，灵活且开源的平台仍然难以获取，制约了该技术的广泛应用和实验研究。本文提出一种在 Xilinx Zynq-7000 FPGA 平台上实现的低成本神经形态处理器。该处理器支持可配置的全互连，采用漏积分发放（LIF）神经元模型，阈值、突触权重和不应期等参数均可自定义。处理器通过 UART 接口与主机通信，无需重新综合硬件即可在运行时重配置。研究使用基准数据集验证了该架构，包括 Iris 分类和 MNIST 手写数字识别任务。综合后结果体现了该设计的能效与可扩展性，表明它可作为一种易于获取、可灵活适配实际脉冲神经网络应用的研究级神经形态平台。项目完成后将开源发布该实现。
takeaway: 该 Xilinx Zynq-7000 FPGA 处理器支持可配置的全互连，并可通过 UART 在运行时重配置，无需重新综合硬件。架构在 Iris 分类和 MNIST 手写数字识别任务上得到验证，综合后结果体现了其能效与可扩展性。
innovation: 1. 在 Xilinx Zynq-7000 FPGA 上实现低成本、支持可配置全互连的神经形态处理器，允许自定义 LIF 神经元的阈值、突触权重和不应期等参数；2. 通过 UART 与主机通信，实现无需重新综合硬件的运行时重配置。

title: Compass: Co-Exploration of Mapping and Hardware for Heterogeneous Multi-Chiplet Accelerators Targeting LLM Inference Service Workloads
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) bring huge computational demands, which makes multi-chiplet accelerators that can integrate large-scale computing resources a powerful solution. However, existing design space exploration (DSE) efforts for such accelerators primarily focus on traditional CNN/Transformer workloads and fall short in supporting the highly dynamic behavior of real-world LLM inference services. This dynamic nature manifests in two key aspects: 1) Mixed request types: the prefill and decode phases exhibit significantly different computational patterns and are frequently interleaved by modern system-level service schedulers; 2) Variable sequence lengths: the sequence length differences across requests can span several orders of magnitude, rendering padding-based assumptions inefficient. Moreover, many prior works assume homogeneous chiplets and overlook the potential beneficial interaction between LLM dynamics and heterogeneous chiplet architectures. To bridge this gap, we introduce Compass, a co-exploration framework designed to optimize mapping strategies and hardware design for multi-chiplet accelerators, specifically tailored for dynamic LLM workloads. First, we propose a computation execution graph-based mapping encoding scheme that decouples micro-batch and layer dimensions, enabling fine-grained execution control on heterogeneous chiplets and flexibly representing various parallelism strategies. Second, based on this scheme, we develop the Compass framework itself, which integrates an evaluation engine, a mapping generation engine based on genetic algorithm, and a hardware sampling engine based on Bayesian optimization, enabling fast and flexible cross-level co-design. Compared with the SOTA DSE works Gemini and MOHaM, Compass reduces latency by 63.92\% and energy by 40.32\% on average in various scenarios, with only a 3.11\% increase in monetary cost.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）的计算需求巨大，能够集成大规模计算资源的多芯粒加速器因此成为一种有效的解决方案。然而，现有此类加速器的设计空间探索（DSE）主要面向传统的 CNN 和 Transformer 工作负载，难以支持实际 LLM 推理服务的高度动态行为。这种动态性体现在两个方面。（1）请求类型混合。预填充和解码阶段的计算模式显著不同，现代系统级服务调度器经常将两者交错调度。（2）序列长度可变。不同请求的序列长度可相差数个数量级，使得基于填充的假设导致效率低下。此外，许多既有工作假设芯粒同构，忽略了 LLM 工作负载的动态特性与异构芯粒架构相结合可能带来的收益。为弥补这一不足，本文提出 Compass，一种专门面向动态 LLM 工作负载、联合优化多芯粒加速器映射策略与硬件设计的协同探索框架。首先，本文提出一种基于计算执行图的映射编码方案，将微批次维度与层维度解耦，支持在异构芯粒上进行细粒度执行控制，并灵活表示多种并行策略。其次，本文在该方案的基础上构建 Compass 框架，集成评估引擎、基于遗传算法的映射生成引擎和基于贝叶斯优化的硬件采样引擎，实现快速、灵活的跨层级协同设计。与当前先进的 DSE 工作 Gemini 和 MOHaM 相比，Compass 在多种场景下平均降低延迟 63.92%、降低能耗 40.32%，货币成本仅增加 3.11%。
takeaway: Compass 面向动态 LLM 推理服务，联合探索多芯粒加速器的映射策略和硬件设计。与 Gemini 和 MOHaM 相比，Compass 在多种场景下平均降低延迟 63.92%、降低能耗 40.32%，货币成本仅增加 3.11%。
innovation: 1. 提出基于计算执行图的映射编码，将微批次维度与层维度解耦，以支持异构芯粒上的细粒度执行控制和多种并行策略；2. 构建 Compass 协同探索框架，集成评估引擎、基于遗传算法的映射生成引擎和基于贝叶斯优化的硬件采样引擎，实现映射与硬件的跨层级协同设计。

title: RISC-V Based TinyML Accelerator for Depthwise Separable Convolutions in Edge AI
abstract: The increasing demand for on-device intelligence in Edge AI and TinyML applications requires the efficient execution of modern Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). While lightweight architectures like MobileNetV2 employ Depthwise Separable Convolutions (DSC) to reduce computational complexity, their multi-stage design introduces a critical performance bottleneck inherent to layer-by-layer execution: the high energy and latency cost of transferring intermediate feature maps to either large on-chip buffers or off-chip DRAM. To address this memory wall, this paper introduces a novel hardware accelerator architecture that utilizes a fused pixel-wise dataflow. Implemented as a Custom Function Unit (CFU) for a RISC-V processor, our architecture eliminates the need for intermediate buffers entirely, reducing the data movement up to 87\% compared to conventional layer-by-layer execution. It computes a single output pixel to completion across all DSC stages-expansion, depthwise convolution, and projection-by streaming data through a tightly-coupled pipeline without writing to memory. Evaluated on a Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA, our design achieves a speedup of up to 59.3x over the baseline software execution on the RISC-V core. Furthermore, ASIC synthesis projects a compact 0.284 mm$^2$ footprint with 910 mW power at 2 GHz in 28 nm, and a 1.20 mm$^2$ footprint with 233 mW power at 300 MHz in 40 nm. This work confirms the feasibility of a zero-buffer dataflow within a TinyML resource envelope, offering a novel and effective strategy for overcoming the memory wall in edge AI accelerators.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 边缘 AI 和 TinyML 应用对端侧智能的需求不断增长，因此需要高效执行现代卷积神经网络（CNN）。MobileNetV2 等轻量级架构采用深度可分离卷积（DSC）降低计算复杂度，但这种多阶段设计在逐层执行时存在一个关键性能瓶颈，即将中间特征图传输到大型片上缓冲区或片外 DRAM 会带来很高的能耗和延迟。为突破这一存储墙，本文提出一种采用融合式逐像素数据流的新型硬件加速器架构。该架构实现为 RISC-V 处理器的自定义功能单元（CFU），完全消除了对中间缓冲区的需求，与常规逐层执行相比，数据搬移量最多减少 87%。该架构通过紧耦合流水线以流式方式传递数据，依次完成扩展、逐通道卷积和投影 3 个阶段，直至算出一个完整的输出像素，全程无需将中间结果写入存储器。在 Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA 上的评估表明，相比在 RISC-V 核上运行的基线软件，该设计的加速比最高达 59.3 倍。此外，ASIC 综合估算表明，在 28 nm 工艺、2 GHz 下，设计面积为 0.284 mm²，功耗为 910 mW。在 40 nm 工艺、300 MHz 下，面积为 1.20 mm²，功耗为 233 mW。本研究验证了零中间缓冲数据流在 TinyML 资源约束下的可行性，为突破边缘 AI 加速器的存储墙提供了一种新的有效方案。
takeaway: 该 RISC-V 加速器通过融合深度可分离卷积的各个阶段消除了中间缓冲区，相比常规逐层执行最多减少 87% 的数据搬移量。在 Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA 上，相比 RISC-V 核上的基线软件，最高实现 59.3 倍加速。
innovation: 1）提出融合式逐像素数据流，通过紧耦合流水线完成单个输出像素的扩展、逐通道卷积和投影，无需缓存或写回中间特征图；2）将该数据流实现为 RISC-V 处理器的自定义功能单元。

title: CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache
abstract: Long-context decoding on edge devices is limited by DRAM, because every generated token reads the whole, growing KV cache. 4-bit block-scaled formats such as NVFP4 reduce this traffic but degrade accuracy: on Qwen3-4B, NVFP4 lowers 32K RULER (seven tasks) from 92.6 to 79.4, and a Hadamard rotation lowers it further to 57.7. We observe that most of the key energy is a positional carrier, one per-head vector that rotary position embedding (RoPE) rotates with position. In NVFP4, it sets the shared scale of most key blocks and lowers the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio of the content by about 5 dB, nearly one bit, yet it depends only on that vector and the position. We therefore introduce positional carrier decomposition, which removes the carrier before RoPE and stores only the content residual. We design a KV path that rotates and quantizes keys only after this removal and computes each attention score directly on the 4-bit code. We also design a positional phase engine that regenerates the carrier's score term for one key per cycle. At the same cache size as NVFP4, CarrierKV raises 32K RULER on Qwen3-4B from 79.4 to 91.1 and lowers the 32K PG19 perplexity increase of NVFP4 by 1.8 to 5.9 times on four models, outperforming SageAttention and P3-LLM on all four. Its loss also stays nearly flat as the cache grows, while that of NVFP4 rises. In a 22 nm FDSOI process at 600 MHz, CarrierKV's hardware increases the area of the NVFP4 accelerator by 2.9% and the energy of a 20K-token reasoning request on Qwen3-4B by 0.12% at the same decode latency. On Qwen3-4B at 32K, CarrierKV has a better RULER score than FP8 keys (91.1 against 89.3) and uses 13.7% less energy per token. The decomposition also lowers the 32K perplexity increase of 3-bit TurboQuant keys on Qwen3-4B from 69.7 to 0.76.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 边缘设备做长上下文解码时，每生成一个 token 都需读取持续增长的 KV 缓存，因而受 DRAM 限制。NVFP4 等四位分块缩放格式能减少流量，但在 Qwen3-4B 上将 32K RULER 七项任务的得分从 92.6 降至 79.4，叠加 Hadamard 旋转后进一步降为 57.7。作者发现，键向量的多数能量来自每个注意力头的一个位置载波向量。该向量随旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）改变方向，并主导大多数 NVFP4 键块的共享缩放因子，使内容的信号与量化噪声比降低约 5 dB。CarrierKV 在 RoPE 前分离并移除位置载波，只旋转、量化和存储内容残差，在四位编码上直接计算内容的注意力分数，再由位置相位引擎以每周期一个键的吞吐重建载波分数项。在缓存与 NVFP4 同样大小时，Qwen3-4B 的 32K RULER 得分升至 91.1，四个模型的 32K PG19 困惑度增幅降为 NVFP4 增幅的约 1/5.9–1/1.8。22 nm FDSOI、600 MHz 的实现相对 NVFP4 加速器增加 2.9% 面积，Qwen3-4B 的 20K-token 推理请求能耗增加 0.12%，解码延迟相同。在 32K 上，它的 RULER 得分高于 FP8 键（91.1 对 89.3），每 token 能耗低 13.7%。同一分解还将三位 TurboQuant 键在 Qwen3-4B 上的 32K 困惑度增幅从 69.7 降至 0.76。
takeaway: 将支配缩放因子的位置载波从内容中分离，可使四位 KV 缓存保留更多内容信息。在同等 NVFP4 缓存容量下，Qwen3-4B 的 32K RULER 从 79.4 升至 91.1，硬件面积增加 2.9%，解码延迟相同。
innovation: 提出 RoPE 前的位置载波分解，把高能量位置项从低比特内容编码中移出，并用四位直接算分通路和位置相位引擎分别计算两部分贡献。

title: KD-DSE: A Knowledge-Driven LLM Framework for Fast Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
abstract: Domain-specific architectures have made design space exploration (DSE) a bottleneck of processor design, yet each candidate costs a full simulation, so exhaustive search is out of reach. Surrogate models need thousands of simulations before they predict reliably, and LLM agents that search directly hallucinate, lack cold-start architectural knowledge, and follow a fixed per-round policy. We present KD-DSE, a knowledge- driven LLM framework for fast microarchitecture DSE. KD- DSE couples a five-state constrained agent with real gem5- McPAT evaluation, retrieves architect-curated guidance from an Architecture Knowledge Base conditioned on the current search state and bottleneck diagnosis, and allocates its budget with a diagnosis-guided two-phase exploration strategy. On a 29- parameter out-of-order core with a budget of 18 simulations, KD-DSE achieves about 4.8% higher hypervolume and about 21.7% lower ADRS than the state-of-the-art MicroEvo, and the ablation attributes the gain chiefly to the Knowledge Base. These results indicate that constraining LLM reasoning and grounding it in architectural knowledge can drive fast and effective microarchitecture DSE. The code will be open-sourced upon acceptance.
abstract_cn: 随着领域专用架构的发展，设计空间探索（DSE）已成为处理器设计的瓶颈。每个候选设计都需要进行一次完整仿真，穷举搜索因而难以实现。代理模型需要数千次仿真才能做出可靠预测，而直接执行搜索的大语言模型（LLM）智能体会产生幻觉，在冷启动阶段缺少体系结构知识，并且每轮都沿用固定策略。本文提出 KD-DSE，一种用于快速微体系结构设计空间探索的知识驱动 LLM 框架。KD-DSE 将受 5 状态约束的智能体与实际的 gem5–McPAT 评估相结合，根据当前搜索状态和瓶颈诊断结果，从体系结构知识库中检索由架构师整理的指导信息，并采用诊断引导的两阶段探索策略分配仿真预算。在一个包含 29 个参数的乱序执行核上，仿真预算为 18 次时，相比当前先进方法 MicroEvo，KD-DSE 的超体积约提高 4.8%，ADRS（与参考集的平均距离）约降低 21.7%。消融实验表明，改进主要归功于知识库。这些结果表明，对 LLM 的推理施加约束并以体系结构知识为依据，可以实现快速、有效的微体系结构设计空间探索。代码将在论文录用后开源。
takeaway: 在包含 29 个参数的乱序执行核上，仅用 18 次仿真，KD-DSE 相比 MicroEvo 将超体积提高约 4.8%，将 ADRS 降低约 21.7%。消融实验表明，体系结构知识库是改进的主要来源。
innovation: 1）将受 5 状态约束的 LLM 智能体与实际的 gem5–McPAT 评估结合；2）依据当前搜索状态和瓶颈诊断结果，从架构师整理的知识库中检索指导信息；3）采用诊断引导的两阶段探索策略分配仿真预算。

title: SlipStream: Enabling HBF for GPU Systems by Mitigating the Latency and SRAM Overheads
abstract:
Large language model (LLM) inference demands ever more memory capacity for larger models and batch sizes. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) replaces the DRAM dies of HBM with NAND flash and provides up to 16x the capacity at comparable read bandwidth. However, HBF can incur a read latency of nearly 20$μ$s, 20x that of HBM, so on-demand HBF accesses slow inference by up to 12.8x. Conventional cache-line prefetchers require 20x more in-flight tracking state to cover this latency. Tensor-streaming designs, such as H3, follow virtual-address order as opposed to kernel-demand order, and therefore need hundreds of megabytes of buffering.
  We propose SlipStream, a software-hardware co-designed prefetcher that turns prefetching into a demand-paced producer-consumer pipeline. In software, SlipStream profiles the repeatable weight-page demand order of data-independent LLM kernels and inserts a staging warp that replays this order with non-blocking STAGE instructions. In hardware, the staging warp acts as the producer and the work warps as consumers. Our key insight is to retire each STAGE tracking entry only when demand first accesses the page, as opposed to when the page returns from HBF. Demand thus paces staging and bounds how far staging leads consumption. SlipStream tracks 4 KB pages instead of cache lines and allocates buffer slots only when pages return, which decouples the buffer size from outstanding traffic. Across seven dense models spanning 16-800 GB, SlipStream with a 40 MB staging buffer achieves 92.4% of the performance of an ideal HBF with HBM-like latency. H3 achieves only 43.1%, even with a 320 MB buffer. The buffer sizing of SlipStream is independent of HBF latency and workload. SlipStream with 16 MB buffer, 20x smaller than that of H3, performs within 4% of SlipStream-40MB. SlipStream also supports Mixture-of-Experts models and reaches 91.2% of ideal performance (40 MB buffer).
abstract_cn:
大语言模型（LLM）推理需要更大的存储容量，以支持更大的模型和批大小。高带宽闪存（HBF）用 NAND 闪存替代高带宽内存（HBM）中的 DRAM 裸片，在读取带宽相当的情况下，容量最高可达 HBM 的 16 倍。然而，HBF 的读取延迟可能接近 20 μs，约为 HBM 的 20 倍，按需访问 HBF 可使推理最多慢至原来的 1/12.8。传统的缓存行预取器需要约 20 倍的在途请求跟踪状态来覆盖这段延迟。H3 等张量流式传输设计按虚拟地址顺序传输，这一顺序与内核实际访问顺序不同，因此需要数百 MB 的缓冲空间。

本文提出 SlipStream，一种软硬件协同设计的预取器，将预取组织为由按需访问控制节奏的生产者–消费者流水线。在软件侧，SlipStream 对访问顺序不依赖输入数据的 LLM 内核进行剖析，记录其可重复的权重页访问顺序，并插入一个预取线程束（staging warp），通过非阻塞 STAGE 指令重放这一顺序。在硬件侧，预取线程束作为生产者，执行计算的线程束作为消费者。该设计将每个 STAGE 跟踪条目保留至计算首次按需访问相应页面，页面从 HBF 返回时仍保留该条目。由此，按需访问控制预取节奏，限制预取领先于消费的程度。SlipStream 采用 4 KB 页粒度取代缓存行粒度进行跟踪，并仅在页面返回时分配缓冲槽位，使缓冲区大小与在途流量解耦。在 7 个大小介于 16–800 GB 的稠密模型上，使用 40 MB 预取缓冲区的 SlipStream 达到了具有 HBM 级延迟的理想 HBF 性能的 92.4%。即使使用 320 MB 缓冲区，H3 也只达到理想性能的 43.1%。SlipStream 的缓冲区大小不依赖 HBF 延迟或工作负载。采用 16 MB 缓冲区时，容量仅为 H3 的 1/20，性能与采用 40 MB 缓冲区的 SlipStream 相差不超过 4%。SlipStream 也支持混合专家（MoE）模型，使用 40 MB 缓冲区时达到理想性能的 91.2%。
takeaway: 在 7 个 16–800 GB 的稠密模型上，SlipStream 使用 40 MB 缓冲区达到具有 HBM 级延迟的理想 HBF 性能的 92.4%，H3 使用 320 MB 缓冲区仅达到 43.1%。将 SlipStream 的缓冲区缩至 16 MB 后，性能与其 40 MB 配置相差不超过 4%。
innovation: 1）在软件侧剖析权重页访问顺序，插入预取线程束并通过非阻塞 STAGE 指令重放该顺序；2）在硬件侧将预取线程束和计算线程束组织为生产者–消费者流水线，在首次按需访问页面时释放对应的 STAGE 跟踪条目，由按需访问控制预取节奏；3）按 4 KB 页跟踪请求，并在页面返回时才分配缓冲槽位，使缓冲区大小与在途流量解耦。

title: PENSA: A Spatial Accelerator for BitNet b1.58 Inference on an HBM-equipped AMD Alveo FPGA
abstract: Ternary large language models (tLLMs) replace general multiplication in dominant linear layers with sign-controlled accumulation, shifting hardware bottlenecks toward packed-weight delivery, reduction, and operator occupancy. PENSA is an end-to-end FPGA accelerator for the BitNet b1.58 2B4T model on an AMD Alveo U50. Two row-partitioned ternary matrix engines consume packed TQ1_0 weights from eight independent high-bandwidth memory (HBM) pseudo-channels, each processing 1,280 ternary weights per cycle through sign selection and integer reduction. The sequencer, attention, and vocabulary-projection units remain resident on the FPGA, while two-stream interleaved scheduling overlaps sequences across the persistent pipeline to form the Penta-Unit. At 104.1~MHz, PENSA achieves 58.09 tok/s at context 128 and 24.60 tok/s at context 2048, corresponding to 2.14-3.14$\times$ the throughput of a same-model Xeon E-2356G baseline. The resulting system demonstrates end-to-end FPGA execution of 2B-scale BitNet topology without modifying its model structure.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 三值大语言模型（tLLM）在线性层这类主要计算环节中，用符号控制的累加替代通用乘法，使硬件瓶颈转向打包权重的供给、归约和算子占用率。PENSA 是一个在 AMD Alveo U50 上运行 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 模型的端到端 FPGA 加速器。两个按行分区的三值矩阵引擎从 8 个独立的高带宽内存（HBM）伪通道读取打包的 TQ1_0 权重，每个引擎每周期通过符号选择和整数归约处理 1,280 个三值权重。时序控制单元、注意力单元和词表投影单元常驻 FPGA，双流交错调度在常驻流水线中重叠执行多个序列，形成 Penta-Unit。在 104.1 MHz 下，PENSA 在上下文长度为 128 时达到 58.09 token/s，在上下文长度为 2048 时达到 24.60 token/s，吞吐量为运行同一模型的 Xeon E-2356G 基线的 2.14–3.14 倍。该系统在保持模型结构的前提下，实现了 20 亿参数量级 BitNet 拓扑在 FPGA 上的端到端执行。
takeaway: 在 AMD Alveo U50 上，PENSA 保持 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 的模型结构并实现端到端推理。在 104.1 MHz 下，上下文长度为 128 和 2048 时分别达到 58.09 和 24.60 token/s，吞吐量为运行同一模型的 Xeon E-2356G 基线的 2.14–3.14 倍。
innovation: 1）采用两个按行分区的三值矩阵引擎，通过 8 个独立的 HBM 伪通道供给打包的 TQ1_0 权重，并以符号选择和整数归约处理权重；2）将时序控制、注意力和词表投影单元常驻于 FPGA，通过双流交错调度在流水线中重叠执行多个序列，形成 Penta-Unit。

title: RoadBlock: Rethinking GPU Tensor Core Microarchitecture for Emerging Microscaling Format Support
abstract: While multiple recent custom Microscaling (MX) format proposals preserve higher model quality over OCP MX, their hardware evaluations remain confined to standalone MAC-unit prototypes, ignoring the system-level integration overheads inside real GPU Tensor Cores. To this end, we present RoadBlock, an open-source framework for accurate end-to-end modeling of custom MX formats in a programmable Tensor Core, built on the RISC-V Vortex GPGPU. RoadBlock exposes data size, scale-factor size, and block size as configurable parameters and automatically derives per-thread metadata tiling for arbitrary formats, enabling format-specific Perplexity-PPA tradeoff evaluation before silicon commitment.
abstract_cn: 近期提出的多种定制微缩放（Microscaling，MX）格式相比 OCP MX 能更好地保持模型质量，但其硬件评估局限于独立的乘累加（MAC）单元原型，忽略了在实际 GPU Tensor Core 中集成这些格式的系统级开销。为此，本文提出 RoadBlock，一个基于 RISC-V Vortex GPGPU 的开源框架，可对可编程 Tensor Core 中的定制 MX 格式进行精确的端到端建模。RoadBlock 将数据位宽、缩放因子位宽和块大小设为可配置参数，并自动为任意格式推导逐线程元数据分块方式，使设计者能够在确定芯片实现方案之前，评估特定格式在困惑度与功耗、性能和面积（PPA）之间的权衡。
takeaway: RoadBlock 在基于 RISC-V Vortex GPGPU 的可编程 Tensor Core 中对定制 MX 格式进行端到端建模，支持在确定芯片实现方案前，按格式评估困惑度与 PPA 的权衡。
innovation: 1）基于 RISC-V Vortex GPGPU 构建开源框架，对可编程 Tensor Core 中的定制 MX 格式进行端到端建模；2）将数据位宽、缩放因子位宽和块大小参数化，并自动为任意格式推导逐线程元数据分块方式。

title: Memory Admission and Result-Retention Sizing in an RV32IMC FPGA Soft Processor
abstract: In FPGA soft processors with shared backing block RAM, memory admission can stall a multiplication after its product has been prepared. We study how admission timing changes result retention in PaceRV, our board-tested five-stage RV32IMC core, using fixed binaries and matched dynamic instructions. Offering data requests one edge earlier reduces geometric-mean Embench cycles by 18.2% and retention opportunities from 375,063 to 4,373. Admission and retention cycle gains are conditional and non-additive. Under slower reads, a 99% capture target selects an 18-edge validity window with registered requests and 28 edges with early requests, although no multiplication matched within both measurement intervals waits longer. A predeclared sizing rule predicts opportunity recovery exactly in all finite tests, including kernels excluded from model development. Independent timing analysis closely estimates execution-cycle savings. The results support choosing admission first, then deciding whether to extend validity and sizing it against an explicit capture or missed-opportunity objective.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 在使用共享块 RAM 作为后备存储的 FPGA 软核处理器中，访存请求的接纳可能使乘法指令在乘积已经就绪后仍然停顿。本文使用固定的二进制程序和相互匹配的动态指令，在经过板级验证的五级流水线 RV32IMC 核 PaceRV 上研究访存接纳时序如何影响乘法结果保留。将数据请求提前 1 个时钟边沿提交，使 Embench 执行周期数的几何平均值降低 18.2%，并使可利用结果保留的机会数从 375,063 降至 4,373。调整接纳时序和保留结果所带来的周期节省均取决于具体条件，且不可相加。在读取较慢时，若要求覆盖 99% 的保留机会，采用寄存后的请求需要 18 个时钟边沿的结果有效窗口，采用提前提交的请求则需要 28 个时钟边沿，尽管在两个测量区间中均能匹配到的乘法指令里，没有任何一条因此等待更久。预先声明的窗口定长规则在所有有限测试中均精确预测了可重新捕获的机会数，包括未参与建模的计算内核。独立的时序分析也能较准确地估算节省的执行周期数。结果支持先选定访存接纳时序，再决定是否延长结果有效期，并按照明确的机会覆盖目标或遗漏目标确定窗口长度。
takeaway: 在板测 PaceRV 上，相比寄存后提交请求，提前 1 个时钟边沿提交可使 Embench 执行周期数的几何平均值减少 18.2%，结果保留机会数从 375,063 降至 4,373。较慢读取下，达到 99% 机会覆盖率所需的有效窗口在两种方案下分别为 18 和 28 个时钟边沿，说明应先选定接纳时序，再按目标确定保留窗口。
innovation: 1）使用固定二进制程序和匹配的动态指令，测量不同访存接纳时序下的乘法结果保留机会；2）预先声明结果有效窗口的定长规则，用于预测可重新捕获的机会数；3）用独立时序分析估算执行周期节省量。

title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 对候选 CPU 设计进行长时间 RTL 仿真可能耗费数小时，而短时诊断运行可能漏掉执行后期才出现的性能退化。这一评估开销可能拖慢基于大语言模型（LLM）智能体的 CPU 开发中的设计决策。本文提出一种开发环境，让 LLM 智能体在 FPGA 上实现候选 CPU，并利用板上性能测量指导设计决策。作者在人工监督下使用该环境，将一个单周期 RV32I 核逐步开发为一个三宽度乱序执行的 RV32IM 核。最终设计在 Artix-7 FPGA 上以 130 MHz 运行，达到 5.61 CoreMark/MHz。对于同一候选 CPU 运行 8,000 次 CoreMark 迭代的任务，计入 FPGA 实现时间后，FPGA 评估的速度仍为单线程 RTL 仿真的 9.6 倍。在一个案例中，某候选设计在短时诊断运行中表现出性能提升，板上测量却揭示了其长时间运行时的性能退化。这一结果指导了候选方案的选择，并推动了基于 RTL 的根因分析和修复。
takeaway: 对同一候选 CPU 运行 8,000 次 CoreMark 迭代时，计入 FPGA 实现时间的板级评估速度为单线程 RTL 仿真的 9.6 倍，并在一个案例中发现了短时诊断漏掉的长期性能退化。人工监督下开发的最终 RV32IM 核在 Artix-7 上以 130 MHz 达到 5.61 CoreMark/MHz。
innovation: 1）构建 FPGA 在环的 CPU 开发环境，使 LLM 智能体能够在 FPGA 上实现候选设计，并用板上性能实测指导设计决策。

title: PaFeDSE: Pareto-Feedback-Guided Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration for Efficient Pareto Search
abstract: Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors. While machine-learning-based DSE significantly reduces the cost of exhaustively evaluating large design spaces, existing methods still waste expensive simulations on Pareto-miss candidates that do not improve the Pareto frontier and repeatedly process redundant candidates during iterative exploration. In this paper, we propose PaFeDSE, a Pareto-feedback-guided microarchitecture DSE framework for efficient Pareto search. PaFeDSE leverages Pareto-hit feedback to prioritize candidates likely to improve the frontier and Pareto-miss feedback to suppress exploration of unpromising local regions, while filtering redundant candidates that remain low priority across iterations. Evaluated on SPEC CPU 2017 workloads, PaFeDSE requires up to 49.0% fewer simulations than the strongest prior baseline to reach target hypervolume levels, while achieving a 7.1x reduction in exploration overhead through adaptive candidate filtering.
abstract_cn: 高效的微架构设计空间探索（DSE）对于优化现代乱序处理器在性能、功耗和面积之间的权衡至关重要。基于机器学习的 DSE 大幅降低了穷举评估大规模设计空间的成本，但现有方法仍将昂贵的仿真资源耗费在未能改善帕累托前沿的候选方案上，并在迭代探索中反复处理冗余候选。本文提出 PaFeDSE，这是一个利用帕累托反馈指导高效帕累托搜索的微架构 DSE 框架。PaFeDSE 利用帕累托命中反馈优先考虑可能改善前沿的候选方案，利用帕累托未命中反馈抑制对前景不佳的局部区域的探索，并筛除在多轮迭代中持续处于低优先级的冗余候选。在 SPEC CPU 2017 工作负载上的评估显示，达到目标超体积水平时，PaFeDSE 所需的仿真次数较最强的已有基线最多减少 49.0%，自适应候选筛选还将探索开销降至原来的约 1/7.1。
takeaway: 在 SPEC CPU 2017 上，达到目标超体积水平时，PaFeDSE 的仿真次数较最强的已有基线最多减少 49.0%，自适应候选筛选将探索开销降至原来的约 1/7.1。
innovation: 1）利用帕累托命中反馈，优先探索可能改善帕累托前沿的候选方案；2）利用帕累托未命中反馈，抑制对前景不佳的局部区域的探索；3）自适应筛除在多轮迭代中持续处于低优先级的冗余候选。

title: SUSpMV: A High Frequency Sparse Matrix Vector Multiplier on HBM Enabled FPGA written in SUS
abstract:
SUSpMV is a Sparse Matrix Vector multiplication (SpMV) accelerator written in the upcoming HDL SUS. By leveraging SUS's unique latency counting and inference mechanism, SUSpMV could be designed with very deep pipelines yet small design complexity overhead. This enables an efficient implementation which employs all 32 HBM channels on the Alveo U280 FPGA at 400MHz for streaming matrix data into 32 Compute Units (CUs). Input and output vectors are stored in DDR memory, which allows zero-overhead chaining of multiplications and increases overall system memory bandwidth by not sharing HBM bandwidth with the CUs.
  A CU processes the SpMV in tiles of width 1024 and a dynamically chosen height, up to 32768. Each CU is capable of accumulating the multiplications with up to 6 separate matrix entries per cycle, resulting in the combined theoretical peak computational throughput of 153.6 GFLOPs. The matrix storage format is designed to exploit density variation within a given matrix by dynamically switching between one representation optimized for denser regions, and a second optimized for sparser regions, allowing jumps of up to 255 rows between each entry.
  Evaluation demonstrates a 79% geometric mean improvement over prior work on the same platform. We achieve a peak throughput of 144.9 GFLOPs, or 94% of our theoretical computational throughput, compared to 98 GFLOPs reached by prior work.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
SUSpMV 是一种稀疏矩阵向量乘法（SpMV）加速器，采用即将推出的硬件描述语言 SUS 编写。借助 SUS 特有的延迟计数与推断机制，SUSpMV 能够以较小的设计复杂度开销实现很深的流水线。该实现以 400 MHz 运行，利用 Alveo U280 FPGA 的全部 32 个 HBM 通道，将矩阵数据流式送入 32 个计算单元（CU）。输入和输出向量存放在 DDR 内存中，使多次乘法可零开销串接，同时避免向量访问占用计算单元所需的 HBM 带宽，从而提高系统总内存带宽。

每个 CU 按分块执行 SpMV，块宽固定为 1024，块高动态选取，最高为 32768。每个 CU 每周期最多可累加来自 6 个不同矩阵元素的乘积，所有 CU 的理论峰值计算吞吐率合计为 153.6 GFLOP/s。矩阵存储格式通过在两种表示之间动态切换，利用同一矩阵内部的密度差异。一种表示针对较稠密区域优化，另一种针对较稀疏区域优化，允许相邻条目之间最多跨越 255 行。

评估表明，与同一平台上的既有工作相比，性能提升的几何平均值为 79%。SUSpMV 的峰值吞吐率为 144.9 GFLOP/s，达到理论计算吞吐率的 94%，既有工作的峰值为 98 GFLOP/s。
takeaway: 在同一 Alveo U280 平台上，与既有工作相比，SUSpMV 的性能提升几何平均值为 79%。峰值吞吐率从既有工作的 98 GFLOP/s 提高到 144.9 GFLOP/s，达到其理论峰值的 94%。
innovation: 1）利用 SUS 的延迟计数与推断机制构建深流水线，以 400 MHz 使用全部 32 个 HBM 通道为 32 个 CU 流式供给矩阵数据；2）将输入和输出向量存放在 DDR，实现零开销的乘法串接，并将向量访问与 CU 的 HBM 访问分开；3）采用固定宽度、动态高度的分块，每个 CU 每周期最多累加 6 个矩阵元素对应的乘积；4）根据矩阵的局部密度在两种存储表示之间动态切换。

title: Memory Bandwidth, Not FLOPs: Profiling and Accelerating Query-Based Segmentation Decoders on Edge GPUs
abstract: Query-based segmentation models achieve strong performance even under real-time inference on workstation GPUs. On edge devices, however, we show their transformer decoders are deeply memory-bandwidth-bound, a bottleneck invisible to standard FLOP analysis that worsens with input resolution and limited DRAM bandwidth. An FP16 roofline analysis with tensor-core GEMMs active and hardware DRAM counters shows that the non-tensor-core aggregates of FastInst and Mask2Former reach only $2.5\%$ to $6\%$ of the CUDA-core ridge yet account for $53\%$ to $70\%$ of decoder time and $61\%$ to $71\%$ of decoder bytes. The largest individual kernels sustain up to $90\%$ of nominal peak DRAM bandwidth, effectively saturating the memory bus. The bottleneck is therefore not primarily low GEMM intensity, but cross-kernel activation traffic. CompactInst addresses this bottleneck using parameter-free spatial pooling at $4{\times}$, which reduces the bytes moved within the transformer decoder, while a two-convolution refinement head recovers spatial detail. Under TensorRT FP16 on Jetson Orin Nano, CompactInst delivers decoder speedups from $2.35{\times}$ to $4.74{\times}$ and model speedups from $1.57{\times}$ to $2.62{\times}$ as input resolution grows, while closely matching accuracy ($-0.4$ AP on COCO val2017, $+0.2$ AP on Cityscapes test). A heavier variant with $2.57{\times}$ more decoder FLOPs still runs its decoder $1.74{\times}$ faster on the most bandwidth-constrained device, confirming at the deployment level that decoder bytes, not FLOPs, govern latency.
abstract_cn: 基于查询的分割模型即使在工作站 GPU 上进行实时推理，也能取得良好表现。本文发现，在边缘设备上，这类模型的 Transformer 解码器严重受内存带宽限制。标准 FLOP 分析无法发现这一瓶颈，且输入分辨率越高、DRAM 带宽越有限，瓶颈就越严重。在启用 Tensor Core GEMM 的条件下，结合硬件 DRAM 计数器进行的 FP16 屋顶线（Roofline）分析表明，FastInst 和 Mask2Former 的非 Tensor Core 算子整体的算术强度仅为 CUDA Core Roofline 拐点对应算术强度的 2.5%–6%，却占解码器耗时的 53%–70% 和数据搬运字节数的 61%–71%。规模最大的单个内核可持续达到标称 DRAM 峰值带宽的 90%，实际已使内存总线接近饱和。因此，主要瓶颈来自内核之间的激活数据搬运，而非 GEMM 的低算术强度。CompactInst 采用 将空间 token 数降至原来 1/4 的无参数空间池化，减少 Transformer 解码器内部搬运的字节数，并用包含两层卷积的细化头恢复空间细节。在 Jetson Orin Nano 上使用 TensorRT FP16 时，随着输入分辨率提高，CompactInst 的解码器加速比从 2.35 倍升至 4.74 倍，整模型加速比从 1.57 倍升至 2.62 倍，精度仍与基线接近（COCO val2017 上 −0.4 AP，Cityscapes test 上 +0.2 AP）。在带宽最受限的设备上，计算量更大的变体即使解码器 FLOP 数达到基线的 2.57 倍，解码器仍快 1.74 倍。这从实际部署层面证实，决定解码器延迟的是搬运的字节数，而非 FLOP 数。
takeaway: 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上使用 TensorRT FP16 时，CompactInst 随输入分辨率提高取得 2.35–4.74 倍的解码器加速和 1.57–2.62 倍的整模型加速，精度与基线接近（COCO val2017 上 −0.4 AP，Cityscapes test 上 +0.2 AP）。在带宽最受限的设备上，解码器 FLOP 数达到基线 2.57 倍的变体仍取得 1.74 倍解码器加速，表明延迟主要取决于数据搬运量。
innovation: 1）在启用 Tensor Core GEMM 的条件下，将 FP16 屋顶线分析与硬件 DRAM 计数器结合，定位解码器中由跨内核激活搬运引起的带宽瓶颈；2）在 CompactInst 中用 将空间 token 数降至原来 1/4 的无参数空间池化减少解码器数据搬运，并用两层卷积组成的细化头恢复空间细节。

title: Quantifying the Effect of HCLs on a Fixed-Microarchitecture MXFP4 Accelerator
abstract: Hardware Construction Languages (HCLs) aim to improve hardware design productivity while generating register-transfer-level (RTL) circuits without changing the designer's microarchitecture. However, most comparisons between HCLs are either qualitative or evaluate quality of results (QoR) across different designs, making it difficult to separate language effects from design effects. This paper compares the most widely used HCLs using the same fixed design, the OCP MXFP4 block dot product, a quantization primitive at the heart of edge Physical-AI inference, implemented as a single 12-stage, II=1 pipeline. A SystemVerilog baseline is followed by implementations in Chisel, SpinalHDL, Amaranth, Clash, Bluespec, and C++ for high-level synthesis (HLS). Every variant goes through the same flow on the same Artix-7 device set at 100 MhZ, driven by a RISC-V soft core. With the micro-architecture held constant, the comparison is clean: every variant meets timing, and the HCLs match or even undercut hand-written RTL in area. The remaining differences stem not from the algorithm but from how each back end lowers arithmetic, and from a single width choice that silently toggles DSP inference. Unlike HLS, where design decisions are limited to pragmas, the HCLs achieve comparable area and timing. Therefore, the choice comes down to ecosystem fit and interface needs rather than QoR.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 硬件构建语言（HCL）旨在提高硬件设计效率，在保持设计者所定微架构的同时生成寄存器传输级（RTL）电路。然而，现有的 HCL 比较大多采用定性分析，或基于不同设计评估实现结果质量（QoR），因而难以区分语言和设计各自的影响。本文选用同一个固定设计来比较最常用的 HCL。该设计实现 OCP MXFP4 块点积，这是边缘物理 AI 推理中的核心量化原语，采用一条 12 级流水线，启动间隔（II）为 1。研究以 SystemVerilog 实现为基线，并分别采用 Chisel、SpinalHDL、Amaranth、Clash、Bluespec 以及面向高层次综合（HLS）的 C++ 实现该设计。所有版本均采用相同的工具流程，在同一款 Artix-7 器件上以 100 MHz 为目标频率，并由 RISC-V 软核驱动。固定微架构后，各版本均满足时序要求，HCL 实现的面积与手写 RTL 相当，部分实现甚至更小。各版本采用相同的算法，余下差异源于各后端将算术运算转换为低层硬件表示的方式，以及一处会在没有显式提示的情况下改变 DSP 推断结果的位宽选择。HLS 中的设计决策仅能通过编译指导指令（pragma）来表达，而 HCL 实现能够达到与基线相当的面积和时序指标。因此，在该设计中，选择 HCL 时主要考虑生态适配性和接口需求，QoR 并非决定因素。
takeaway: 在同一 Artix-7 器件上，固定为 12 级、II = 1 的 MXFP4 块点积流水线后，所有实现均满足 100 MHz 时序要求，HCL 实现的面积与手写 SystemVerilog RTL 相当或更小。余下差异来自后端的算术映射和一处影响 DSP 推断的位宽选择。
innovation: 1. 固定 OCP MXFP4 块点积的微架构，在同一器件、目标频率和工具流程下，对比手写 SystemVerilog、6 种 HCL 和 C++ HLS 实现；2. 将固定微架构后余下的实现差异归因于后端算术映射和一处影响 DSP 推断的位宽选择。

title: Hardware Trojan Threats to Multi-Chiplet Photonic Neural Network Accelerators
abstract: Multi-chiplet photonic neural network accelerators (MCPNAs) combine photonic computation, photonic communica-tion, and heterogeneous chiplet integration to enable scalable and energy-efficient AI acceleration. However, their distributed archi-tecture and reliance on third-party chiplets introduce significant hardware security risks. This paper examines Hardware Trojan (HT) threats to MCPNAs across three dimensions: confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 多芯粒光子神经网络加速器（MCPNA）将光子计算、光子通信和异构芯粒集成相结合，实现可扩展且能效较高的 AI 加速。然而，其分布式架构及对第三方芯粒的依赖带来了显著的硬件安全风险。本文从机密性、完整性和可用性三个维度考察 MCPNA 面临的硬件木马（HT）威胁。
takeaway: 多芯粒光子神经网络加速器的分布式架构及对第三方芯粒的依赖带来显著的硬件安全风险。论文从机密性、完整性和可用性三个维度考察硬件木马威胁。
innovation: 1. 从机密性、完整性和可用性三个维度考察多芯粒光子神经网络加速器面临的硬件木马威胁。摘要未说明具体分析方法。

title: The Road Less Traveled: Congestion-Aware NoC Placement and Packet Routing for FPGAs
abstract:
To help scale to ever-larger and more complex designs, recent FPGA architectures now integrate network-on-chips (NoCs). NoCs help transfer high-bandwidth data over long distances within the chip without using scarce low-delay long routing wire segments. While NoC-enhanced FPGAs aid system integration and design reuse, they also complicate FPGA computer-aided design (CAD) flows by introducing new constraints and metrics. Placement and routing need to optimize NoC metrics like latency and bandwidth utilization and avoid link oversubscription (congestion), while simultaneously optimizing the programmable routing resource usage of the design modules attached to NoC routers.
  In this work, we develop several new approaches to reduce NoC congestion while minimizing the impact on other design metrics. First, we incorporate a NoC link congestion cost into the placement engine of the open-source CAD flow, versatile place & route (VPR). Second, we integrate turn model NoC routing algorithms into the placement engine to leverage path diversity to further reduce congestion. On average over a suite of 29 benchmarks, combining placement congestion modeling with turn model packet routing reduces NoC congestion by 90.7% at the cost of increasing aggregate bandwidth demand by 4%. In cases where the enhanced placement engine and NoC routing fail to fully resolve congestion, we formulate NoC routing as a Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problem. This approach yields significant additional improvements; the combined algorithm reduces congestion by 95.1% compared to the baseline placement. Finally, we enhance the reinforcement learning (RL) agent in VPR's placement engine by introducing a NoC-aware move type, resulting in an 8.8% reduction in wirelength on designs that make extensive use of the NoC.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
为支持规模和复杂度不断增长的设计，近期的 FPGA 架构开始集成片上网络（NoC）。NoC 能够在芯片内部进行长距离、高带宽的数据传输，无需占用稀缺的低延迟长布线段。集成 NoC 的 FPGA 有助于系统集成和设计复用，但也为 FPGA 计算机辅助设计（CAD）流程引入了新的约束和指标，使流程更加复杂。布局布线既要优化延迟和带宽利用率等 NoC 指标，避免链路因需求超过容量而拥塞，也要优化连接到 NoC 路由器的设计模块对可编程布线资源的使用。

本文提出多种方法，以降低 NoC 拥塞，并尽量减小对其他设计指标的影响。首先，在开源 CAD 工具流程 Versatile Place & Route（VPR）的布局引擎中引入 NoC 链路拥塞代价。其次，将基于转向模型的 NoC 路由算法集成到布局引擎中，利用路径多样性进一步减轻拥塞。在一组包含 29 个基准设计的测试中，结合布局阶段的拥塞建模与基于转向模型的分组路由，平均可使 NoC 拥塞降低 90.7%，代价是总带宽需求增加 4%。当改进后的布局引擎与 NoC 路由仍无法完全消除拥塞时，本文将 NoC 路由建模为布尔可满足性（SAT）问题。该方法带来显著的额外改善，组合算法较基线布局减少了 95.1% 的拥塞。最后，本文为 VPR 布局引擎中的强化学习（RL）智能体引入一种感知 NoC 的移动类型，使大量使用 NoC 的设计的布线线长减少 8.8%。
takeaway: 在 29 个基准设计上，结合布局拥塞建模与基于转向模型的分组路由，平均使 NoC 拥塞降低 90.7%，总带宽需求增加 4%。针对残余拥塞加入 SAT 路由后，组合算法较基线布局减少了 95.1% 的拥塞。
innovation: 1. 在 VPR 布局引擎中引入 NoC 链路拥塞代价；2. 在布局引擎中集成基于转向模型的 NoC 路由，利用路径多样性分散流量；3. 在仍有拥塞时，将 NoC 路由建模为布尔可满足性问题；4. 为 VPR 布局引擎的强化学习智能体引入感知 NoC 的移动类型。

title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths
abstract: Modern mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models increasingly strain the capacity and cost efficiency of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), as rapidly growing expert weights must be provisioned close to GPUs. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers substantially greater capacity, but conventional designs typically deliver HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through HBM, leaving an additional direct GPU-HBF connection underutilized. We explore an HBF organization that simultaneously exploits two independent expert-delivery routes: a direct path that transfers expert weights from HBF to the GPU and a relay path that transfers them from HBF through the HBM base die to the GPU. Whole experts are assigned to one of the two routes, and transfers over both routes proceed concurrently, increasing aggregate expert-delivery bandwidth without replicating expert weights or introducing a shared relay bottleneck. Early expert determination identifies upcoming experts ahead of their conventional execution point, allowing HBF read latency to overlap with preceding computation, while separate management of immutable expert weights and mutable KV-cache data reduces interference between the two traffic classes. We evaluate the architecture using an event-driven continuous-batching LLM serving simulator with empirically measured GPU compute latencies. Across representative MoE workloads, concurrently utilizing the direct GPU-HBF and HBF-HBM-GPU routes consistently improves expert-delivery efficiency over designs restricted to either route alone. For a representative workload, the proposed architecture can achieve 1.94$\times$ higher throughput and 1.90$\times$ end-to-end speedup over a design that delivers all HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through the HBM base die.
abstract_cn: 现代混合专家（MoE）语言模型的专家权重快速增长，且需要部署在靠近 GPU 的位置，这给高带宽内存（HBM）的容量和成本效益带来越来越大的压力。高带宽闪存（HBF）可提供大得多的容量，但传统设计通常经由 HBM 将存储在 HBF 中的专家权重传送到 GPU，导致额外的 GPU 与 HBF 直连链路利用不足。本文探索一种同时利用两条独立专家权重传输路径的 HBF 组织方式。直连路径将专家权重直接从 HBF 传至 GPU，中继路径则经由 HBM 基础裸片将权重从 HBF 传至 GPU。每个专家的全部权重分配给其中一条路径，两条路径并行传输，从而提高专家权重的总传输带宽，同时避免复制权重或引入共享中继瓶颈。通过提前确定即将使用的专家，系统可以在常规执行时点前发起读取，使 HBF 读取延迟与前序计算重叠。系统还分别管理不可变的专家权重和可变的 KV 缓存数据，以减少两类流量之间的干扰。本文使用事件驱动、支持连续批处理的大语言模型（LLM）服务模拟器评估该架构，模拟采用实测的 GPU 计算延迟。在多种代表性 MoE 工作负载上，同时使用 GPU 与 HBF 的直连路径以及 HBF–HBM–GPU 中继路径，其专家权重传输效率始终高于仅使用任一路径的设计。在一项代表性工作负载上，与所有存储在 HBF 中的专家权重均经 HBM 基础裸片传至 GPU 的设计相比，所提架构可实现 1.94 倍的吞吐量和 1.90 倍的端到端加速。
takeaway: 在采用实测 GPU 计算延迟的模拟评估中，双路径并行传输在多种代表性 MoE 工作负载上均比任一单路径设计具有更高的专家权重传输效率。在一项代表性工作负载上，相较于全部专家权重均经 HBM 基础裸片从 HBF 传至 GPU 的基线，双路径架构可达到 1.94 倍吞吐量和 1.90 倍端到端加速。
innovation: 1. 以完整专家为单位分配权重传输路径，并发使用 HBF 至 GPU 的直连路径和经 HBM 基础裸片的中继路径，无需复制专家权重或引入共享中继瓶颈；2. 提前确定即将使用的专家，使 HBF 读取延迟与前序计算重叠；3. 分别管理不可变的专家权重与可变的 KV 缓存数据，减少两类流量之间的干扰。

title: FPGA Lifecycle Management for RISC-V Systems
abstract: FPGA lifecycle management remains tied to proprietary toolchains and host architectures, leaving RISC-V without a vendor-neutral model for scalable bitstream deployment. A host-agnostic control-plane architecture is presented that shifts lifecycle management to the operating-system layer by leveraging standard Linux capabilities, thereby decoupling deployment from specific ISAs and vendor stacks. This enables Linux-capable RISC-V processors to serve as control hosts in heterogeneous FPGA systems. Prototyped on a Zynq-7000 SoC and generalizable to RISC-V platforms, the architecture provides a portable foundation for fleet-scale FPGA management.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: FPGA 生命周期管理仍依赖专有工具链和特定主机架构，使 RISC-V 缺少可扩展且独立于厂商的比特流部署模式。本文提出一种与主机架构无关的控制平面，利用 Linux 的标准能力将生命周期管理移至操作系统层，从而将部署与特定指令集架构（ISA）及厂商技术栈解耦。这使能够运行 Linux 的 RISC-V 处理器可以在异构 FPGA 系统中充当控制主机。该架构已在 Zynq-7000 片上系统（SoC）上实现原型，可推广至 RISC-V 平台，为大规模 FPGA 设备群管理提供可移植的基础。
takeaway: 该控制平面利用 Linux 标准能力将 FPGA 生命周期管理移至操作系统层，使支持 Linux 的 RISC-V 处理器能够担任异构 FPGA 系统的控制主机。架构已在 Zynq-7000 SoC 上实现原型，可推广至 RISC-V 平台。
innovation: 1. 提出与主机架构无关的 FPGA 生命周期管理控制平面，利用 Linux 标准能力将管理移至操作系统层，使比特流部署与特定 ISA 和厂商技术栈解耦。

title: C2P-Cache: Scalable GPU L1 Cache Sharing via Concurrent Candidate Pruning
abstract:
Modern GPUs rely on private per-SM L1 caches and a shared L2 cache, but this organization obscures cross-SM reuse: an L1 miss is typically forwarded to L2 even when the requested line already resides in a peer L1 cache, leading to redundant L2 access. Prior GPU L1-sharing designs attempt to recover such reuse through exact or broad remote-hit searches, which become increasingly difficult to scale and can interfere with the critical L1 miss path under high concurrency. %miss handling as more caches participate and more misses arrive concurrently. We observe that eliminating redundant L2 accesses does not require exact, chip-wide knowledge of private L1 contents. Instead, it requires only sufficient visibility to sharply narrow down a small set of candidate caches, leaving exact confirmation to a much smaller number of L1s.
  Based on this insight, we propose C2P-Cache, a scalable GPU L1-sharing mechanism that transforms remote-hit discovery from a chip-wide exact search problem into a lightweight filtering-and-confirmation process. C2P-Cache maintains compact Bloom-filter-based snapshots of private L1 tags, performs parallel chip-wide candidate filtering, and selectively probes only a small number of likely peer caches. To sustain high concurrency, C2P-Cache organizes filtering as bit-sliced matching over a banked and replicated snapshot matrix, enabling efficient, parallel processing of many concurrent misses without interfering with normal L1 accesses. Across a wide range of GPU workloads, C2P-Cache improves instructions per cycle (IPC) by up to 49.7\% and by 23.5\% on average for applications with high remote-L1 reuse and strong sensitivity to L2 latency, demonstrating that lightweight, scalable filtering can effectively unlock cross-SM reuse with modest overhead.
abstract_cn:
现代 GPU 采用每个流式多处理器（SM）私有的 L1 缓存和共享的 L2 缓存，但这种组织方式使跨 SM 的数据复用难以被发现。即使请求的缓存行已驻留在另一个 SM 的 L1 缓存中，L1 缺失通常仍会被转发至 L2，从而产生冗余的 L2 访问。以往的 GPU L1 共享设计通过精确搜索或大范围搜索来发现远端命中，以利用这类复用机会。随着参与的缓存增多、同时到达的缺失请求增加，这些搜索方式越来越难以扩展，并可能在高并发下干扰 L1 缺失处理的关键路径。我们观察到，消除冗余的 L2 访问只需掌握足以将候选缓存迅速缩小到少数几个的信息，再由这些 L1 缓存精确确认命中，无需精确掌握全芯片各私有 L1 缓存的内容。

基于这一观察，我们提出 C2P-Cache，一种可扩展的 GPU L1 共享机制，将远端命中发现由全芯片精确搜索转化为轻量级的筛选和确认流程。C2P-Cache 使用布隆过滤器维护私有 L1 缓存标签的紧凑快照，在全芯片范围内并行筛选候选缓存，仅选择性地探测少数最可能命中的其他 L1 缓存。为支持高并发，C2P-Cache 将快照组织为分存储体且具有副本的矩阵，并通过位切片匹配完成筛选，从而高效并行处理大量并发缺失请求，同时避免干扰常规 L1 访问。在多种 GPU 工作负载的评估中，对于远端 L1 复用程度高且对 L2 延迟高度敏感的应用，C2P-Cache 将每周期指令数（IPC）最高提升 49.7%，平均提升 23.5%。结果表明，轻量且可扩展的筛选机制能够以较小的开销有效利用跨 SM 复用。
takeaway: C2P-Cache 先并行筛选候选 L1 缓存，再探测少数最可能命中的缓存，以减少冗余 L2 访问。对于远端 L1 复用程度高且对 L2 延迟高度敏感的应用，IPC 最高提升 49.7%，平均提升 23.5%。
innovation: 1. 使用布隆过滤器维护私有 L1 缓存标签的紧凑快照；2. 在全芯片范围内并行筛选候选缓存，仅探测少数最可能命中的 L1 缓存以确认远端命中；3. 在分存储体且具有副本的快照矩阵上执行位切片匹配，并行处理大量 L1 缺失请求，同时避免干扰常规 L1 访问。

title: SEAM-V: A Hybrid-Decoupled RISC-V Vector Processor with Backend-Visible Packet Semantics and Source-Lifetime-Aware Scheduling
abstract: Data-parallel workloads in deep learning and scientific computing continue to increase the demands on processor throughput, energy efficiency, and scalability. The RISC-V Vector Extension (RVV) supports scalable execution through a vector-length-agnostic model, yet many tightly coupled implementations still rely on the scalar core to supply vector instructions individually and are therefore constrained by instruction supply, scalar-side progress, memory stalls, and conservative dependence management in short-vector, loop-tail, and control/memory-interleaved scenarios. This paper presents SEAM-V, a hybrid-decoupled RVV processor that uses task-level decoupling, local instruction supply, and VLIW-style packing to form a continuous stream of execute packets (EPs). During EP formation and request serialization, SEAM-V preserves the association between prefetch intent and the corresponding load to support request-bound prefetching, while lane-level source-read completion is used to release pure write-after-read (WAR) dependences early; other dependences remain governed by conventional mechanisms. Relative to an Ara-based tightly coupled baseline (TC), SEAM-V achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.38x across 17 representative kernel configurations. The one-dimensional vector, BLAS and matrix, and fixed-size application workload groups achieve 1.56x, 1.35x, and 1.23x, respectively. Synthesis and power analysis show that SEAM-V increases total cell area by 4.29% and geometric mean runtime power by 17.30%, while reducing task energy by 12.70%, demonstrating improved sustained execution efficiency and task-level energy efficiency with limited area overhead.
abstract_cn: 深度学习和科学计算中的数据并行工作负载不断提高对处理器吞吐量、能效和可扩展性的要求。RISC-V 向量扩展（RVV）通过向量长度无关的模型支持可扩展执行，但许多紧耦合实现仍依赖标量核逐条提供向量指令，因此在短向量、循环尾部以及控制与访存操作交错的场景中，容易受到指令供给、标量侧执行进度、访存停顿和保守的依赖管理机制的制约。本文提出混合解耦的 RVV 处理器 SEAM-V，通过任务级解耦、本地指令供给和超长指令字（VLIW）式打包，形成连续的执行包（EP）流。在执行包形成和请求串行化过程中，SEAM-V 保留预取意图与对应加载操作之间的关联，以支持与请求绑定的预取。同时，SEAM-V 根据各向量通道的源操作数读取完成状态，提前解除纯写后读（WAR）依赖，其他依赖仍由常规机制管理。相较于基于 Ara 的紧耦合基线（TC），SEAM-V 在 17 种代表性计算内核配置上的加速比几何平均值为 1.38 倍。一维向量、BLAS 与矩阵运算、固定规模应用这 3 组工作负载的加速比分别为 1.56 倍、1.35 倍和 1.23 倍。综合和功耗分析表明，SEAM-V 的单元总面积增加 4.29%，运行功耗的几何平均值增加 17.30%，而任务能耗降低 12.70%。结果表明，SEAM-V 以有限的面积开销提高了持续执行效率和任务级能效。
takeaway: 相较于基于 Ara 的紧耦合基线（TC），SEAM-V 在 17 种代表性计算内核配置上的加速比几何平均值为 1.38 倍。其单元总面积增加 4.29%，运行功耗的几何平均值增加 17.30%，任务能耗降低 12.70%。
innovation: 1. 结合任务级解耦、本地指令供给和 VLIW 式打包，形成连续的执行包流；2. 在执行包形成和请求串行化时保留预取意图与对应加载操作的关联，实现与请求绑定的预取；3. 根据各向量通道的源操作数读取完成状态提前解除纯 WAR 依赖，其余依赖仍由常规机制管理。

title: Pattern-Guided Design Space Exploration for FPGA Accelerator Design
abstract: High-level synthesis (HLS) raises the abstraction level of FPGA accelerator design from hardware description languages to C/C++, but high-quality results still depend on schedule decisions such as pipelining, unrolling, tiling, reordering, and buffering. These decisions create a combinatorial design space, while many numerical kernels exhibit recurring computation patterns that suggest different optimization strategies. This paper presents PATTERNDSE, a lightweight pattern-guided design space exploration (DSE) framework for FPGA kernels written in Allo, a scheduling-oriented HLS programming system. PATTERNDSE maps recurring computation patterns, including elementwise maps, reductions, matrix-vector operations, matrix-matrix operations, and stencil-like updates, to compact schedule spaces. It then applies candidate schedules, validates functional correctness through LLVM execution, checks HLS C code generation, and uses a simple pattern-aware estimator to rank candidates before Vitis HLS synthesis. We evaluate PATTERNDSE on six representative kernels: vecadd, axpy, dot, matvec, gemm, and jacobi2d. Compared with an exhaustive-lite baseline, pattern-guided DSE reduces the number of HLS-evaluated candidates from 140 to 29, achieving a 4.83x overall search reduction and up to 12.0x reduction for individual kernels. Across all evaluated kernels, PATTERNDSE recovers the same best valid Vitis HLS latency as the exhaustive-lite baseline, demonstrating that computation-pattern information can prune unproductive schedule combinations while preserving high-quality HLS outcomes.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 高层次综合（HLS）将 FPGA 加速器设计的抽象层次从硬件描述语言提升到 C/C++，但高质量的综合结果仍依赖流水化、循环展开、分块、重排序和缓冲等调度决策。这些决策构成了一个组合设计空间，而许多数值计算内核具有反复出现的计算模式，可据此选择不同的优化策略。本文提出 PATTERNDSE，一种轻量级的模式引导设计空间探索（DSE）框架，适用于使用面向调度的 HLS 编程系统 Allo 编写的 FPGA 内核。PATTERNDSE 将逐元素映射、归约、矩阵–向量运算、矩阵–矩阵运算和类模板（stencil）更新等常见计算模式映射到紧凑的调度空间。随后，框架应用候选调度，通过 LLVM 执行验证功能正确性，检查 HLS C 代码生成，并在 Vitis HLS 综合之前使用一个考虑计算模式的简单估算器对候选方案排序。我们在 6 个代表性内核上评估了 PATTERNDSE，包括 vecadd、axpy、dot、matvec、gemm 和 jacobi2d。与简化穷举基线相比，模式引导的 DSE 将需经 HLS 评估的候选方案数从 140 个降至 29 个，整体搜索规模缩减至基线的 1/4.83，单个内核的最大缩减倍数为 12.0。在所有评估内核上，PATTERNDSE 获得的有效方案的最优 Vitis HLS 延迟均与简化穷举基线相同，表明计算模式信息可以剪除无效益的调度组合，同时保持高质量的 HLS 结果。
takeaway: 在 6 个代表性 FPGA 内核上，相较于简化穷举基线，PATTERNDSE 将 HLS 评估的候选方案数从 140 个降至 29 个，单个内核的搜索规模最多缩减至基线的 1/12.0。所有内核的有效方案均达到与基线相同的最优 Vitis HLS 延迟。
innovation: 1. 将常见计算模式映射到紧凑的 Allo 调度空间；2. 应用候选调度，通过 LLVM 执行验证功能正确性并检查 HLS C 代码生成；3. 在 Vitis HLS 综合前，利用考虑计算模式的简单估算器对候选方案排序。

title: Residual GPU Cache State on Apple M4 Pro
abstract: Apple silicon exposes unified CPU-GPU memory, but the cache state left after a completed GPU command is not documented. This paper characterizes that phase boundary on a 14-core Apple M4 Pro. We validate the measurement pipeline against unmodified STREAM 5.10 and BabelStream 5.0, then adapt an 8192-byte system-level-cache occupancy pattern to a synchronized Metal experiment. A GPU kernel touches 0 to 512 MiB and finishes before a 16 MiB CPU probe begins. The first CPU traversal is slower after large GPU footprints, while a second traversal removes most of the cost, showing residual shared-cache displacement rather than simultaneous DRAM contention. A separate matched-block experiment measures GPU slowdown under high-priority CPU traffic and finds background QoS close to baseline. Root PMU measurements and public IOReport histograms provide hardware grounding: they distinguish L1D refill sectors from software cache-line size, expose page-offset-dependent conflict behavior, and separate performance-core, efficiency-core, and AGX demand. The results identify a reproducible post-GPU cache-displacement window on M4 Pro and quantify a simple one-pass software recovery mechanism.
abstract_cn: Apple 芯片提供 CPU 与 GPU 统一内存，但文档未说明 GPU 命令执行完成后残留的缓存状态。本文在配备 14 核 CPU 的 Apple M4 Pro 上表征 GPU 执行结束前后的这一阶段边界。我们先使用未经修改的 STREAM 5.10 和 BabelStream 5.0 验证测量流程，再将一种以 8192 字节为单位的系统级缓存占用模式改用于同步执行的 Metal 实验。GPU 内核访问的内存范围大小为 0 至 512 MiB，并在 CPU 开始探测 16 MiB 数据之前执行完毕。GPU 访存占用较大时，CPU 的第一次遍历变慢，而第二次遍历消除了大部分额外开销。结合 GPU 和 CPU 访问在时间上分离这一条件，结果表明，减速源于 GPU 执行后残留的共享缓存数据逐出效应。另一个采用匹配数据块的实验测量了高优先级 CPU 流量下 GPU 的减速情况，并发现 CPU 流量处于后台服务质量（QoS）等级时，GPU 性能接近基线。以 root 权限进行的性能监控单元（PMU）测量和公开的 IOReport 直方图提供了硬件层面的证据。这些数据区分了 L1 数据缓存（L1D）的回填扇区与软件侧的缓存行大小，揭示了随页内偏移变化的冲突行为，并区分了性能核、能效核和 AGX GPU 各自的访问需求。研究结果在 M4 Pro 上识别出一个可复现的 GPU 执行后共享缓存逐出效应窗口，并量化了一种只需遍历一次的软件恢复机制。
takeaway: 在配备 14 核 CPU 的 Apple M4 Pro 上，大访存占用的 GPU 内核执行完毕后，CPU 对 16 MiB 数据的首次遍历仍会变慢，第二次遍历可消除大部分额外开销。GPU 与 CPU 访问在时间上分离，表明减速来自残留的共享缓存逐出效应。
innovation: 1. 将系统级缓存占用模式用于同步 Metal 实验，在 GPU 完成后通过两次 CPU 遍历表征残留缓存效应并量化单遍恢复机制；2. 采用匹配数据块实验测量 CPU 流量对 GPU 的减速影响；3. 结合 root 权限下的 PMU 测量和公开的 IOReport 直方图，分析缓存回填粒度、页内偏移相关冲突和不同硬件单元的访问需求。

title: DxPTA: An Architecture Design Space Exploration with Optical Dataflow-guided Strategy for HW/SW Co-Design of Photonic Transformer Accelerators
abstract: Transformer-based networks have emerged as prominent AI models with state-of-the-art performance, which potentially pave the way toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). However, their large sizes still hinder their efficient implementation, thus highlighting the need for alternate solutions to enable their energy-efficient acceleration. Recently, state-of-the-art works propose photonic transformer accelerators (PTAs) with significant speedup and energy efficiency improvements over the conventional electronic accelerators. However, their PTA architectures are developed without considering the application constraints (e.g., area, power, energy, and latency). Moreover, their manual design approach also requires huge design time to determine a suitable architecture for the targeted application, hence making this approach not scalable. To address these limitations, we propose DxPTA, a novel design space exploration methodology for enabling efficient hardware/software co-design of the appropriate PTA architecture that meets all constraints. It is achieved by (1) identifying the PTA architecture parameters based on the coherent optical dataflow; (2) analyzing the impact/significance of the parameters; and (3) leveraging this analysis for devising a constraint-aware architecture search algorithm. Experimental results show that, our DxPTA can find the appropriate PTA architectures for different transformer-based models (i.e., DeiT-T/S/B and BERT-B/L). It achieves up to 26mm^2 area, 4.8W power, 39mJ energy, and 6ms latency, for constraints of 50mm^2 area, 5W power, 50mJ energy, and 10ms latency; with 15.2x faster searching time than the exhaustive approach. These results demonstrate the potential of DxPTA methodology for enabling efficient PTA designs for diverse AGI-based applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 基于 Transformer 的网络已成为一类重要的 AI 模型，性能达到当前先进水平，并有望为实现通用人工智能（AGI）铺平道路。然而，模型规模庞大，仍制约其高效实现，因此需要其他方案来实现高能效加速。近期的先进研究提出了光子 Transformer 加速器（PTA），相较于传统电子加速器显著提高了速度和能效。然而，这些研究在设计 PTA 架构时未考虑应用的面积、功耗、能耗和延迟等约束。其手工设计方法还需要投入大量设计时间，为目标应用确定合适的架构，因而难以扩展。为解决这些问题，我们提出 DxPTA，一种新的设计空间探索方法，用于高效开展软硬件协同设计，选出满足全部约束的 PTA 架构。该方法包含 3 个步骤。首先，基于相干光数据流识别 PTA 架构参数。其次，分析各参数的影响及其重要性。最后，利用分析结果设计能够考虑约束的架构搜索算法。实验结果表明，DxPTA 能够为不同的 Transformer 模型（DeiT-T/S/B 和 BERT-B/L）找到合适的 PTA 架构。在面积、功耗、能耗和延迟上限分别为 50 mm²、5 W、50 mJ 和 10 ms 的约束下，所得设计的相应指标可达到 26 mm²、4.8 W、39 mJ 和 6 ms，搜索速度为穷举法的 15.2 倍。这些结果显示，DxPTA 有望为多种基于 AGI 的应用实现高效的 PTA 设计。
takeaway: DxPTA 能为 DeiT-T/S/B 和 BERT-B/L 找到满足约束的 PTA 架构。在面积、功耗、能耗和延迟上限分别为 50 mm²、5 W、50 mJ 和 10 ms 时，所得设计的相应指标可达到 26 mm²、4.8 W、39 mJ 和 6 ms，搜索速度为穷举法的 15.2 倍。
innovation: 1. 基于相干光数据流识别光子 Transformer 加速器的架构参数；2. 分析这些架构参数的影响及其重要性；3. 利用参数分析结果构建考虑应用约束的架构搜索算法，以支持软硬件协同设计。

title: A PVT-Resilient Subthreshold SRAM-Based In-Memory Computing Accelerator with In-Situ Regulation for Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: This paper presents a PVT-resilient, subthreshold SRAM-based computing-in-memory (CIM) macro tailored for energy-efficient spiking neural networks (SNNs). The macro integrates in-situ current sensors and distributed voltage regulators to enable robust large-scale (1024 wordlines, 1304 bitlines and 128 shared neuron cells) subthreshold current-mode CIM, mitigating energy overheads and process-voltage-temperature (PVT) sensitivity. The neuron cells adopt a programmable, memory cell-based firing threshold to enhance neuron robustness against PVT variations. The architecture uses a stride-tick batching schedule to significantly reduce buffer overhead with enhanced input data reuse. Exploiting the high sparsity of SNNs, the proposed system demonstrates significant improvements in energy efficiency and variation tolerance. Fabricated in 28-nm CMOS, the prototype attains 93.64\% accuracy on keyword spotting, delivers up to 1181.42 TOPS/W, and achieves 7.24 TOPS/mm^2, demonstrating a viable and efficient solution for high-performance edge SNN processing.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 本文提出一种面向高能效脉冲神经网络（SNN）的亚阈值 SRAM 存内计算（CIM）宏单元，可耐受工艺、电压和温度（PVT）变化。该宏单元集成原位电流传感器和分布式电压调节器，在由 1024 条字线、1304 条位线和 128 个共享神经元单元组成的大规模阵列中实现稳健的亚阈值电流模式存内计算，降低能耗开销及对 PVT 变化的敏感性。神经元单元采用基于存储单元的可编程发放阈值，以提高对 PVT 变化的耐受性。该架构采用按步幅组织时间步的批处理调度，提高输入数据复用率，并显著降低缓冲开销。所提系统利用 SNN 的高稀疏性，显著提高了能效和对变化的耐受能力。采用 28 nm CMOS 工艺制造的原型在关键词识别任务上达到 93.64% 的准确率，能效最高达 1181.42 TOPS/W，面积效率达 7.24 TOPS/mm²，表明该方案可用于高性能、高能效的边缘 SNN 处理。
takeaway: 采用 28 nm CMOS 工艺制造的亚阈值 SRAM 存内计算原型通过原位调节提高了对 PVT 变化的耐受性，在关键词识别任务上达到 93.64% 的准确率，能效最高达 1181.42 TOPS/W，面积效率达 7.24 TOPS/mm²。
innovation: （1）在亚阈值电流模式 SRAM 存内计算宏单元中集成原位电流传感器与分布式电压调节器，实现大规模稳健计算；（2）为神经元单元设计基于存储单元的可编程发放阈值，提高对 PVT 变化的耐受性；（3）采用按步幅组织时间步的批处理调度，提高输入数据复用率并降低缓冲开销。

title: Evaluating Computing Platforms for Sustainability: A Comparative Analysis of FPGAs against ASICs, GPUs, and CPUs
abstract: Climate change concerns emphasize the need for sustainable computing. Modeling the carbon footprint (CFP), including operational and embodied CFP from semiconductor use, manufacture and design, is essential. Field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) stand out as promising platforms due to their reconfigurability across various applications, enabling the amortization of embodied CFP across multiple applications. This paper introduces GreenFPGA, a tool estimating the total CFP of FPGAs over their lifespan, considering uncertainties in CFP modeling. It accounts for CFP during design, manufacturing, reconfigurability (reuse), operation, disposal, testing, and recycling. GreenFPGA identifies deployment regimes in which FPGAs can be more sustainable than ASICs, GPUs, and CPUs under the modeled iso-performance assumptions. Experimental results highlight the importance of analyzing applications across different computing platforms to assess their CFP while varying parameters such as application type, lifetime, usage time, and volume impact their total CFP. Across the evaluated pairwise iso-performance case studies with ASICs, GPUs, and CPUs, FPGAs can be more sustainable under specific deployment regimes involving frequently changing, diverse workloads and low-volume applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 对气候变化的担忧凸显了发展可持续计算的必要性。对碳足迹（CFP）建模至关重要，建模范围包括半导体使用、制造和设计所涉及的运行碳足迹与隐含碳足迹。现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）可以针对不同应用重新配置，使隐含碳足迹分摊到多个应用上，因此是有潜力的可持续计算平台。本文介绍 GreenFPGA，该工具在考虑碳足迹建模不确定性的情况下，估算 FPGA 全生命周期的总碳足迹，涵盖设计、制造、重配置（复用）、运行、处置、测试和回收。GreenFPGA 在模型所设定的等性能假设下，识别 FPGA 可能比 ASIC、GPU 和 CPU 更具可持续性的部署情景。实验结果表明，评估应用的碳足迹时，有必要跨计算平台开展分析，因为应用类型、使用寿命、使用时长和部署规模等参数的变化都会影响总碳足迹。在 FPGA 分别与 ASIC、GPU 和 CPU 进行的等性能案例比较中，对于负载多样且频繁变化、应用部署量较低等特定部署情景，FPGA 可能更具可持续性。
takeaway: 在所评估的等性能案例中，对于负载多样且频繁变化、应用部署量较低的特定部署情景，FPGA 可能比作为对照的 ASIC、GPU 或 CPU 具有更低的全生命周期碳足迹。
innovation: （1）提出 GreenFPGA，在考虑建模不确定性的情况下估算 FPGA 全生命周期碳足迹，并将重配置带来的跨应用复用纳入模型；（2）在等性能假设下，将 FPGA 与 ASIC、GPU 和 CPU 逐一比较，识别 FPGA 可能更具可持续性的部署情景。

title: A Comparative Analysis of ARM and x86-64 Laptop-Class Processors: Architecture, Assembly-Level Performance, and Energy Efficiency
abstract: ARM-based and x86-64 laptop processors differ not only in instruction-set design, but also in memory hierarchy, core organization, system integration, and power-management mechanisms. This study presents a combined architectural and experimental comparison of an Apple M3 system and an AMD Ryzen 7 3750H system. The architectural analysis contrasts AArch64's fixed-width load-store design with the variable-length, memory-operand-rich x86-64 instruction model, and discusses how register organization, calling conventions, heterogeneous core organization, memory behavior, and low-power mechanisms shape observed performance and energy characteristics. The experimental part uses two native assembly benchmarks: a recursive Fibonacci workload and an integer matrix-multiplication workload. The analysis combines repeated timing measurements, processor-energy measurements, and cross-platform microarchitectural counter measurements from matched portable-C profiling runs. The Ryzen platform is decisively faster on the branch-heavy Fibonacci benchmark, while matrix multiplication shows no meaningful timing advantage for either platform in the present measurements. In contrast, the Apple platform is markedly more energy-efficient, reducing energy-to-solution by approximately 5.82$\times$ on Fibonacci and 6.38$\times$ on matrix multiplication. These results are interpreted as platform-level findings rather than as pure ISA-only effects, reflecting differences in implementation, system integration, and measurement methodology in addition to instruction-set structure.
abstract_cn: 基于 ARM 和 x86-64 的笔记本处理器在指令集设计、存储层次、核心组织、系统集成和功耗管理机制等方面均存在差异。本研究结合架构分析与实验，对比搭载 Apple M3 和 AMD Ryzen 7 3750H 的两套系统。架构分析对比了 AArch64 采用定长指令的加载／存储架构与 x86-64 采用变长指令、广泛支持内存操作数的指令模型，并讨论寄存器组织、调用约定、异构核心组织、内存访问行为和低功耗机制如何影响观测到的性能与能耗特征。实验使用两项原生汇编基准，分别为递归斐波那契计算与整数矩阵乘法。分析综合了重复计时、处理器能耗测量，以及在两平台上通过相互匹配的可移植 C 语言性能分析运行获得的微架构计数器测量数据。对于分支密集的斐波那契基准，Ryzen 平台明显更快。在本次测量中，矩阵乘法在两平台上的运行时间没有明显差异。Apple 平台的能效明显更高，完成斐波那契计算和矩阵乘法所需的能量分别约为 Ryzen 平台的 1/5.82 和 1/6.38。研究将这些结果归因于平台层面的综合差异，涉及指令集结构、具体实现、系统集成及测量方法。
takeaway: 在 Apple M3 与 AMD Ryzen 7 3750H 的原生汇编基准对比中，Ryzen 在分支密集的递归斐波那契测试中明显更快，两平台在整数矩阵乘法中的运行时间无明显差异。Apple 平台完成这两项计算所需的能量分别约为 Ryzen 的 1/5.82 和 1/6.38，这些结果反映的是平台层面的差异。
innovation: （1）结合架构分析与跨平台实验对比 Apple M3 和 AMD Ryzen 7 3750H，采用两项原生汇编基准开展重复计时和处理器能耗测量，并通过相互匹配的可移植 C 语言性能分析运行获取微架构计数器数据。

title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
abstract: Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving. Current systems suffer from three compounding inefficiencies: (1) the absence of unified KV cache sizing across all attention architectures--particularly multi-head latent attention (MLA), which is unsupported in general-purpose frameworks, resulting in up to 57x memory over-provisioning; (2) confinement of KV cache to a single memory tier (GPU HBM) despite the availability of a rich hierarchy spanning CPU DRAM, CXL-attached memory, NVMe via GPUDirect Storage, RDMA fabric, and parallel filesystems; and (3) reactive eviction policies that discard reusable state, forcing redundant recomputation. We present a unified system addressing all three. Our architecture-variant-aware sizing engine computes exact memory requirements per attention type; the resulting batch size gain reaches 7.4x for the one MLA model we evaluate (DeepSeek-V3), while the three GQA models see 1.0x, 1.0x, and 0.7x, so the GQA benefit is fleet-wide unified sizing rather than larger per-model batches. A six-tier memory hierarchy extends effective KV cache capacity from 40 GB to over 38 TB per node while maintaining sub-millisecond time-to-first-token (TTFT) for hot entries. A Bayesian reuse predictor with Beta conjugate priors over 16 (block-type, transition-type) pairs drives EMA-scored head-granular eviction and RoPE-aware prefetching.
