Component-level validation on trace replay using ShareGPT, LMSYS-Chat-1M, and agentic workloads demonstrates 70-84% cache hit rates. Analytical projections combining validated component behavior with published hardware specifications indicate TTFT reductions of 1.4x to 2.1x, throughput improvements of 1.7x to 2.9x, and 47% cost reduction relative to published baselines; these cluster-scale projections are analytical and carry no error bars.
abstract_cn: 键值（KV）缓存的内存管理是制约大规模 GPU 推理服务吞吐量与成本效益的主要瓶颈。现有系统存在 3 个相互叠加的低效因素。（1）缺乏覆盖所有注意力架构的统一 KV 缓存容量核算方法，尤其是通用框架不支持多头潜在注意力（MLA）的容量核算，可导致内存配置量最高达到实际需求的 57 倍。（2）KV 缓存局限于 GPU 高带宽内存（HBM）这一单一层级，尽管系统可用的存储层次还包括 CPU DRAM、CXL 挂接内存、通过 GPUDirect Storage 访问的 NVMe 存储、RDMA 网络及并行文件系统。（3）反应式淘汰策略丢弃可复用状态，导致冗余重计算。本文提出一个统一系统，同时解决这 3 个问题。该系统的容量核算引擎能够区分注意力架构变体，精确计算每种注意力类型的内存需求。对于评估中唯一的 MLA 模型 DeepSeek-V3，批大小达到原来的 7.4 倍。3 个分组查询注意力（GQA）模型的批大小则分别为原来的 1.0 倍、1.0 倍和 0.7 倍，因此 GQA 的收益体现在整个部署集群可以统一核算容量。六层存储体系将每个节点的有效 KV 缓存容量从 40 GB 扩展至 38 TB 以上，同时将热点条目的首词元延迟（TTFT）保持在 1 ms 以下。贝叶斯复用预测器针对 16 种（块类型，转换类型）组合使用 Beta 共轭先验，驱动基于指数移动平均（EMA）评分的注意力头级淘汰和考虑旋转位置编码（RoPE）的预取。基于 ShareGPT、LMSYS-Chat-1M 及智能体工作负载的轨迹回放进行组件级验证，得到 70%–84% 的缓存命中率。结合经验证的组件行为与公开硬件规格进行解析推算，相较于已发表的基线，TTFT 降至基线的 1/1.4 至 1/2.1，吞吐量达到基线的 1.7–2.9 倍，成本降低 47%。这些集群级结果来自解析推算，且没有误差条。
takeaway: 六层存储体系将单节点有效 KV 缓存容量从 40 GB 扩至 38 TB 以上，同时保持热点条目的首词元延迟低于 1 ms，组件级轨迹回放的缓存命中率为 70%–84%。相较已发表的基线，集群级解析推算给出的吞吐量为基线的 1.7–2.9 倍、成本降低 47%，推算结果没有误差条。
innovation: （1）设计可区分注意力架构变体的容量核算引擎，精确计算各类注意力的 KV 缓存需求；（2）构建横跨 6 个存储层级的 KV 缓存体系，在扩展有效容量的同时维持热点条目的低首词元延迟；（3）针对 16 种（块类型，转换类型）组合使用 Beta 共轭先验进行贝叶斯复用预测，驱动基于 EMA 评分的注意力头级淘汰及考虑 RoPE 的预取。

title: GEN-Graph: Heterogeneous PIM Accelerator for General Computational Patterns in Graph-based Dynamic Programming
abstract:
While graph-based dynamic programming (DP) is a cornerstone of genomics and network analytics, its efficiency is hampered by fundamentally conflicting computational patterns. Matrix-centric DP drives regular, compute-bound network analytics, while topology-centric DP handles irregular, memory-bound genomic traversals. These two categories of DP have substantially different computation patterns and dataflows, which makes it difficult for a single homogeneous processing-in-memory (PIM) architecture to efficiently support both.
  This work presents GEN-Graph, a novel heterogeneous PIM chiplet that integrates two types of specialized compute tiles within a 2.5D package: Matrix-tile, a processing-using-memory (PUM) tile optimized for matrix-centric workloads, such as all-pairs shortest path (APSP); and traversal-tile, a processing-near-memory (PNM) tile optimized for traversal-centric DP workloads, such as DNA sequence alignment. Our hardware-software co-design employs recursive partitioning and reconfigurable windowed bit-parallel logic to ensure exact computation. Results show the matrix tile achieves 42.8x speedup and 392x energy efficiency over the NVIDIA H100 GPU for APSP. For sequence-to-graph alignment, the traversal tile sustains 2.56 million reads/s (short-reads) and 39.3 thousand reads/s (long-reads), outperforming state-of-the-art accelerators by up to 2.56x in throughput. GEN-Graph provides the first scalable, exact solution for general DP dataflows by matching hardware specialization to algorithmic structure.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
基于图的动态规划（DP）是基因组学与网络分析的基础，但两类计算模式的需求存在根本冲突，制约了其执行效率。以矩阵为中心的 DP 面向规则、受计算性能制约的网络分析，以拓扑为中心的 DP 则处理不规则、受内存性能制约的基因组图遍历。两类 DP 的计算模式和数据流差异显著，单一同构存内处理（PIM）架构难以同时高效支持两者。

本文提出 GEN-Graph，这是一种异构 PIM 芯粒，在 2.5D 封装中集成两种专用计算单元。Matrix-tile 是利用存储器进行计算（PUM）的单元，针对全源最短路径（APSP）等以矩阵为中心的负载优化。traversal-tile 是近存处理（PNM）单元，针对 DNA 序列比对等以遍历为中心的 DP 负载优化。该软硬件协同设计采用递归划分和可重构的窗口化位并行逻辑，确保计算结果精确。结果表明，在 APSP 任务上，Matrix-tile 相比 NVIDIA H100 GPU 实现 42.8 倍加速，能效达到其 392 倍。在序列到图比对任务中，traversal-tile 对短读段和长读段分别维持 256 万读段/秒和 3.93 万读段/秒的吞吐量，最高达到现有最先进加速器的 2.56 倍。GEN-Graph 将硬件专用化与算法结构相匹配，提供了首个面向通用 DP 数据流的可扩展精确计算方案。
takeaway: GEN-Graph 通过异构存内处理支持两类图动态规划数据流的精确计算。在 APSP 上，Matrix-tile 相比 NVIDIA H100 GPU 实现 42.8 倍加速，能效达到其 392 倍，序列到图比对的吞吐量最高达到现有最先进加速器的 2.56 倍。
innovation: （1）在 2.5D 封装中集成异构 PIM 计算单元，分别以利用存储器计算的 Matrix-tile 和近存处理的 traversal-tile 支持矩阵型与遍历型动态规划负载；（2）通过软硬件协同设计，将递归划分与可重构的窗口化位并行逻辑结合，保证计算精确性。

title: Rethinking Compute Substrates for 3D-Stacked Near-Memory LLM Decoding: Microarchitecture-Scheduling Co-Design
abstract: Large language model (LLM) decoding is a major inference bottleneck because its low arithmetic intensity makes performance highly sensitive to memory bandwidth. 3D-stacked near-memory processing (NMP) provides substantially higher local memory bandwidth than conventional off-chip interfaces, making it a promising substrate for decode acceleration. However, our analysis shows that this bandwidth advantage also shifts many decode operators on 3D-stacked NMP back into the compute-bound regime. Under the tight area budget of the logic die, the design of the compute substrate itself therefore becomes a first-order challenge. Therefore, we rethink the compute microarchitecture of prior 3D-stacked NMP designs. First, we replace prior MAC tree-based compute units with a more area-efficient systolic array, and we further observe that decode operators exhibit substantial shape diversity, making reconfigurability in both systolic array shape and dataflow essential for sustaining high utilization. Building on this insight, we continue to exploit two key opportunities: the high local memory bandwidth reduces the need for large on-chip buffers, and the existing vector core, originally designed to handle auxiliary tensor computations, already provides much of the control logic and multi-ported buffering required for fine-grained flexibility for systolic array, allowing us to unify the two structures in a highly area-efficient manner. Based on these insights, we present the first compute microarchitecture tailored to 3D-stacked NMP LLM decoding, explicitly designed to satisfy the joint requirements of low area cost, high-bandwidth operation, and fine-grained reconfigurability. We further propose an multi-core scheduling framework. Compared with Stratum, our design achieves an average 2.91x speedup and 2.40x higher energy efficiency across both dense and MoE models.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）解码是推理的主要瓶颈之一。由于算术强度低，解码性能对内存带宽高度敏感。3D 堆叠近存处理（NMP）提供的本地内存带宽远高于传统片外接口，因此有望用于加速解码。然而，我们的分析表明，这一带宽优势也使 3D 堆叠 NMP 上的许多解码算子重新受限于计算性能。在逻辑裸片面积预算紧张的情况下，计算架构本身的设计因此成为首要挑战。为此，我们重新审视了已有 3D 堆叠 NMP 设计的计算微架构。首先，我们用面积效率更高的脉动阵列替代以往基于乘累加（MAC）树的计算单元。我们进一步发现，解码算子的形状差异显著，因此，脉动阵列的形状和数据流均需支持重构，才能维持高利用率。基于这一认识，我们进一步利用两个条件。其一，本地内存带宽较高，降低了对大容量片上缓冲区的需求。其二，原用于处理辅助张量计算的向量核已经具备脉动阵列实现细粒度灵活性所需的大部分控制逻辑和多端口缓冲资源，使两种结构能够以很高的面积效率合为一体。据此，我们提出首个面向 3D 堆叠 NMP 上 LLM 解码的计算微架构，专门设计以同时满足低面积开销、高带宽运行和细粒度可重构性的要求。我们还提出了一个多核调度框架。与 Stratum 相比，我们的设计在涵盖稠密模型和混合专家（MoE）模型的评估中实现了平均 2.91 倍的加速和 2.40 倍的能效。
takeaway: 3D 堆叠 NMP 的高本地内存带宽使许多 LLM 解码算子转为计算受限。与 Stratum 相比，采用可重构脉动阵列、向量核融合及多核调度的设计，在涵盖稠密和 MoE 模型的评估中实现了平均 2.91 倍的加速和 2.40 倍的能效。
innovation: 1. 用面积效率更高的脉动阵列替代基于 MAC 树的计算单元，并支持阵列形状和数据流的细粒度重构；2. 利用高本地内存带宽降低对大容量片上缓冲的需求，复用现有向量核的控制逻辑和多端口缓冲，将向量核与脉动阵列融合；3. 提出多核调度框架。

title: MINISA: Minimal Instruction Set Architecture for Next-gen Reconfigurable Inference Accelerator
abstract: Modern reconfigurable AI accelerators rely on rich mapping and data-layout flexibility to sustain high utilization across matrix multiplication, convolution, and emerging applications beyond AI. However, exposing this flexibility through fine-grained micro-control results in prohibitive control overhead of fetching configuration bits from off-chip memory. This paper presents MINISA, a minimal instruction set that programs a reconfigurable accelerator at the granularity of Virtual Neurons (VNs), the coarsest control granularity that retains flexibility of hardware and the finest granularity that avoids unnecessary control costs. First, we introduce FEATHER+, a modest refinement of FEATHER, that eliminates redundant on-chip replication needed for runtime dataflow/layout co-switching and supports dynamic cases where input and weight data are unavailable before execution for offline layout manipulation. MINISA then abstracts control of FEATHER+ into three layout-setting instructions for input, weight, and output VNs and a single mapping instruction for setting dataflow. This reduces the control and instruction footprint while preserving the legal mapping and layout space supported by the FEATHER+. Our results show that MINISA reduces geometric mean off-chip instruction traffic by factors ranging from 35x to (4x10^5)x under various sizes under 50 GEMM workloads spanning AI (GPT-oss), FHE, and ZKP. This eliminates instruction-fetch stalls that consume 96.9% of micro-instruction cycles, yielding up to 31.6x end-to-end speedup for 16x256 FEATHER+. Our code: https://github.com/maeri-project/FEATHER/tree/main/minisa.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 现代可重构 AI 加速器依靠灵活的映射和数据布局，在矩阵乘法、卷积及 AI 之外的新兴应用中保持较高的利用率。然而，通过细粒度微控制提供这种灵活性，需要从片外内存读取配置位，控制开销高到难以承受。本文提出精简指令集 MINISA，以虚拟神经元（VN）为粒度对可重构加速器进行编程。这是能够保留硬件灵活性的最粗控制粒度，也是能够避免不必要控制开销的最细粒度。首先，我们提出 FEATHER+，对 FEATHER 做了小幅改进，消除了运行时联合切换数据流和布局所需的冗余片上数据副本，并支持输入和权重数据在执行前无法取得、因而无法离线调整布局的动态情形。随后，MINISA 将 FEATHER+ 的控制抽象为 3 条布局设置指令和 1 条映射指令，前者分别设置输入、权重和输出 VN 的布局，后者设置数据流。这缩减了控制和指令开销，同时保留了 FEATHER+ 支持的合法映射与布局空间。实验涵盖来自 AI（GPT-oss）、全同态加密（FHE）和零知识证明（ZKP）的 50 个通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）工作负载。在不同规模配置下，按几何平均计算的片外指令流量降至原来的 1/35 至 1/(4 × 10⁵)。这一改进消除了占用微指令周期 96.9% 的取指停顿，使 16 × 256 规模的 FEATHER+ 实现最高 31.6 倍的端到端加速。代码见 https://github.com/maeri-project/FEATHER/tree/main/minisa。
takeaway: 在来自 AI（GPT-oss）、FHE 和 ZKP 的 50 个 GEMM 工作负载上，MINISA 在不同规模配置下将片外指令流量的几何平均值降至微指令控制下的 1/35 至 1/(4 × 10⁵)。消除原先占微指令周期 96.9% 的取指停顿后，16 × 256 的 FEATHER+ 获得最高 31.6 倍的端到端加速。
innovation: 1. 提出 FEATHER+，消除运行时联合切换数据流和布局所需的冗余片上数据副本，并支持执行前无法取得输入和权重数据的动态情形；2. 提出以虚拟神经元为控制粒度的 MINISA，用 3 条指令分别设置输入、权重和输出 VN 的布局，并用 1 条映射指令设置数据流，同时保留 FEATHER+ 支持的合法映射与布局空间。

title: Interconnect-Aware Logic Resynthesis for Multi-Die FPGAs
abstract: Multi-die FPGAs enable device scaling beyond reticle limits but introduce severe interconnect overhead across die boundaries. Inter-die connections, commonly referred to as super-long lines (SLLs), incur high delay and consume scarce interposer interconnect resources, often dominating critical paths and complicating physical design. To address this, this work proposes an interconnect-aware logic resynthesis method that restructures the LUT-level netlist to reduce the number of SLLs. The resynthesis engine uses die partitioning information to apply logic resubstitutions, which simplifies local circuit structures and eliminates SLLs. By reducing the number of SLLs early in the design flow, prior to physical implementation, the proposed method shortens critical paths, alleviates pressure on scarce interposer interconnect resources, and improves overall physical design flexibility. We further build a tool flow for multi-die FPGAs by integrating the proposed resynthesis method with packing and placement. Experimental results on the EPFL benchmarks show that, compared with a state-of-the-art framework, the proposed method reduces the number of SLLs by up to 24.8% for a 2-die FPGA and up to 27.38% for a 3-die FPGA. On MCNC benchmarks, our tool flow achieves an average SLL reduction of 1.65% while preserving placement quality. On Koios benchmarks, where fewer removable SLLs exist, several designs still exhibit considerable inter-die edge reductions. Overall, the results confirm that reducing inter-die connections at the logic level is an effective approach for multi-die FPGAs.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 多裸片 FPGA 能够突破光刻掩模版的尺寸限制来扩展器件规模，但也会带来显著的跨裸片互连开销。裸片间连接通常称为超长线（SLL），其延迟较高，还会占用稀缺的中介层互连资源，往往主导关键路径延迟，并增加物理设计的难度。为此，本文提出一种互连感知的逻辑再综合方法，通过重构查找表（LUT）级网表减少 SLL 数量。再综合引擎利用裸片划分信息执行逻辑重代入，简化局部电路结构并消除部分 SLL。该方法在设计流程前期、物理实现之前减少 SLL 数量，从而缩短关键路径、缓解中介层互连资源紧张，并提高整体物理设计的灵活性。我们进一步将所提出的再综合方法与打包和布局集成，构建了面向多裸片 FPGA 的工具流程。EPFL 基准测试的结果表明，与一个最先进的框架相比，该方法在双裸片 FPGA 上最多减少 24.8% 的 SLL，在三裸片 FPGA 上最多减少 27.38% 的 SLL。在 MCNC 基准测试中，我们的工具流程在保持布局质量的同时平均减少了 1.65% 的 SLL。在可消除 SLL 较少的 Koios 基准测试中，仍有多个设计的跨裸片边数显著减少。总体而言，结果证实，在逻辑层面减少裸片间连接是多裸片 FPGA 的一种有效优化方法。
takeaway: 在 EPFL 基准测试中，与一个最先进的框架相比，互连感知逻辑再综合将双裸片和三裸片 FPGA 的 SLL 数量分别最多减少 24.8% 和 27.38%。在 MCNC 基准测试中，集成后的工具流程在保持布局质量的同时平均减少 1.65% 的 SLL。
innovation: 1. 提出互连感知的逻辑再综合方法，在物理实现前利用裸片划分信息对 LUT 级网表执行逻辑重代入，简化局部电路并减少超长线；2. 将再综合与打包和布局集成，构建面向多裸片 FPGA 的工具流程。

title: Performance Analysis of Edge and In-Sensor AI Processors: A Comparative Review
abstract: This review examines the rapidly evolving landscape of ultra-low-power edge processors, covering heterogeneous Systems-on-Chips (SoCs), neural accelerators, near-sensor and in-sensor architectures, and emerging dataflow and memory-centric designs. We categorize commercially available and research-grade platforms according to their compute paradigms, power envelopes, and memory hierarchies, and analyze their suitability for always-on and latency-critical Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads. To complement the architectural overview with empirical evidence, we benchmark a 336 million Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) segmentation model (PicoSAM2) on three representative processors: GAP9, leveraging a multi-core RISC-V architecture augmented with hardware accelerators; the STM32N6, which pairs an advanced ARM Cortex-M55 core with a dedicated neural architecture accelerator; and the Sony IMX500, representing in-sensor stacked-Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) compute. Collectively, these platforms span MCU-class, embedded neural accelerator, and in-sensor paradigms. The evaluation reports latency, inference efficiency, energy efficiency, and energy-delay product. The results show a clear divergence in hardware behavior, with the IMX500 achieving the highest utilization (86.2 MAC/cycle) and the lowest energy-delay product, highlighting the growing significance and technological maturity of in-sensor processing. GAP9 offers the best energy efficiency within microcontroller-class power budgets, and the STM32N6 provides the lowest raw latency at a significantly higher energy cost. Together, the review and benchmarks provide a unified view of the current design directions and practical trade-offs that are shaping the next generation of ultra-low-power and in-sensor AI processors.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 本文综述快速发展的超低功耗边缘处理器，涵盖异构片上系统（SoC）、神经网络加速器、近传感器与传感器内架构，以及新兴的数据流架构和以存储为中心的设计。我们按计算范式、功耗范围和存储层次对商用平台与研究平台进行分类，并分析它们对常开型和延迟敏感型人工智能（AI）工作负载的适用性。为给架构综述补充实测证据，我们在 3 款代表性处理器上对分割模型 PicoSAM2 进行基准测试，该模型需要 3.36 亿次乘累加（MAC）运算。GAP9 采用配有硬件加速器的多核 RISC-V 架构。STM32N6 将先进的 ARM Cortex-M55 核与专用神经网络加速器相结合。索尼 IMX500 则代表采用堆叠式互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）技术的传感器内计算。三者覆盖微控制器（MCU）级处理、嵌入式神经网络加速和传感器内计算等范式。评估报告了延迟、推理效率、能效和能量延迟积。结果显示，不同硬件的表现差异明显。IMX500 的利用率最高（86.2 MAC/周期），能量延迟积最低，凸显了传感器内处理日益重要的地位和技术成熟度。GAP9 在微控制器级功耗预算内的能效最高，STM32N6 的实测延迟最低，但能耗明显更高。综述与基准测试共同呈现了当前的设计方向及实际权衡，这些方向和权衡正在塑造下一代超低功耗 AI 处理器和传感器内 AI 处理器。
takeaway: 在 GAP9、STM32N6 和索尼 IMX500 上运行需要 3.36 亿次 MAC 运算的 PicoSAM2 分割模型时，IMX500 的利用率最高（86.2 MAC/周期），能量延迟积最低。GAP9 在微控制器级功耗预算内的能效最高，STM32N6 的延迟最低，但能耗明显更高。
innovation: 1. 按计算范式、功耗范围和存储层次对商用与研究平台进行分类，分析其对常开型和延迟敏感型 AI 工作负载的适用性；2. 在 GAP9、STM32N6 和索尼 IMX500 上使用同一 PicoSAM2 分割模型进行基准测试，对比延迟、推理效率、能效和能量延迟积。

title: Timing Fragility Aware Selective Hardening of RISCV Soft Processors on SRAM Based FPGAs
abstract: Selective hardening is widely employed to improve the reliability of FPGA based soft processors while limiting the overhead of full redundancy. However, existing approaches primarily rely on architectural criticality or functional fault analysis, overlooking the impact of routing dependent timing sensitivity on processor robustness. This paper introduces a timing fragility aware selective hardening methodology for RISCV soft processors implemented on SRAM based FPGAs. Building on recent advances in in situ timing observability, the proposed approach quantifies the statistical timing sensitivity of pipeline components under controlled routing perturbations and uses this information to guide hardening decisions. Experimental results on a RISCV processor implemented on a commercial FPGA platform show that components exhibiting higher timing fragility also demonstrate increased vulnerability to routing induced delay effects. Leveraging this correlation, the proposed selective hardening strategy achieves robustness comparable to full hardening while significantly reducing area and timing overhead. These results demonstrate that timing fragility provides a practical and effective metric for reliability aware design optimization in FPGA based processor architectures.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 选择性加固广泛用于提高基于 FPGA 的软处理器的可靠性，同时控制全冗余带来的开销。然而，已有方法主要依据体系结构关键性或功能故障分析，忽视了布线相关的时序敏感性对处理器鲁棒性的影响。本文提出一种时序脆弱性感知的选择性加固方法，适用于在基于 SRAM 的 FPGA 上实现的 RISC-V 软处理器。该方法利用近年来原位时序观测技术的进展，在受控布线扰动下量化流水线部件的统计时序敏感性，并据此决定加固哪些部件。在商用 FPGA 平台上实现的 RISC-V 处理器实验表明，时序脆弱性较高的部件也更容易受到布线引入的延迟影响。利用这一相关性，所提出的选择性加固策略实现了与全面加固相当的鲁棒性，同时显著降低了面积和时序开销。结果表明，时序脆弱性是一项实用且有效的指标，可用于面向可靠性的 FPGA 处理器架构设计优化。
takeaway: 在商用 FPGA 上实现的 RISC-V 处理器中，时序脆弱性较高的流水线部件更容易受到布线引入的延迟影响。依据这一指标进行选择性加固，可达到与全面加固相当的鲁棒性，同时显著降低面积和时序开销。
innovation: 1. 利用原位时序观测，在受控布线扰动下量化流水线部件的统计时序敏感性；2. 将时序脆弱性用作选择性加固的决策依据，确定基于 SRAM 的 FPGA 上的 RISC-V 软处理器需要加固的部件。

title: RISCBench: Benchmarking RISC-V Orchestration Efficiency in FPGA and FPGA-Like Computing Engines
abstract:
Heterogeneous systems increasingly rely on RISC-V cores as orchestration engines to manage data movement, synchronization, and scheduling across accelerators and reconfigurable fabrics. Conventional performance metrics, such as FLOPs, TOPS/W, or energy per operation, do not capture orchestration efficiency, even though it often dictates sustained system behavior. This gap is increasingly relevant as systems evolve toward tightly coupled heterogeneous fabrics and co-packaged accelerators, where control-plane behavior determines whether these platforms achieve their promised performance.
  We present RISCBench, a kernel benchmark suite and open methodology for quantifying orchestration efficiency. RISCBench introduces the Sustained Instantaneous Throughput (SIT) metric, which accumulates instantaneous throughput over near-aggregate execution intervals, capturing sustained efficiency beyond peak rates. The methodology is evaluated across representative platforms spanning soft and hard RISC-V orchestration engines, including FPGA-based prototyping and accelerator-class implementations. Results highlight synchronization and data residency driven tradeoffs that limit realized throughput beyond peak performance, motivating SIT as a practical, platform-independent descriptor for evaluating orchestration efficiency in heterogeneous systems and AI inference applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
异构系统越来越多地采用 RISC-V 核作为编排引擎，管理加速器与可重构结构之间的数据搬移、同步和调度。FLOPs、TOPS/W 和每次操作能耗等传统性能指标无法衡量编排效率，而编排效率往往决定系统持续运行时的表现。随着系统向紧耦合异构结构和协同封装的加速器演进，这一指标缺口愈发重要，因为控制面的行为决定了这些平台能否达到预期性能。

我们提出 RISCBench，这是一套用于量化编排效率的内核基准测试和开放评估方法。RISCBench 引入持续瞬时吞吐量（Sustained Instantaneous Throughput，SIT）指标，在接近完整执行过程的区间内累积瞬时吞吐量，以衡量峰值速率之外的持续运行效率。我们在采用软核和硬核 RISC-V 编排引擎的代表性平台上评估了该方法，覆盖基于 FPGA 的原型平台与加速器级实现。结果表明，同步和数据驻留带来的权衡制约了实际吞吐量，其影响无法仅凭峰值性能体现。这些结果支持将 SIT 作为一种实用且独立于平台的指标，用于评估异构系统及 AI 推理应用中的编排效率。
takeaway: 在涵盖 FPGA 原型和加速器级实现的软核、硬核 RISC-V 平台上，同步和数据驻留带来的权衡制约了实际吞吐量。SIT 通过累积接近完整执行过程的瞬时吞吐量，衡量峰值指标无法体现的持续运行效率。
innovation: 1. 提出 RISCBench 内核基准测试套件和量化编排效率的开放评估方法；2. 定义 SIT 指标，通过在接近完整执行过程的区间内累积瞬时吞吐量来衡量持续运行效率。

title: CHIME: Chiplet-based Heterogeneous Near-Memory Acceleration for Edge Multimodal LLM Inference
abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) is accelerating the integration of multimodal assistants into edge devices, where inference is executed under stringent latency and energy constraints, often exacerbated by intermittent connectivity. These challenges become particularly acute in the context of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), as high-dimensional visual inputs are transformed into extensive token sequences, thereby inflating the key-value (KV) cache and imposing substantial data movement overheads to the LLM backbone. To address these issues, we present CHIME, a chiplet-based heterogeneous near-memory acceleration for edge MLLMs inference. CHIME leverages the complementary strengths of integrated monolithic 3D (M3D) DRAM and RRAM chiplets: DRAM supplies low-latency bandwidth for attention, while RRAM offers dense, non-volatile storage for weights. This heterogeneous hardware is orchestrated by a co-designed mapping framework that executes fused kernels near data, minimizing cross-chiplet traffic to maximize effective bandwidth. On FastVLM (0.6B/1.7B) and MobileVLM (1.7B/3B), CHIME achieves up to 54x speedup and up to 246x better energy efficiency per inference as compared to the edge GPU NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It sustains 116.5-266.5 token/J compared to Jetson's 0.7-1.1 token/J. Furthermore, it delivers up to 69.2x higher throughput than the state-of-the-art PIM accelerator FACIL. Compared to the M3D DRAM-only design, CHIME's heterogeneous memory further improves energy efficiency by 7% and performance by 2.4x.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）的普及正加速多模态助手在边缘设备上的集成。这些设备上的推理面临严格的延迟与能耗约束，间歇性网络连接往往进一步加剧这些挑战。在多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中，这一问题尤为突出，因为高维视觉输入会被转换成长 token 序列，导致键值（KV）缓存膨胀，并给 LLM 主干网络带来大量数据搬移开销。为此，我们提出 CHIME，一种面向边缘端 MLLM 推理的基于芯粒的异构近存加速方案。CHIME 发挥集成的单片三维（M3D）DRAM 与 RRAM 芯粒的互补优势。DRAM 为注意力计算提供低延迟的带宽，RRAM 则为模型权重提供高密度、非易失存储。与硬件协同设计的映射框架负责编排这些异构资源，在数据附近执行融合内核，尽量减少跨芯粒流量并最大化有效带宽。在 FastVLM（0.6B、1.7B）和 MobileVLM（1.7B、3B）上，与边缘 GPU NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 相比，CHIME 的推理加速比最高为 54 倍，单次推理的能效最高为其 246 倍。CHIME 的持续能效为 116.5–266.5 token/J，Jetson 为 0.7–1.1 token/J。此外，相比当前先进的存内计算（PIM）加速器 FACIL，CHIME 的吞吐量最高为其 69.2 倍。与仅使用 M3D DRAM 的设计相比，CHIME 的异构存储使能效进一步提高 7%，性能达到其 2.4 倍。
takeaway: 在 FastVLM（0.6B、1.7B）和 MobileVLM（1.7B、3B）上，CHIME 相对 Jetson Orin NX 的推理加速比最高达 54 倍，单次推理能效最高为其 246 倍，持续能效分别为 116.5–266.5 和 0.7–1.1 token/J。其吞吐量最高为 FACIL 的 69.2 倍，相比仅使用 M3D DRAM 的设计，能效进一步提高 7%，性能达到其 2.4 倍。
innovation: 1. 设计基于芯粒的异构近存架构，由 M3D DRAM 为注意力计算提供低延迟的带宽，RRAM 提供高密度、非易失的权重存储；2. 协同设计映射框架，在数据附近执行融合内核，以减少跨芯粒流量并提高有效带宽。

title: Tri-Stack-PIM: A Heterogeneous Multi-Die 3D-Integrated Processing-in-Memory Architecture for Efficient LLM Inference
abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference during autoregressive decoding is fundamentally memory-bandwidth-bound. Existing three-dimensional (3D) stacked processing-in-memory (PIM) architectures alleviate the off-chip bandwidth wall, yet remain constrained by several limitations: physical layer (PHY), controllers, and direct memory access (DMA) engines compete with arithmetic units for advanced-node base-die area; hybrid-bonding keep-out zones fragment the base-die floorplan and impede physical design; compute tiles built in a dynamic random access memory (DRAM) process are restricted to low logic density, capping achievable throughput; and nonlinear operations offloaded to the host reintroduce a communication bottleneck. We present Tri-Stack-PIM, a heterogeneous three-die architecture that resolves these tensions by dedicating a top DRAM die to storage, a middle buffer die on a mature process node to PHYs, DMA engines, and near-memory compute units, and a bottom base die on an advanced node exclusively to single-instruction-multiple-data (SIMD) multiply-accumulate (MAC) arrays. We further introduce a Unified Buffer-Aware Ready-based (UBAR) hardware out-of-order micro-operation scheduler that enforces cross-die dependency correctness at runtime while maximizing issue-slot utilization through a multi-term priority function, recovering up to 90% of the cycles that an in-order policy would forfeit. A joint architecture-dataflow co-exploration identifies Pareto-optimal configurations that reduce the energy-delay product (EDP) by 33-66x over naive parameter selection. Evaluated across multi-head, grouped-query, and multi-query attention (MHA, GQA, MQA) mechanisms with batch sizes 1-32, Tri-Stack-PIM achieves geometric-mean speedups of 4.95x, 2.57x, and 1.68x across all three attention mechanisms and batch sizes over a graphics processing unit (GPU) baseline, AttAcc, and H2-LLM, respectively.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）推理的自回归解码阶段本质上受内存带宽限制。现有三维（3D）堆叠存内计算（PIM）架构缓解了片外带宽瓶颈，但仍面临多项限制。物理层（PHY）、控制器和直接内存访问（DMA）引擎与算术单元争夺先进工艺底层裸片的面积。混合键合禁布区割裂了底层裸片的布局，增加了物理设计难度。采用动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）工艺制造的计算单元受限于较低的逻辑密度，限制了可实现的吞吐量。将非线性运算卸载到主机也会重新引入通信瓶颈。我们提出 Tri-Stack-PIM，一种异构三裸片架构，以解决这些设计矛盾。顶层 DRAM 裸片专用于存储，中间层缓冲裸片采用成熟工艺，容纳 PHY、DMA 引擎和近存计算单元，底层裸片采用先进工艺，专用于单指令多数据（SIMD）乘加（MAC）阵列。我们进一步提出统一的缓冲区感知、基于就绪状态（UBAR）的硬件乱序微操作调度器。该调度器在运行时确保跨裸片依赖关系得到正确处理，并通过多项优先级函数最大化发射槽利用率，最多可挽回顺序发射策略原本会损失的 90% 周期。架构与数据流的联合探索找到了帕累托最优配置，使能量延迟积（EDP）降至朴素参数选择方案的 1/33 至 1/66。在批量大小为 1–32 的多头注意力（MHA）、分组查询注意力（GQA）和多查询注意力（MQA）评估中，综合所有 3 种注意力机制及所有受测批量大小，Tri-Stack-PIM 相对于图形处理器（GPU）基线、AttAcc 和 H2-LLM 的几何平均加速比分别为 4.95 倍、2.57 倍和 1.68 倍。
takeaway: 在批量大小为 1–32 的 MHA、GQA 和 MQA 评估中，Tri-Stack-PIM 相对 GPU 基线、AttAcc 和 H2-LLM 的几何平均加速比分别为 4.95 倍、2.57 倍和 1.68 倍。UBAR 最多挽回顺序发射策略原本会损失的 90% 周期，架构与数据流联合探索使 EDP 降至朴素参数选择方案的 1/33 至 1/66。
innovation: 1. 提出异构三裸片架构，将存储置于顶层 DRAM 裸片，将 PHY、DMA 引擎和近存计算置于中间成熟工艺裸片，将 SIMD MAC 阵列置于底层先进工艺裸片；2. 提出 UBAR 硬件乱序微操作调度器，在运行时正确处理跨裸片依赖，并通过多项优先级函数提高发射槽利用率；3. 联合探索架构与数据流，确定帕累托最优配置。

title: OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture
abstract: As the computing power density of large-scale AI clusters rises, network communication increasingly limits system performance. GPU-initiated communication requires low-overhead request submission to overlap communication with computation. However, GPUDirect RDMA (GDR) still relies on CPU involvement in its control path, while InfiniBand GPUDirect Async (IBGDA) requires GPUs to assemble Work Queue Entries (WQEs), consuming additional SM resources and memory bandwidth. We propose OpenRDMA, an open-source multi-path reliable RDMA transport architecture designed for GPU-friendly communication. First, OpenRDMA provides a minimal GPU doorbell mechanism: the GPU issues an 8-byte token, and a dedicated FPGA NIC reconstructs the complete WQE from preconfigured context. Second, building on Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC), OpenRDMA supports per-packet multi-path transport and out-of-order arrivals, while selective retransmission, ordered DMA placement, and GPU-visible flag polling provide reliable delivery and safe data consumption. Third, a hardware-software co-designed retransmission mechanism keeps the GPU submission path lightweight and reduces FPGA hardware state overhead: the NIC handles fast data transfer, while CPU software manages complex timeout detection, state tracking, and recovery policies. We describe the architecture and key hardware components of OpenRDMA; implementation of the FPGA prototype is underway.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 随着大规模 AI 集群的算力密度上升，网络通信日益成为系统性能的瓶颈。GPU 发起的通信需要以低开销提交请求，才能让通信与计算重叠。然而，GPUDirect RDMA（GDR）的控制路径仍需 CPU 参与，而 InfiniBand GPUDirect Async（IBGDA）要求 GPU 构造工作队列条目（WQE），会额外消耗流式多处理器（SM）资源和内存带宽。我们提出 OpenRDMA，一种面向 GPU 通信设计的开源多路径可靠 RDMA 传输架构。首先，OpenRDMA 提供精简的 GPU 门铃机制，GPU 发出一个 8 字节令牌，专用 FPGA 网卡（NIC）根据预配置的上下文重建完整的 WQE。其次，OpenRDMA 基于多路径可靠连接（Multipath Reliable Connection，MRC），支持逐包多路径传输和乱序到达，并通过选择性重传、有序 DMA 写入和对 GPU 可见标志位的轮询，确保可靠交付和数据的安全使用。最后，软硬件协同设计的重传机制降低了 GPU 提交路径的开销和 FPGA 上维护硬件状态的成本。网卡负责快速传输数据，CPU 软件负责复杂的超时检测、状态跟踪和恢复策略。本文介绍 OpenRDMA 的架构及关键硬件组件，FPGA 原型仍在实现中。
takeaway: OpenRDMA 将 GPU 请求提交简化为发送 8 字节令牌，由 FPGA 网卡重建 WQE，并通过软硬件协同支持逐包多路径可靠传输。FPGA 原型仍在实现中。
innovation: 1. 设计精简的 GPU 门铃机制，由 FPGA 网卡根据 8 字节令牌和预配置上下文重建完整 WQE；2. 基于 MRC 支持逐包多路径传输和乱序到达，结合选择性重传、有序 DMA 写入和对 GPU 可见标志位的轮询，保证可靠交付和数据的安全使用；3. 协同设计重传机制，由网卡负责快速数据传输，CPU 软件负责超时检测、状态跟踪和恢复策略。

title: Naviq: An Open-Source System-on-Chip Simulator for Rapid Prototyping, Verification, and Design Space Exploration
abstract:
Modern FPGA SoCs are no longer just collections of accelerators on top of a programmable fabric. They combine programmable logic with hardened processors, NoCs, and components that dominate end-to-end performance. Evaluating individual pieces is insufficient; system performance depends on the interplay of SoC components. However, current FPGA SoC simulations provide limited support for this style of evaluation. Vendor simulations capture these interactions but are prohibitively slow for iterative design-space exploration. At the same time, generic software models overly abstract the hardware components that determine real behavior, resulting in less accurate simulations. Fast, easy-to-use simulators that accurately model real SoCs are critical for system debugging and design space exploration.
  We present Naviq, an open-source, cycle-level software simulator for FPGA SoCs, tuned to AMD Versal-class architectures. Naviq bridges accurate but slow vendor simulation and fast software modeling: it captures key behaviors of modern commercial FPGA SoCs while being fast enough for debugging and design-space exploration. Naviq models hardened SoC infrastructure in C++ and integrates accelerators through Verilator, allowing designers to evaluate custom hardware in a full-system environment. At the center of Naviq is an AXI4-compliant NoC model that captures transaction ordering, packetization, routing, backpressure, and memory interactions. Naviq provides CPU and memory integration, protocol checking, checkpointing, tracing, and performance-analysis tools for debugging and design-space exploration. Experimental results show Naviq closely reproduces the bandwidth and latency of Vivado's RTL NoC model while accelerating the evaluated simulations by 81x-182x. We present five case studies demonstrating Naviq's capabilities. Naviq enables practical full-system evaluation of modern FPGA SoC designs.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
现代 FPGA SoC 将可编程逻辑与硬核处理器、片上网络（NoC）以及其他对端到端性能起决定作用的组件集成在一起。系统性能取决于 SoC 组件之间的相互作用，仅评估单个组件并不充分。然而，现有 FPGA SoC 仿真对这种评估方式的支持有限。厂商提供的仿真能够体现这些相互作用，但速度过慢，难以用于迭代式设计空间探索。通用软件模型则对决定实际行为的硬件组件抽象过度，导致仿真精度下降。快速、易用且能准确建模真实 SoC 的仿真器对系统调试和设计空间探索至关重要。

我们提出 Naviq，一款针对 AMD Versal 一类架构优化的开源周期级 FPGA SoC 软件仿真器。Naviq 兼顾厂商仿真的精度和软件建模的速度，能够模拟现代商用 FPGA SoC 的关键行为，同时满足调试和设计空间探索的速度需求。Naviq 使用 C++ 对 SoC 的硬化基础设施建模，并通过 Verilator 集成加速器，使设计者能够在全系统环境中评估定制硬件。Naviq 的核心是一个符合 AXI4 规范的 NoC 模型，能够模拟事务顺序、分组封装、路由、反压及与内存的交互。Naviq 支持 CPU 和内存集成、协议检查、检查点、执行跟踪，并提供性能分析工具，以支持调试和设计空间探索。实验结果表明，Naviq 能够较为准确地复现 Vivado 的 RTL NoC 模型的带宽和延迟，同时在所评估的仿真中实现 81–182 倍加速。本文通过 5 个案例展示 Naviq 的功能。Naviq 使现代 FPGA SoC 设计的全系统评估具备实际可行性。
takeaway: 在所评估的仿真中，面向 AMD Versal 一类架构的周期级仿真器 Naviq 较为准确地复现了 Vivado RTL NoC 模型的带宽和延迟，同时实现 81–182 倍加速。论文通过 5 个案例展示其全系统评估能力。
innovation: 1. 提出针对 AMD Versal 一类架构优化的开源周期级 FPGA SoC 仿真器，用 C++ 建模硬化基础设施并通过 Verilator 集成加速器，以支持定制硬件的全系统评估；2. 实现符合 AXI4 规范的 NoC 模型，模拟事务顺序、分组封装、路由、反压及与内存的交互；3. 集成 CPU 和内存，并提供协议检查、检查点、执行跟踪和性能分析功能，支持系统调试与设计空间探索。

title: Randomized Caches in Hardware: Challenges and Trade-offs
abstract: Randomized caches protect against side-channel attacks by obfuscating the mapping of memory addresses to cache locations. Existing proposals typically describe architectural behavior, leaving practical hardware implementation challenges largely unexplored. We implement four prominent designs, CEASER-S, ScatterCache, SassCache, and MIRAGE, and integrate them as the last-level cache (LLC) of a multi-core out-of-order RISC-V system-on-chip (SoC). We identify common and design-specific implementation challenges and develop practical solutions. We evaluate complete FPGA implementations by running SPEC CPU 2017 rate and GAPBS workloads to completion, providing, to our knowledge, the first comparative evaluation of these designs on a common full-system hardware platform. Pipelining the index derivation function (IDF) alone is insufficient: in three of the four variants, other components become the frequency bottleneck, reducing frequency by up to 35% relative to the baseline set-associative cache. Redesigning the critical paths while preserving mappings, rekeying, and victim-selection policies brings the three affected variants to no more than 10% below the baseline frequency, at the cost of added latency or reduced concurrency. Increased LLC access latency, rather than additional misses, dominates IPC degradation, reducing instructions per cycle by up to 5% for SPEC and 11% for GAPBS. Hardware overhead depends on the design and implementation technology: FPGA lookup-table usage increases by 10-35%, while ASIC area increases by 1-14%.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 随机化缓存通过混淆内存地址到缓存位置的映射来防御侧信道攻击。现有方案通常侧重描述体系结构层面的行为，对实际硬件实现中的挑战鲜有探讨。我们实现了 4 种代表性设计，即 CEASER-S、ScatterCache、SassCache 和 MIRAGE，并将它们分别集成为多核乱序执行 RISC-V 片上系统（SoC）的末级缓存（LLC）。我们识别了这些设计共有的实现难点及各自特有的难点，并提出了可行的解决方案。我们在完整的 FPGA 实现上将 SPEC CPU 2017 rate 和 GAPBS 工作负载运行至结束。据我们所知，这是首次在同一全系统硬件平台上对这些设计进行对比评估。仅对索引派生函数（IDF）进行流水线化仍不够。在 4 种设计中的 3 种里，其他组件成为频率瓶颈，工作频率较基线组相联缓存最多降低 35%。在保留映射、密钥更新和替换牺牲项选择策略的前提下重新设计关键路径，可将这 3 种设计的频率降幅控制在基线的 10% 以内，代价是延迟增加或并发度下降。LLC 访问延迟增加是每周期指令数（IPC）下降的主要原因，相比之下，额外的缓存未命中影响较小。SPEC 和 GAPBS 的 IPC 分别最多下降 5% 和 11%。硬件开销取决于具体设计和实现技术，FPGA 查找表用量增加 10%–35%，ASIC 面积增加 1%–14%。
takeaway: 仅将 IDF 流水线化时，4 种随机化缓存中有 3 种受其他组件限制，频率较组相联基线最多降低 35%。重设计关键路径后，这 3 种设计的频率降幅均收窄到 10% 以内，代价是延迟增加或并发度下降，而 LLC 访问延迟增加主导了 SPEC 和 GAPBS 分别最高 5% 和 11% 的 IPC 降幅。
innovation: ① 将 4 种随机化缓存分别实现为同一多核乱序执行 RISC-V SoC 的 LLC，并在完整 FPGA 系统上运行工作负载至结束以开展对比评估；② 针对共性及各设计特有的实现瓶颈提出解决方案，在保留映射、密钥更新和替换牺牲项选择策略的前提下重设计关键路径。

title: Operating System Support for Accelerators as First-Class Compute Elements in Heterogeneous Systems
abstract:
Heterogeneous systems-on-chip (SoCs) increasingly rely on domain-specific hardware accelerators (HAs) to deliver performance and energy efficiency gains beyond what general-purpose processors can provide. However, operating systems (O/S), such as Linux, assume that processors are the Compute Elements (CEs) and HAs are peripheral devices rather than specialized CEs. As a result, HA execution incurs substantial software (SW) overheads that reduce the effective benefits of hardware (HW) acceleration.
  This work demonstrates that significant inefficiencies arise from ``O/S peripheral device taxes'' (O/S taxes), including SW stack-accelerator communication, invocation, interrupt handling, and scheduling. We built MEERKAT, a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based framework for configurable multicore systems that include HAs; it allows the user to migrate Linux O/S support from SW to HW and identify, study, and quantify the impact. Here we study four major sources of O/S tax and introduce techniques to mitigate them. These include a virtual-memory-aware (VMA) communication method that enables efficient HA access to application data, a lightweight HA invocation interface, Interrupt Policy Adaptation (IPA) for dynamic polling and interrupt selection, and an HA-aware scheduler that dynamically distributes work across Central Processing Units (CPUs) and multiple HA instances.
  Experimental results demonstrate up to $260\times$ faster communication and $2$--$6\times$ performance improvements in wall-clock time over conventional schedulers. Furthermore, our study reveals that overall system performance depends not only on HA speed, but also on O/S overheads, resource availability, and scheduling decisions. These findings highlight the importance of treating HAs as first-class computational resources and motivate a more accelerator-centric O/S design for future heterogeneous systems.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
异构片上系统（SoC）越来越依赖领域专用硬件加速器（HA），以获得超越通用处理器所能提供的性能和能效。然而，Linux 等操作系统（O/S）默认将处理器视为计算单元（CE），将 HA 视为外设。这使得 HA 执行产生大量软件（SW）开销，削弱了硬件（HW）加速的实际收益。

本文表明，“操作系统外设税”（简称“操作系统税”）会造成显著的效率损失，其来源包括软件栈与加速器的通信、加速器调用、中断处理和调度。我们构建了 MEERKAT，这是一个基于现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）的框架，用于构建含 HA 的可配置多核系统。该框架允许用户将 Linux 操作系统支持功能从软件迁移到硬件，并识别、研究和量化这一迁移的影响。本文研究了操作系统税的 4 个主要来源，并提出相应的缓解技术，包括支持 HA 高效访问应用数据的虚拟内存感知（VMA）通信方法、轻量级 HA 调用接口、在轮询与中断之间动态选择的中断策略自适应（IPA），以及在中央处理器（CPU）和多个 HA 实例之间动态分派工作的 HA 感知调度器。

实验结果表明，通信最高可加速 260 倍，按实际经过时间衡量，相比传统调度器可实现 2–6 倍加速。此外，研究表明，整体系统性能同时取决于 HA 的速度、操作系统开销、资源可用性和调度决策。这些发现凸显了将 HA 视为一等计算资源的重要性，也为未来异构系统采用更以加速器为中心的操作系统设计提供了动机。
takeaway: 在 MEERKAT 实验中，通信最高加速 260 倍，按实际经过时间衡量，相比传统调度器实现了 2–6 倍加速。异构系统的整体性能同时取决于加速器速度、操作系统开销、资源可用性和调度决策。
innovation: ① 构建基于 FPGA 的可配置多核框架 MEERKAT，支持将 Linux 操作系统功能从软件迁移到硬件并量化其影响；② 提出虚拟内存感知通信方法，使 HA 能高效访问应用数据；③ 设计轻量级 HA 调用接口；④ 提出中断策略自适应机制，在轮询与中断之间动态选择；⑤ 设计 HA 感知调度器，在 CPU 和多个 HA 实例之间动态分派工作。

title: M3D-FLOW: A Monolithic 3-D-Stackable Processing-Near-DRAM Architecture for Generative Normalizing Flow Applications
abstract: Normalizing Flows (NFs) have shown strong results in generative modeling, recently reaching state-of-the-art image generation performance. However, their repetitive, sequential operations limit the computational and memory efficiency achievable with GPUs and TPUs. We propose M3D-FLOW, a novel monolithic 3D-stackable (M3D) DRAM-based processing-near-memory (PNM) architecture that eliminates memory bottlenecks using a Cu-Cu hybrid-bonded logic die integrated with an M3D DRAM die. The M3D DRAM provides dense bank integration and a tiered organization with variable access latencies that M3D-FLOW exploits for the efficient processing of different NF workloads. To maximize compute density while minimizing area, energy, and thermal overhead, M3D-FLOW employs hybrid binary--stochastic floating-point multipliers, performing mantissa multiplication in the stochastic domain and exponent operations in the binary domain. A pipelined execution strategy maps sequential NF stages across dynamically partitioned PE groups, and together with the stochastic hardware, enables M3D-FLOW to achieve at least $6.6\times$ higher performance and $3\times$ better energy efficiency than prior PNM accelerators, with only a 2.2% bits-per-dimension (BPD) increase over bfloat16 and 4.1% over FP32. An analysis of stochastic hardware variants further shows that shorter stochastic bitstreams reduce execution time by up to $3.3\times$ at the cost of higher approximation error, providing a concrete design guide for latency--accuracy trade-offs.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 归一化流（NF）在生成建模中表现出色，近期已达到图像生成的最先进水平。然而，其重复且顺序执行的操作限制了 GPU 和 TPU 可达到的计算效率与访存效率。我们提出 M3D-FLOW，一种基于可单片三维堆叠（M3D）DRAM 的新型近存计算（PNM）架构。该架构通过铜—铜混合键合将逻辑裸片与 M3D DRAM 裸片集成，以消除访存瓶颈。M3D DRAM 支持高密度存储体集成，并采用访问延迟随层级而变化的分层组织。M3D-FLOW 利用这一特性高效处理不同的 NF 工作负载。为了尽可能提高计算密度并降低面积、能耗和热开销，M3D-FLOW 采用二进制与随机计算混合的浮点乘法器，在随机域执行尾数乘法，在二进制域执行指数运算。流水线执行策略将顺序执行的 NF 阶段映射到动态划分的处理单元（PE）组。结合随机计算硬件，M3D-FLOW 的性能至少达到既有 PNM 加速器的 6.6 倍，能效至少达到其 3 倍，每维比特数（BPD）仅比 bfloat16 高 2.2%，比 FP32 高 4.1%。对不同随机计算硬件变体的进一步分析表明，缩短随机比特流最多可带来 3.3 倍的执行加速，代价是近似误差增大。这为延迟与精度之间的权衡提供了具体的设计依据。
takeaway: 在归一化流工作负载上，M3D-FLOW 的性能和能效分别至少达到既有近存计算加速器的 6.6 倍和 3 倍，BPD 较 bfloat16 和 FP32 分别增加 2.2% 和 4.1%。缩短随机比特流最多可带来 3.3 倍的执行加速，代价是近似误差增大。
innovation: ① 提出通过铜—铜混合键合集成逻辑裸片与 M3D DRAM 裸片的近存计算架构，利用高密度存储体及不同访问延迟的存储层级处理不同 NF 工作负载；② 设计混合浮点乘法器，在随机域执行尾数乘法，在二进制域执行指数运算；③ 动态划分处理单元组，并将顺序执行的 NF 阶段映射到这些组上进行流水线执行；④ 分析不同随机计算硬件变体，量化随机比特流长度对执行时间和近似误差的影响。

title: MemLLM: End-to-end In-Storage Acceleration of On-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Precomputed KV Caches
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices enables personalized large language model (LLM) inference while preserving privacy. However, RAG's inherent length asymmetry makes the prefill phase the dominant bottleneck. While precomputing the KV caches offline alleviates the prefill cost on server systems, the multi-gigabyte caches over the narrow interconnect create a severe I/O wall for on-device systems. To mitigate this, we propose MemLLM, an end-to-end in-storage processing (ISP) architecture that executes the complete attention pipeline based on precomputed KV caches within the SSD. MemLLM utilizes per-channel accelerators to fully utilize the aggregated NAND channel bandwidth and accelerates all KV cache-related computations on the storage-side to minimize PCIe transfers. To efficiently handle the sparse updates required by RAG, MemLLM introduces a fused recomputation-query kernel paired with a hardware-based filter logic to halve the NAND read volume and eliminate write-back penalties. Furthermore, MemLLM's global SRAM-based stateful reduction engine enables a completely DRAM-less dataflow, thereby removing the internal memory bottlenecks and bounding the PCIe egress to an $O(1)$ footprint. A full-stack software stack allows asynchronous, zero-copy transfers from the ISP to the host and provides transparent execution within modern ML frameworks. Evaluated across eight real-world RAG datasets and six on-device LLM models, MemLLM achieves an average end-to-end speedup of 4.06$\times$ over the GPU baseline.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 在边缘设备上运行检索增强生成（RAG），可以在保护隐私的同时实现个性化的大语言模型（LLM）推理。然而，RAG 固有的长度不对称使预填充阶段成为主要瓶颈。在服务器系统中，离线预计算 KV 缓存能够降低预填充开销。对端侧系统而言，经由带宽有限的互连传输数 GB 的缓存会造成严重的 I/O 瓶颈。为缓解这一问题，我们提出 MemLLM，一种端到端存储侧处理（ISP）架构，可在固态硬盘（SSD）内部基于预计算的 KV 缓存执行完整的注意力流水线。MemLLM 在每条通道上布置加速器，充分利用 NAND 各通道的总带宽，并在存储侧加速所有与 KV 缓存相关的计算，以尽量减少 PCIe 传输。为高效处理 RAG 所需的稀疏更新，MemLLM 引入融合重计算与查询的计算核，并配合硬件过滤逻辑，将 NAND 读取量减半并消除写回开销。此外，MemLLM 基于全局 SRAM 的有状态归约引擎实现了完全无 DRAM 的数据流，消除了内部存储瓶颈，并将经 PCIe 传出的数据量限制在 O(1)。全栈软件支持从 ISP 到主机的异步零拷贝传输，并可在现代机器学习框架中透明执行。在 8 个真实场景的 RAG 数据集和 6 个端侧 LLM 上进行评估时，MemLLM 相比 GPU 基线平均实现了 4.06 倍的端到端加速。
takeaway: MemLLM 在 SSD 内利用预计算 KV 缓存执行完整的注意力流水线，并将 PCIe 传出数据量限制在 O(1)。在 8 个真实场景的 RAG 数据集和 6 个端侧 LLM 上，相比 GPU 基线平均实现了 4.06 倍的端到端加速。
innovation: ① 在 SSD 内设置逐通道加速器以充分利用 NAND 通道的总带宽，并在存储侧基于预计算 KV 缓存执行完整的注意力流水线；② 将重计算与查询融合到同一计算核，并配合硬件过滤逻辑处理稀疏更新，将 NAND 读取量减半并消除写回开销；③ 采用基于全局 SRAM 的有状态归约引擎，实现无 DRAM 数据流，并将 PCIe 传出数据量限制在 O(1)；④ 提供支持从 ISP 到主机异步零拷贝传输的全栈软件，并支持在现代机器学习框架中透明执行。

title: Helix: A Unified Programmable Accelerator for Diverse Krylov Subspace Solvers
abstract: Domain-specific accelerators deliver high performance and energy efficiency through specialization but often lack support for extensible algorithm families. Existing FPGA accelerators for Krylov subspace methods, which iteratively solve sparse linear systems, typically support a single solver or require separate hardware configurations. Helix follows a systematic algorithm-family design methodology that first abstracts common computational primitives from diverse Krylov solvers and builds the architecture around efficient, programmable primitive kernels. Helix then introduces programmable datapaths to coordinate these primitives. Its architecture decouples hardware implementation from solver-specific execution, enabling HBM reuse and zero solver-switching latency. Finally, Helix provides a DSL compiler that efficiently maps different solvers onto the architecture while optimizing vector-operation performance for each solver. We prototype Helix on a Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA and evaluate Helix's practicality and performance by using it to compile and execute eight solvers. Helix achieves up to 7.91x and 1.16x speedups over Xilinx XcgSolver and the state-of-the-art FPGA accelerator Callipepla, respectively, both of which support only JPCG. Across the eight solvers, Helix sustains 47.5% - 96.9% of the throughput of an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU while delivering 2.29x - 4.66x higher energy efficiency and 1.89x - 3.85x higher throughput per unit peak memory bandwidth. The programmable components incur 0.25% - 0.57% execution-time overhead and 4.7% LUT and 4.0% FF overhead, demonstrating negligible overhead for programmability.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 领域专用加速器通过专门化设计实现高性能和高能效，但通常缺乏对可扩展算法族的支持。Krylov 子空间方法用于迭代求解稀疏线性系统，现有面向这类方法的 FPGA 加速器通常仅支持一种求解器，或需要为不同求解器分别配置硬件。Helix 采用系统化的算法族设计方法，先从多种 Krylov 求解器中抽象出通用计算原语，再围绕高效、可编程的原语计算核构建架构。随后，Helix 引入可编程数据通路来协调这些原语。该架构将硬件实现与各求解器特有的执行过程解耦，从而支持复用高带宽内存（HBM），并实现零求解器切换延迟。Helix 还提供领域专用语言（DSL）编译器，可将不同求解器高效映射到该架构，同时优化各求解器的向量运算性能。我们在 Xilinx Alveo U55C FPGA 上构建了 Helix 原型，并用它编译和运行 8 种求解器，以评估其实用性与性能。相比 Xilinx XcgSolver 和最先进的 FPGA 加速器 Callipepla，Helix 分别实现了最高 7.91 倍和 1.16 倍加速，这两种基线均仅支持 JPCG。在 8 种求解器上，Helix 达到 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU 吞吐量的 47.5%–96.9%，能效为该 GPU 的 2.29–4.66 倍，单位峰值内存带宽的吞吐量为其 1.89–3.85 倍。可编程组件带来的执行时间开销为 0.25%–0.57%，查找表（LUT）和触发器（FF）开销分别为 4.7% 和 4.0%，表明可编程性的开销可忽略不计。
takeaway: Xilinx Alveo U55C 上的 Helix 原型可编译并运行 8 种 Krylov 求解器，相比仅支持 JPCG 的 XcgSolver 和 Callipepla 分别最高加速 7.91 倍和 1.16 倍。在 8 种求解器上，其吞吐量达到 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 的 47.5%–96.9%，能效为该 GPU 的 2.29–4.66 倍，可编程组件仅增加 0.25%–0.57% 的执行时间。
innovation: ① 提出面向算法族的系统化设计方法，从多种 Krylov 求解器中提取通用计算原语，并构建可编程的原语计算核；② 引入协调计算原语的可编程数据通路，将硬件实现与求解器特有的执行过程解耦，支持 HBM 复用和零延迟切换求解器；③ 提供 DSL 编译器，将不同求解器高效映射到统一架构，并优化各求解器的向量运算。

title: CHIPSMORE: Compute-in-Interconnect and -Memory Chiplets for Multi-Mode Multi-Request LLM Inference Acceleration
abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits substantial variability across adaptation modes, context lengths, and request concurrency, creating challenges for maintaining high utilization, memory efficiency, and scalable performance on compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators. This paper presents CHIPSMORE, a multi-mode and multi-request LLM inference accelerator that integrates compute-in-interconnect and CIM to support both base-mode and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) inference under diverse workloads. CHIPSMORE employs heterogeneous processing elements consisting of resistive RAM analog compute-in-memory (RRAM-ACIM) and static RAM digital compute-in-memory (SRAM-DCIM) interconnected through a programmable Inter-PE computational network (IPCN). A composable hierarchical key-value (KV) memory scheme dynamically allocates router scratchpad, SRAM-DCIM, and embedded DRAM (eDRAM) resources according to workload requirements, enabling scalable support for long-context and batched inference. Furthermore, a non-replicated multi-request execution pipeline exploits request-level parallelism without duplicating pretrained weights, while a state-aware resource reconfiguration mechanism selectively retains runtime states and power-gates inactive resources to improve energy efficiency. Evaluation using cycle-accurate hardware-software co-simulation demonstrates that CHIPSMORE effectively sustains high throughput across varying model sizes, context lengths, and batch sizes while maintaining favorable power scaling. Compared with Nvidia H100, CHIPSMORE achieves up to $2.38\times$ higher throughput and $27\times$ higher energy efficiency on Mistral-7B inference while eliminating weight replication for multi-request serving.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）推理的特征随适配模式、上下文长度和请求并发度显著变化，使存内计算（CIM）加速器难以同时维持高利用率、高效的存储资源利用和可扩展的性能。本文提出 CHIPSMORE，一种面向多模式、多请求的 LLM 推理加速器，结合互连内计算与存内计算，在多种工作负载下支持基础模型模式和低秩适配（LoRA）推理。CHIPSMORE 采用异构处理单元（PE），包括基于阻变随机存取存储器的模拟存内计算（RRAM-ACIM）和基于静态随机存取存储器的数字存内计算（SRAM-DCIM），并通过可编程的 PE 间计算网络（IPCN）互连。可组合的分层 KV 存储方案按工作负载需求动态分配路由器暂存存储器、SRAM-DCIM 和嵌入式 DRAM（eDRAM）资源，为长上下文推理和批量推理提供可扩展支持。此外，无权重复制的多请求执行流水线在共享预训练权重的同时利用请求级并行性。状态感知的资源重配置机制选择性地保留运行时状态，并对非活动资源实施电源门控，以提高能效。周期精确的软硬件协同仿真表明，CHIPSMORE 在不同模型规模、上下文长度和批大小下均能维持高吞吐率，同时保持良好的功耗扩展特性。与 NVIDIA H100 相比，CHIPSMORE 在 Mistral-7B 推理中最高达到其 2.38 倍的吞吐率和 27 倍的能效，同时消除了多请求服务中的权重复制。
takeaway: 周期精确的软硬件协同仿真显示，CHIPSMORE 在多种模型规模、上下文长度和批大小下均能维持高吞吐率。在 Mistral-7B 推理中，其吞吐率和能效最高分别达到 NVIDIA H100 的 2.38 倍和 27 倍，同时消除了多请求服务中的权重复制。
innovation: 1. 通过可编程 PE 间计算网络互连 RRAM 模拟存内计算与 SRAM 数字存内计算处理单元，支持基础模型模式和 LoRA 推理；2. 构建可组合的分层 KV 存储，按负载动态分配路由器暂存存储器、SRAM-DCIM 和 eDRAM 资源；3. 设计共享预训练权重的多请求执行流水线，利用请求级并行性；4. 采用状态感知的资源重配置，选择性保留运行时状态并对非活动资源实施电源门控。

title: Assessing Triple Modular Redundancy for Wide-Link, Low-Latency NoC Routers: Reliability and Physical Design Challenges
abstract: Protecting the Network-on-Chip (NoC) of physical-AI tile-based accelerators deployed in harsh environments against single-event effects (SEEs) is paramount for preventing NoC failures that can lead to deadlocks and silent data corruption (SDC). Prior work on reliable NoCs has largely focused on narrow links (e.g., 32-bit), deeply pipelined routers, and single-event upsets (SEUs). However, the state of the art has evolved toward low-latency NoC routers with ultra-wide links, implemented on advanced technology nodes and operating at frequencies above 1 GHz. We evaluate the cost and reliability trade-offs of implementing Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) at three granularities (coarse, state-only, and full) for a 2-cycle-latency NoC router with 512-bit wide links. We carry out RTL-to-GDSII physical design in TSMC 7nm technology, as well as both RTL- and netlist-level SEU and SET fault injection campaigns. We evaluate the three TMR approaches in terms of reliability, cost, and physical design strategies, further extending the assessment from a standalone router to a full AI acceleration tile. Our results show that state-only and coarse-grained TMR do not provide sufficient protection against SEEs, whereas full TMR eliminates all observed failures across more than one million injected faults per experiment. Although the standalone full-TMR router incurs a 7.04x area overhead, this cost is drastically amortized once integrated into a complete AI accelerator tile with processors and local L1 memories: the same design adds only 16.8% area and 15.2% power consumption under a GEMM benchmark at the system level, with the critical path of the tile entirely unaffected. These results demonstrate that advanced technology nodes provide sufficient routing capacity to make full TMR a practical and deployable solution for protecting NoCs in Physical AI systems operating in harsh environments.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 对于部署在严苛环境中的物理 AI 分块式加速器，保护其片上网络（NoC）免受单粒子效应（SEE）影响，对于防止可能导致死锁和静默数据损坏（SDC）的 NoC 故障至关重要。以往关于高可靠 NoC 的研究主要聚焦于窄链路（例如 32 位）、深流水线式路由器及单粒子翻转（SEU）。当前的先进设计已转向采用超宽链路的低延迟 NoC 路由器，这类路由器采用先进工艺节点实现，工作频率超过 1 GHz。本文以一款延迟为 2 个周期、链路宽度为 512 位的 NoC 路由器为对象，评估在粗粒度、仅保护状态和全量三种粒度下实现三模冗余（TMR）的开销与可靠性权衡。我们采用台积电 7 nm 工艺完成从 RTL 到 GDSII 的物理设计，并在 RTL 和网表两个层级开展单粒子翻转和单粒子瞬态（SET）故障注入实验。我们从可靠性、开销和物理设计策略三个方面评估这三种 TMR 方法，并将评估范围从独立路由器扩展到完整的 AI 加速单元。结果表明，仅保护状态的 TMR 和粗粒度 TMR 无法为单粒子效应提供充分防护，而全量 TMR 在每项注入超过 100 万个故障的实验中均未出现失效。采用全量 TMR 的独立路由器有 7.04 倍的面积开销。将同一设计集成到包含处理器和本地 L1 存储器的完整 AI 加速单元后，这一开销显著摊薄。在系统层面，面积仅增加 16.8%，运行通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）基准时的功耗仅增加 15.2%，加速单元的关键路径完全不受影响。这些结果表明，先进工艺节点具备足够的布线容量，让全量 TMR 成为严苛环境下物理 AI 系统中可实际部署的 NoC 防护方案。
takeaway: 对于采用台积电 7 nm 工艺、链路宽度为 512 位且延迟为 2 个周期的 NoC 路由器，三种方案中只有全量 TMR 在每项注入超过 100 万个故障的实验中均未出现失效。全量 TMR 集成到完整 AI 加速单元后，相对未加固设计的面积和 GEMM 功耗分别增加 16.8% 和 15.2%，关键路径保持不变。
innovation: 1. 针对 512 位链路、2 周期延迟的 NoC 路由器，比较粗粒度、仅保护状态和全量三种 TMR 方案；2. 结合台积电 7 nm 工艺的 RTL 到 GDSII 物理设计及 RTL、网表两个层级的 SEU 与 SET 故障注入，评估可靠性、开销和物理设计策略；3. 将评估从独立路由器扩展到包含处理器和本地 L1 存储器的完整 AI 加速单元。

title: ELiTeFormer: An Efficient Transformer for FPGAs
abstract: Transformer blocks are prevalent in large language model (LLM) but present deployment challenges due to their challenging computational and memory demands. While prior work has typically optimized attention mechanisms or feed-forward networks (FFNs) separately, few hardware (HW) architecture have jointly addressed both components with co-designed hardware acceleration. We present ELiTeFormer (Efficient Linear Ternary Transformer), the first Transformer model architecture that unifies hybrid linear attention with ultra-low-precision (ternary) linear projections, specifically co-designed for field-programmable gate array (FPGA) deployment. ELiTeFormer achieves 10x model weight compression and 12.8x key-value (KV) cache compression compared to LLaMA 3, while maintaining competitive accuracy (31.9% on the MMLU benchmark, within 3.0% of BitNet b1.58). Our key architectural contribution is a novel processing element (PE) micro-architecture that eliminates all multiplications in ternary linear projections through bitmasking operations, significantly reducing resource utilization by completely avoiding dedicated digital signal processing (DSP) blocks. We simulate, synthesize, and deploy ELiTeFormer targeting a Xilinx VCK5000 Versal board using high-level synthesis (HLS) flows. Block-level simulations show 9.6x speedup for FFN operations and 4.4x speedup for attention compared to standard implementations. End-to-end deployment achieves up to 3.9x lower latency and 3.2x better energy efficiency than LLaMA 3 on an NVIDIA A100 graphics processing unit (GPU) at long context lengths. This represents the first FPGA realization combining linear attention with ternary quantization, demonstrating the viability of algorithm-architecture co-design for next-generation LLM acceleration.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: Transformer 模块广泛用于大语言模型（LLM），其高计算量和高存储需求给部署带来了挑战。以往研究通常分别优化注意力机制和前馈网络（FFN），很少有硬件架构通过协同设计同时加速这两个组件。本文提出 ELiTeFormer（Efficient Linear Ternary Transformer），这是首个将混合线性注意力与超低精度（三值）线性投影统一到同一模型中，并专为现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）部署而协同设计的 Transformer 架构。与 LLaMA 3 相比，ELiTeFormer 的模型权重和 KV 缓存的压缩比分别达到 10 倍和 12.8 倍，同时保持有竞争力的准确率，在 MMLU 基准上达到 31.9%，与 BitNet b1.58 的差距在 3.0% 以内。主要架构贡献是一种新型处理单元（PE）微架构，通过位掩码操作消除三值线性投影中的所有乘法，完全省去专用数字信号处理（DSP）模块，从而显著降低资源占用。我们使用高层次综合（HLS）流程，面向 Xilinx VCK5000 Versal 板卡对 ELiTeFormer 进行仿真、综合和部署。模块级仿真表明，相比标准实现，FFN 和注意力运算分别获得 9.6 倍和 4.4 倍的加速。在长上下文条件下，端到端部署的延迟最低为 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上运行 LLaMA 3 的 1/3.9，能效最高为其 3.2 倍。这是首个结合线性注意力与三值量化的 FPGA 实现，展示了算法与架构协同设计用于下一代 LLM 加速的可行性。
takeaway: 在长上下文条件下，部署于 Xilinx VCK5000 的 ELiTeFormer 相比 NVIDIA A100 上运行的 LLaMA 3，端到端延迟最低为基线的 1/3.9，能效最高为基线的 3.2 倍。相较于 LLaMA 3，其模型权重和 KV 缓存的压缩比分别为 10 倍和 12.8 倍，MMLU 准确率为 31.9%，与 BitNet b1.58 的差距在 3.0% 以内。
innovation: 1. 面向 FPGA 协同设计 Transformer 模型，将混合线性注意力与三值线性投影集成到同一架构；2. 设计基于位掩码操作的 PE 微架构，消除三值线性投影中的全部乘法，并省去专用 DSP 模块。

title: High-Performance NTT Accelerators for PQC leveraging Unified Redundant Arithmetic and Fine-Tuned Microarchitecture
abstract: Post-quantum cryptography and privacy-preserving technologies are expected to play a central role in future secure communication systems. Lattice-based PQC schemes such as ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber) and ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) rely heavily on large-degree polynomial arithmetic, making the Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) a key computational primitive. Although existing hardware accelerators exploit parallelism and pipelining to support both NTT and INTT, their efficiency is often limited by the overhead of modular reduction and correction steps, inverse-transform scaling operations, and suboptimal FPGA implementations. This work addresses these limitations by proposing parallel iterative NTT/INTT accelerators based on optimized unified butterfly units. We introduce a novel redundant number representation that eliminates conditional corrections for both Montgomery modulo multiplication and combined subtract-multiply operations, and integrate inverse-transform scaling into existing arithmetic hardware to avoid dedicated scaling units. Furthermore, we design hierarchical Montgomery multipliers that map efficiently onto FPGA DSP resources, reducing hardware cost while enabling high operating frequencies. FPGA-based experimental results demonstrate higher clock frequencies, reduced execution times, and competitive resource utilization, supporting efficient NTT acceleration for PQC and related privacy-preserving applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 预计后量子密码（PQC）和隐私保护技术将在未来的安全通信系统中发挥核心作用。ML-KEM（CRYSTALS-Kyber）和 ML-DSA（CRYSTALS-Dilithium）等基于格的 PQC 方案高度依赖高阶多项式运算，因此数论变换（NTT）是关键的计算原语。已有硬件加速器利用并行处理和流水线同时支持 NTT 及其逆变换（INTT），但其效率往往受限于模约减和校正步骤的开销、逆变换中的缩放操作，以及 FPGA 实现未充分优化等因素。为解决这些问题，本文提出基于优化的统一蝶形单元的并行迭代式 NTT/INTT 加速器。我们提出一种新的冗余数表示，消除蒙哥马利模乘和融合减乘运算中的条件校正，并将逆变换缩放集成到现有运算硬件中，省去专用缩放单元。此外，我们设计了分层蒙哥马利乘法器，使其能高效映射到 FPGA 的 DSP 资源，从而降低硬件开销并实现较高的工作频率。基于 FPGA 的实验结果表明，该设计具有更高的时钟频率、更短的执行时间和有竞争力的资源占用，可为 PQC 及相关隐私保护应用提供高效的 NTT 加速。
takeaway: 基于统一蝶形单元的并行迭代式 NTT/INTT 加速器通过消除条件校正并将逆变换缩放融入现有运算硬件，减少了运算和硬件开销。FPGA 实验显示该设计获得了更高的时钟频率和更短的执行时间，资源占用具有竞争力，摘要未给出具体基线或改善幅度。
innovation: 1. 使用优化的统一蝶形单元构建并行迭代式 NTT/INTT 加速器；2. 提出冗余数表示，消除蒙哥马利模乘及融合减乘运算中的条件校正；3. 将逆变换缩放集成到现有运算硬件中，省去专用缩放单元；4. 设计高效映射到 FPGA DSP 资源的分层蒙哥马利乘法器。

title: Dead on Arrival: Characterizing and Protecting Against Dead-Entry TLB Misses in GPU Microarchitectures
abstract: GPU workloads with large memory footprints frequently suffer from redundant L2 TLB misses in which a recently evicted translation is immediately re-walked at full page-walk cost. We characterize these dead-entry misses across 24 GPU workloads, finding they account for up to 99% of L2 TLB misses in the most TLB-sensitive applications, yet their performance impact varies widely depending on memory access structure. Workloads where warps share the same virtual page suffer from burst amplification, where a single eviction stalls many warps simultaneously waiting for one translation to return. In contrast, workloads where each warp accesses a distinct set of pages face a capacity-overflow problem that no replacement policy can resolve, a distinction validated by huge page experiments. Building on this two-class taxonomy, we design DEPOT (Dead-Entry PrOTection), a 1 KB Bloom filter mechanism that prevents recently evicted translations from being displaced immediately upon reinstallation, delivering up to 72% IPC improvement on interference-driven workloads with zero overhead on others, and composing with the state-of-the-art TLB prefetching and compaction mechanism, for 2 to 7% additional gain.
abstract_cn: 内存占用较大的 GPU 工作负载经常遭遇冗余的二级地址转换后备缓冲器（L2 TLB）缺失。刚被淘汰的地址转换条目随即再次被访问，为此需要重新执行完整的页表遍历，并承担相应开销。我们对 24 个 GPU 工作负载中的这类死条目缺失进行分析，发现它们在对 TLB 最敏感的应用中最多占 L2 TLB 缺失的 99%，但对性能的影响随内存访问结构而显著变化。多个线程束（warp）共享同一虚拟页的工作负载会遭遇突发放大效应，一次淘汰便会使多个线程束同时停顿，等待同一地址转换结果返回。各线程束访问不同页面集合的工作负载则面临容量溢出问题，这一问题无法通过任何替换策略解决。大页实验验证了这两类问题的区别。基于这一分类，我们设计了 DEPOT（Dead-Entry PrOTection），一种采用 1 KB 布隆过滤器的机制，用于防止刚被淘汰的地址转换条目在重新装入后立刻再次被替换。DEPOT 在受干扰的工作负载上可使每周期指令数（IPC）最高提高 72%，在其他工作负载上实现零开销，并可与先进的 TLB 预取与压缩机制结合，额外获得 2% 至 7% 的性能增益。
takeaway: 在 24 个 GPU 工作负载中，对 TLB 最敏感的应用里，死条目缺失最多占 L2 TLB 缺失的 99%。采用 1 KB 布隆过滤器的 DEPOT 在受干扰的工作负载上最高提高 72% 的 IPC，在其他工作负载上实现零开销，与先进的 TLB 预取与压缩机制结合后可再获得 2% 至 7% 的性能增益。
innovation: 1. 将死条目缺失的性能问题归因于共享虚拟页时的突发放大和各线程束访问不同页面集合时的容量溢出，并用大页实验验证这一划分；2. 提出基于 1 KB 布隆过滤器的 DEPOT，保护近期遭淘汰且已重新装入的地址转换条目，避免其立即再次被替换。

title: DORA: Dataflow-Instruction Orchestration Architecture for DNN Acceleration
abstract:
As deep neural networks develop significantly more diverse and complex, achieving high performance and efficiency on complicated DNN models faces pressing challenges. Modern DNN workloads are increasingly diverse in operation types, tensor shapes, and execution dependencies, making it difficult to sustain high hardware efficiency across models. In addition, a generic accelerator often incurs substantial overhead when executing diverse workloads.
  To address these problems, we propose DORA, an instruction-based overlay architecture that explicitly describes dataflow via a proposed ISA, enabling fine-grained control of data movement, computation, and synchronization at the layer level. To support flexibility while achieving high performance, DORA adopts a novel on-chip memory management and computation parallelism management mechanism. DORA proposes a compilation framework that can generate instructions for given DNN workloads after a two-stage design space exploration. DORA framework also incorporates a MILP-based and a heuristic-based search engine to generate the schedule solution for different needs and constraints.
  We prototype DORA on the AMD Versal VCK190 platform, demonstrating its deployability on existing reconfigurable systems. Experimental results show that DORA maintains stable efficiency, with less than 5\% variation on a single vector processor across workloads exhibiting up to 6$\times$ variation in operation counts. Compared to state-of-the-art accelerators, DORA consistently achieves higher performance, delivering up to 5$\times$ throughput improvement. The heuristic-based scheduler further achieves up to 90\% optimality under practical time constraints. DORA is open-sourced at https://github.com/arc-research-lab/DORA.git.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
随着深度神经网络（DNN）日益多样化和复杂化，如何在复杂 DNN 模型上同时实现高性能和高效率，已成为一项迫切的挑战。现代 DNN 工作负载的算子类型、张量形状和执行依赖关系日益多样，使硬件难以在不同模型上持续保持高效率。此外，通用加速器在执行多样化工作负载时往往会产生较大开销。

为解决这些问题，我们提出 DORA，一种基于指令的覆盖式（overlay）架构。DORA 通过新设计的指令集架构（ISA）显式描述数据流，从而在网络层级对数据移动、计算和同步进行细粒度控制。为兼顾灵活性与高性能，DORA 采用新的片上存储管理和计算并行度管理机制。DORA 的编译框架经过两阶段设计空间探索，为给定的 DNN 工作负载生成指令。该框架还包含分别基于混合整数线性规划（MILP）和启发式方法的搜索引擎，可根据不同需求和约束生成调度方案。

我们在 AMD Versal VCK190 平台上实现了 DORA 原型，展示了该架构在现有可重构系统上的可部署性。实验结果表明，当不同工作负载的运算次数相差最多 6 倍时，DORA 在单个向量处理器上的效率波动仍小于 5%。与当前先进的加速器相比，DORA 始终取得更高性能，吞吐量最高达到对方的 5 倍。在实际时间约束下，基于启发式方法的调度器对最优解的逼近程度最高可达 90%。DORA 已开源，地址为 https://github.com/arc-research-lab/DORA.git。
takeaway: 在 AMD Versal VCK190 原型上，当工作负载的运算次数相差最多 6 倍时，DORA 在单个向量处理器上的效率波动小于 5%，且吞吐量最高达到当前先进加速器的 5 倍。在实际时间约束下，启发式调度器对最优解的逼近程度最高可达 90%。
innovation: （1）设计通过 ISA 显式描述数据流的覆盖式架构，在网络层级细粒度控制数据移动、计算和同步；（2）引入片上存储管理和计算并行度管理机制；（3）构建采用两阶段设计空间探索的指令生成框架，集成基于 MILP 和启发式方法的搜索引擎，以适应不同调度需求和约束

title: A complete discussion on fully reconfigurable, digital, scalable, graph and sparsity-aware near-memory accelerator for graph neural networks
abstract:
Graph neural networks (GNNs) have gained significant interest for applications such as citation network analysis and drug discovery due to their ability to apply machine learning techniques on graph-structured data. GNNs typically employ a two-stage execution pipeline consisting of combination and aggregation kernels. The combination stage performs data-intensive convolution operations with relatively regular memory access patterns, whereas the aggregation stage operates on sparse graph data with highly irregular accesses. These heterogeneous memory behaviors make conventional CPU- and GPU-based execution energy inefficient due to substantial data movement overheads.
  Existing accelerators attempt to mitigate these challenges using specialized architectures and processing-in-memory (PIM) techniques. However, prior approaches often suffer from scalability limitations, area overheads, restricted parallelism, and energy inefficiencies associated with analog compute and dedicated accelerator structures.
  This paper presents NEM-GNN, a scalable DAC/ADC-less processing-in-memory architecture for graph neural network acceleration. The proposed design introduces early compute termination mechanisms, pre-computation using reconfigurable system-on-chip components, and graph- and sparsity-aware near-memory aggregation using a compute-as-soon-as-ready (CAR) and broadcast-based execution model. Experimental results demonstrate that NEM-GNN achieves approximately 80--230x higher performance, 80--300x higher throughput, 850--1134x better energy efficiency, and 7--8x higher compute density compared to prior state-of-the-art approaches.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
图神经网络（GNN）能够将机器学习技术应用于图结构数据，因此在引文网络分析和药物发现等应用中受到广泛关注。GNN 通常采用由组合和聚合两个计算内核构成的两阶段执行流水线。组合阶段执行数据密集型卷积运算，访存模式相对规则，而聚合阶段处理稀疏图数据，访存高度不规则。这两类不同的访存行为会带来大量数据移动开销，导致传统 CPU 和 GPU 执行方式的能效较低。

现有加速器采用专用架构和存内处理（PIM）技术来缓解这些问题。然而，已有方案往往面临可扩展性受限、面积开销较大、并行度受限等问题，模拟计算和专用加速器结构也会带来能效问题。

本文提出 NEM-GNN，一种用于图神经网络加速的可扩展存内处理架构，无需数模转换器（DAC）和模数转换器（ADC）。该设计引入计算提前终止机制，利用可重构片上系统组件进行预计算，并采用就绪即计算（CAR）与广播相结合的执行模型，实现感知图结构与稀疏性的近存聚合。实验结果表明，与此前的先进方案相比，NEM-GNN 的性能约为其 80–230 倍，吞吐量约为其 80–300 倍，能效约为其 850–1134 倍，计算密度约为其 7–8 倍。
takeaway: 与此前的先进 GNN 加速方案相比，无需 DAC 和 ADC 的 NEM-GNN 在实验中的吞吐量约为其 80–300 倍，能效约为其 850–1134 倍，计算密度约为其 7–8 倍。
innovation: （1）设计无需 DAC 和 ADC 的可扩展 GNN 存内处理架构；（2）引入计算提前终止机制；（3）利用可重构片上系统组件执行预计算；（4）采用就绪即计算与广播相结合的执行模型，实现感知图结构与稀疏性的近存聚合

title: FPGA-Accelerated Lock Management and Transaction Processing: Architecture, Optimization, and Design Space Exploration
abstract:
Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) is a classic application with a growing business. CPU-based OLTP has low lock serving efficiency. The main reason is that most locks are cold, and the lock agent must issue frequent memory accesses to retrieve the lock details to determine whether to grant it. This motivates us to propose dedicated hardware-based lock agents with integrated lock tables to remove the DRAM access overhead.
  In this paper, we propose hardware-accelerated lock management and transaction processing for database systems. First, we propose a low-latency lock agent optimized for both lock acquiring and releasing requests. Second, we design a scalable transaction agent that executes the full transaction lifecycle. We present the architecture, optimizations, and design-space exploration of the proposed lock management and transaction processing system. The experiment results show up to 51X higher transaction throughput over the CPU baseline on the TPC-C benchmark.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
联机事务处理（OLTP）是一类经典应用，相关业务仍在增长。基于 CPU 的 OLTP 系统锁服务效率较低，主要原因是大多数锁都属于低频访问的冷锁，锁代理必须频繁访问内存，以查取锁的详细信息并判断是否授予锁。为消除这部分 DRAM 访问开销，我们提出集成锁表的专用硬件锁代理。

本文提出面向数据库系统的硬件加速锁管理与事务处理方案。首先，我们设计了一种低延迟锁代理，针对获取锁和释放锁两类请求进行了优化。其次，我们设计了一种可扩展的事务代理，负责执行事务的整个生命周期。本文介绍所提出的锁管理与事务处理系统的架构、优化措施和设计空间探索。实验结果表明，在 TPC-C 基准测试中，该系统的事务吞吐量最高达到 CPU 基线的 51 倍。
takeaway: 在 TPC-C 基准测试中，采用专用硬件锁代理和事务代理的系统，其事务吞吐量最高达到 CPU 基线的 51 倍。
innovation: （1）设计集成锁表的低延迟硬件锁代理，优化获取锁和释放锁的请求处理，并消除查取锁信息所需的 DRAM 访问开销；（2）设计可扩展的事务代理，在硬件中执行事务的整个生命周期

title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
abstract:
All current LLM serving systems place the GPU at the center, from production-level attention-FFN disaggregation to NVIDIA's Rubin GPU-LPU heterogeneous platform. Even academic PIM/PNM proposals still treat the GPU as the central hub for cross-device communication. Yet the GPU's compute-rich architecture is fundamentally mismatched with the memory-bound nature of decode-phase attention, inflating serving latency while wasting power and die area on idle compute units. The problem is compounded as reasoning and agentic workloads push context lengths toward one million tokens, making attention latency the primary user-facing bottleneck.
  To address these inefficiencies, we present AMMA, a multi-chiplet, memory-centric architecture for low-latency long-context attention. AMMA replaces GPU compute dies with HBM-PNM cubes, roughly doubling the available memory bandwidth to better serve memory-bound attention workloads. To translate this bandwidth into proportional performance gains, we introduce (i) a logic-die microarchitecture that fully exploits per-cube internal bandwidth for decode attention under a minimal power and area budget, (ii) a two-level hybrid parallelism scheme, and (iii) a reordered collective flow that reduces intra-chip die-to-die communication overhead. We further conduct a design-space exploration over per-cube compute power and intra-chip D2D link bandwidth, providing actionable guidance for hardware designers. Evaluations show that AMMA achieves 15.5X lower attention latency and 6.9X lower energy consumption compared with the NVIDIA H100.
abstract_cn:
当前的 LLM 服务系统均以 GPU 为中心，从生产环境中的注意力与前馈网络（FFN）解耦方案，到 NVIDIA 的 Rubin GPU-LPU 异构平台，皆是如此。即使是学术界提出的存内处理（PIM）和近存处理（PNM）方案，仍将 GPU 用作跨设备通信的中心枢纽。然而，GPU 的计算资源密集型架构与解码阶段注意力受内存带宽限制的特性存在根本性失配，既增加了服务延迟，也使闲置的计算单元浪费功耗和裸片面积。随着推理型和智能体工作负载将上下文长度推向 100 万个 token，这一问题进一步加剧，注意力延迟成为用户感知延迟的主要瓶颈。

为解决上述效率问题，我们提出 AMMA，一种面向低延迟长上下文注意力的多芯粒、以存储为中心的架构。AMMA 用 HBM-PNM 堆栈取代 GPU 计算裸片，使可用内存带宽约增至原来的 2 倍，以更好地支持受内存带宽限制的注意力工作负载。为将带宽增益转化为相应幅度的性能增益，我们引入 3 项设计：（1）逻辑裸片微架构，在极低的功耗和面积预算下充分利用各堆栈的内部带宽，执行解码阶段的注意力计算。（2）两级混合并行方案。（3）重新安排集合通信流程，降低芯片内部的裸片间通信开销。我们进一步探索了单个堆栈的算力和芯片内部裸片间（D2D）链路带宽的设计空间，为硬件设计人员提供可据以决策的参考。评估结果表明，相比 NVIDIA H100，AMMA 的注意力延迟降至其 1/15.5，能耗降至其 1/6.9。
takeaway: AMMA 以 HBM-PNM 堆栈取代 GPU 计算裸片，使可用内存带宽约增至原来的 2 倍。在长上下文注意力评估中，AMMA 的注意力延迟和能耗分别为 NVIDIA H100 的 1/15.5 和 1/6.9。
innovation: （1）提出以 HBM-PNM 堆栈取代 GPU 计算裸片的多芯粒存储中心架构；（2）设计逻辑裸片微架构，在低功耗和低面积预算下充分利用各堆栈的内部带宽执行解码注意力；（3）提出两级混合并行方案；（4）重新安排集合通信流程，降低芯片内部的裸片间通信开销；（5）探索单堆栈算力和芯片内部 D2D 链路带宽的设计空间

title: PC2IM: An Efficient In-Memory Computing Accelerator for 3D Point Cloud
abstract: 3D point cloud neural networks have significantly enhanced the perceptual capabilities of resource-limited mobile intelligent systems. However, despite the transformative impact, the point cloud algorithm suffers from substantial memory access during data preprocessing and imposes a burdensome workload on feature computing, resulting in high energy consumption and latency. In this paper, an efficient SRAM-based computing-in-memory (SRAM-CIM) accelerator (PC2IM), is proposed to alleviate memory access bottlenecks in point-based 3D point cloud networks. A data preprocessing module driven by the customized CIM engines is proposed and incorporated into a memory-efficient data flow. Specifically, an approximate distance SRAM-CIM (APD-CIM) is introduced to eliminate the repetitive on-chip memory access for point clouds that are spatially partitioned by the median and reduce the volume of temporary distance data. Building on the APD-CIM, a two-level Ping-Pong-MAX Content Addressable Memory (Ping-Pong-MAX CAM) is introduced to adaptively update temporary distances and perform in-situ search for the maximum, further reducing memory access. Additionally, an efficient CIM-based feature computing engine, named split-concatenate SRAM-CIM, is presented to minimize computation latency in multi-layer perceptron with high-precision input, while maintaining high area and energy efficiency. Experiment results show that the proposed PC2IM demonstrates 1.5x speedup and 2.7x enhanced energy efficiency compared to state-of-the-art point cloud accelerator. Moreover, PC2IM achieves 3.5x speedup and 1518.9x enhanced energy efficiency compared to GPU implementations.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 三维点云神经网络显著增强了资源受限的移动智能系统的感知能力。然而，点云算法在数据预处理阶段需要大量访存，特征计算的负载也很重，导致能耗和延迟居高不下。本文提出 PC2IM，一种基于 SRAM 的高效存内计算（SRAM-CIM）加速器，用于缓解以点为基本处理单元的三维点云网络中的访存瓶颈。我们设计了由定制存内计算引擎驱动的数据预处理模块，并将其集成到高效利用存储资源的数据流中。具体而言，我们引入近似距离 SRAM 存内计算单元（APD-CIM），消除按中位数进行空间划分的点云在处理过程中产生的重复片上访存，并减少临时距离数据量。在 APD-CIM 的基础上，我们引入两级 Ping-Pong-MAX 内容寻址存储器（Ping-Pong-MAX CAM），自适应地更新临时距离并原位查找最大值，进一步减少访存。此外，我们提出一种名为拆分拼接 SRAM-CIM（split-concatenate SRAM-CIM）的高效存内特征计算引擎，以尽量降低多层感知机处理高精度输入时的计算延迟，同时保持较高的面积效率和能效。实验结果表明，相比当前先进的点云加速器，PC2IM 达到 1.5 倍加速，能效为其 2.7 倍。相比 GPU 实现，PC2IM 达到 3.5 倍加速，能效为其 1518.9 倍。
takeaway: 在三维点云实验中，PC2IM 相比当前先进的点云加速器达到 1.5 倍加速，能效为其 2.7 倍。相比 GPU 实现，PC2IM 达到 3.5 倍加速，能效为其 1518.9 倍。
innovation: （1）将定制存内计算引擎驱动的数据预处理模块集成到高效利用存储资源的数据流中；（2）设计 APD-CIM，消除处理按中位数划分的点云时的重复片上访存，并减少临时距离数据量；（3）设计两级 Ping-Pong-MAX CAM，自适应地更新临时距离并原位查找最大值；（4）提出拆分拼接 SRAM-CIM 特征计算引擎，降低多层感知机处理高精度输入时的计算延迟，同时维持较高的面积效率和能效

title: SNAP-V: A RISC-V SoC with Configurable Neuromorphic Acceleration for Small-Scale Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained significant attention in edge computing due to their low power consumption and computational efficiency. However, existing implementations either use conventional System on Chip (SoC) architectures that suffer from memory-processor bottlenecks, or large-scale neuromorphic hardware that is inefficient and wasteful for small-scale SNN applications. This work presents SNAP-V, a RISC-V-based neuromorphic SoC with two accelerator variants: Cerebra-S (bus-based) and Cerebra-H (Network-on-Chip (NoC)-based) which are optimized for small-scale SNN inference, integrating a RISC-V core for management tasks, with both accelerators featuring parallel processing nodes and distributed memory. Experimental results show close agreement between software and hardware inference, with an average accuracy deviation of 2.62% across multiple network configurations, and an average synaptic energy of 1.05 pJ per synaptic operation (SOP) in 45 nm CMOS technology. These results show that the proposed solution enables accurate, energy-efficient SNN inference suitable for real-time edge applications.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）因功耗低、计算效率高而在边缘计算领域受到广泛关注。然而，现有实现要么采用受存储器与处理器之间的数据传输瓶颈制约的传统片上系统（SoC）架构，要么采用在小规模 SNN 应用中效率低、资源开销过大的大规模神经形态硬件。本文提出 SNAP-V，一款基于 RISC-V 的神经形态 SoC，集成了用于管理任务的 RISC-V 核心，并提供两种面向小规模 SNN 推理优化的加速器变体，即基于总线的 Cerebra-S 和基于片上网络（NoC）的 Cerebra-H。两种加速器均采用并行处理节点和分布式存储。实验结果表明，软件与硬件推理结果高度一致，在多种网络配置下的平均准确率偏差为 2.62%。在 45 nm CMOS 工艺下，平均每次突触操作（SOP）的能耗为 1.05 pJ。结果表明，所提出的方案能够实现准确、节能的 SNN 推理，适用于实时边缘应用。
takeaway: SNAP-V 面向实时边缘场景中的小规模 SNN 推理，在多种网络配置下，硬件推理相对于软件推理的平均准确率偏差为 2.62%，在 45 nm CMOS 工艺下的平均每次突触操作能耗为 1.05 pJ。
innovation: （1）提出 SNAP-V 神经形态 SoC，集成用于管理任务的 RISC-V 核心；（2）设计基于总线的 Cerebra-S 和基于片上网络的 Cerebra-H，两种变体均采用并行处理节点和分布式存储，以优化小规模 SNN 推理。

title: A Persistent-State Dataflow Accelerator for Memory-Bound Linear Attention Decode on FPGA
abstract: Gated DeltaNet (GDN) is a linear attention mechanism that replaces the growing KV cache with a fixed-size recurrent state. Hybrid LLMs like Qwen3-Next use 75% GDN layers and achieve competitive accuracy to attention-only models. However, at batch-1, GDN decode is memory-bound on GPUs since the full recurrent state must be round-tripped through HBM every token. We show that this bottleneck is architectural, not algorithmic, as all subquadratic sequence models exhibit arithmetic intensities below 1 FLOP/B at decode time, making them more memory-bound than standard Transformers. We present an FPGA accelerator that eliminates this bottleneck by holding the full 2 MB recurrent state persistently in on-chip BRAM, converting the workload from memory-bound to compute-bound. Our design fuses the GDN recurrence into a five-phase pipelined datapath that performs only one read and one write pass over each state matrix per token, exploits Grouped Value Attention for paired-head parallelism, and overlaps preparation, computation, and output storage via dataflow pipelining. We explore four design points on an AMD Alveo U55C using Vitis HLS, varying head-level parallelism from 2 to 16 value-heads per iteration. Our fastest configuration achieves 63 $μ$s per token, 4.5$\times$ faster than the GPU reference on NVIDIA H100 PCIe. Post-implementation power analysis reports 9.96 W on-chip, yielding up to 60$\times$ greater energy efficiency per token decoded.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: Gated DeltaNet（GDN）是一种线性注意力机制，用固定大小的循环状态取代不断增长的 KV 缓存。Qwen3-Next 等混合大语言模型（LLM）采用 75% 的 GDN 层，准确率可与仅使用注意力层的模型相竞争。然而，当批大小为 1 时，GPU 上的 GDN 解码受访存限制，因为每生成一个词元（token），都必须从高带宽内存（HBM）读出完整的循环状态并将其写回。我们指出，状态往返造成的瓶颈源于硬件架构。所有计算复杂度低于平方级的序列模型在解码时的算术强度均低于 1 FLOP/B，因此比标准 Transformer 更易受访存限制。我们提出一种 FPGA 加速器，将完整的 2 MB 循环状态持续保存在片上块 RAM（BRAM）中，从而消除这一瓶颈，使工作负载转为计算受限。该设计将 GDN 循环更新融合到五阶段流水数据通路中，每个词元对每个状态矩阵只需各遍历读写一次，并利用分组值注意力（Grouped Value Attention）实现注意力头的成对并行，通过数据流流水线重叠准备、计算和输出存储。我们使用 Vitis HLS 在 AMD Alveo U55C 上探索了 4 种设计配置，将头级并行度从每次迭代处理 2 个值头提高到 16 个值头。最快配置的解码延迟为每词元 63 μs，速度是 NVIDIA H100 PCIe 上 GPU 参考实现的 4.5 倍。实现后功耗分析得到的片上功耗为 9.96 W，每解码一个词元的能效最高可达 GPU 参考实现的 60 倍。
takeaway: 将完整的 2 MB 循环状态常驻片上 BRAM，使批大小为 1 的 GDN 解码从访存受限转为计算受限。AMD Alveo U55C 上最快配置达到每词元 63 μs，速度是 NVIDIA H100 PCIe 参考实现的 4.5 倍，每词元解码能效最高达其 60 倍。
innovation: （1）将完整的 2 MB 循环状态常驻片上 BRAM，消除每个词元触发的片外状态读写；（2）将 GDN 循环更新融合进五阶段流水数据通路，使每个词元对每个状态矩阵只需各遍历读写一次；（3）利用分组值注意力实现注意力头的成对并行；（4）利用数据流流水线重叠准备、计算和输出存储。

title: Architectural Design and Performance Analysis of FPGA based AI Accelerators: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: Deep learning (DL) has emerged as a rapidly developing advanced technology, enabling the performance of complex tasks involving image recognition, natural language processing, and autonomous decision-making with high levels of accuracy. However, as these technologies evolve and strive to meet the growing demands of real-life applications, the complexity of DL models continues to increase. These models require processing of massive volumes of data, demanding substantial computational power and memory bandwidth. This gives rise to the critical need for hardware accelerators that can deliver both high performance and energy efficiency. Accelerator types include ASIC based solutions, GPU accelerators, and FPGA based implementations. The limitations of ASIC and GPU accelerators have led to FPGAs becoming one of the prominent solutions, offering distinct advantages for DL workloads. FPGAs provide a flexible and reconfigurable platform, allowing model specific customization while maintaining high efficiency. This article explores various hardware level optimizations for DL. These optimizations include techniques such as loop pipelining, parallelism, quantization, and various memory hierarchy enhancements. In addition, it provides an overview of state-of-the-art FPGA-based neural network accelerators. Through the study and analysis of these accelerators, several challenges have been identified, paving the way for future optimizations and innovations in the design of FPGA-based hardware accelerators.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 深度学习（DL）是一项快速发展的先进技术，能够以较高的准确率完成图像识别、自然语言处理和自主决策等复杂任务。然而，随着技术发展和实际应用需求不断增长，深度学习模型也日益复杂。这些模型需要处理海量数据，对算力和内存带宽提出了很高的要求，因此亟需兼顾高性能和高能效的硬件加速器。加速器类型包括基于专用集成电路（ASIC）的方案、GPU 加速器和基于 FPGA 的实现。ASIC 和 GPU 加速器的局限性使 FPGA 成为主要方案之一，并在深度学习工作负载上展现出独特优势。FPGA 提供灵活、可重配置的平台，在保持高效率的同时支持针对特定模型进行定制。本文探讨了多种面向深度学习的硬件级优化，包括循环流水化、并行化、量化以及多种存储层次结构优化。文章还概述了当前先进的 FPGA 神经网络加速器。通过研究和分析这些加速器，本文识别出若干挑战，为未来 FPGA 硬件加速器设计的优化和创新奠定基础。
takeaway: FPGA 的灵活性与可重配置性使其能够在保持高效率的同时针对深度学习模型进行定制。本文梳理了循环流水化、并行化、量化和存储层次结构优化等技术，并通过分析先进的 FPGA 神经网络加速器归纳了若干设计挑战。
innovation: 摘要未明确提出新的加速器架构或优化方法。综述贡献包括（1）梳理面向深度学习的硬件级优化技术；（2）综述和分析先进的 FPGA 神经网络加速器，并归纳设计挑战。

title: FAST-Prefill: FPGA Accelerated Sparse Attention for Long Context LLM Prefill
abstract:
In long-context large language model (LLM) inference, the prefill stage dominates computation due to self-attention over the complete input context. Sparse attention significantly reduces self-attention computation by limiting each token's interactions to a subset of tokens. The attention sparsity pattern varies across input prompts, and within a prompt, each attention head can follow a distinct pattern. This makes attention sparsity dynamic. The requirement of generating the sparsity pattern, combined with limited data reuse in attention, shifts the prefill compute to being memory-bound. This, in addition to the huge energy requirements for long-context inference on GPU, motivates FPGAs as good candidates for accelerating dynamic long-context inference.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose FAST-Prefill, the first FPGA accelerator for long-context prefill-stage inference with dynamic sparse attention. To efficiently generate sparse indices, we propose a \textit{fused pipeline unit with a memory-aware execution order} to reduce large tensors and irregular memory accesses. To reduce off-chip memory traffic for accessing the KV cache, we utilize the memory hierarchy to design a \textit{liveness-driven, dual-tier cache}. For high-throughput matrix multiplication, we design a \textit{hybrid Matrix Processing Unit (MPU)} with DSPs and bit-plane decomposition using LUTs. We implement FAST-Prefill on Alveo U280 and evaluate it on the Llama and Qwen models (batch size = 1) for context lengths ranging from 4K to 128K tokens. We demonstrate an average speedup of up to 2.5$\times$ in TTFT and 4.5$\times$ improvement in energy efficiency over GPU implementation on Nvidia A5000 GPU.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn:
在长上下文大语言模型（LLM）推理中，预填充（prefill）阶段需要对完整输入上下文执行自注意力计算，因此占据了主要计算开销。稀疏注意力将每个词元的交互范围限制在词元的一个子集内，显著减少了自注意力计算量。注意力稀疏模式随输入提示而变化，即使在同一提示中，各注意力头也可以采用不同的模式，因此注意力稀疏性具有动态性。生成稀疏模式的需求加上注意力计算中有限的数据复用，使预填充转为访存受限。加之 GPU 上的长上下文推理能耗很高，FPGA 成为加速采用动态稀疏注意力的长上下文推理的合适选择。

为应对这些挑战，我们提出 FAST-Prefill，这是首款面向采用动态稀疏注意力的长上下文预填充推理的 FPGA 加速器。为高效生成稀疏索引，我们提出一种采用访存感知执行顺序的融合流水单元，以减少大张量的产生和不规则访存。为减少访问 KV 缓存产生的片外流量，我们利用存储层次结构设计了基于数据活跃性的双层缓存。为实现高吞吐量矩阵乘法，我们设计了混合矩阵处理单元（MPU），结合数字信号处理单元（DSP）与利用查找表（LUT）实现的位平面分解。我们在 Alveo U280 上实现 FAST-Prefill，并在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上进行评估，批大小为 1，上下文长度为 4K 至 128K 个词元。与 NVIDIA A5000 GPU 上的实现相比，首词元延迟（TTFT）的平均加速比最高为 2.5 倍，能效达到 4.5 倍。
takeaway: 在批大小为 1、上下文长度为 4K 至 128K 个词元的 Llama 和 Qwen 评估中，Alveo U280 上的 FAST-Prefill 相比 NVIDIA A5000 GPU 实现，首词元延迟的平均加速比最高为 2.5 倍，能效达到 4.5 倍。
innovation: （1）提出 FAST-Prefill，面向动态稀疏注意力的长上下文预填充推理设计 FPGA 加速器；（2）采用具有访存感知执行顺序的融合流水单元生成稀疏索引，减少大张量的产生和不规则访存；（3）设计基于数据活跃性的双层缓存，减少 KV 缓存访问产生的片外流量；（4）设计结合 DSP 与基于 LUT 的位平面分解的混合矩阵处理单元，实现高吞吐量矩阵乘法。

title: ABI: A tightly integrated, unified, sparsity-aware, reconfigurable, compute near-register file/cache GPU architecture with light-weight softmax for deep learning, linear algebra, and Ising compute
abstract: We present a tightly integrated and unified near-memory GPU architecture that delivers 6 to 16 times speedup and 6 to 13 times energy savings across Convolutional Neural Networks, Graph Convolutional Networks, Linear Programming, Large Language Models, and Ising workloads compared to MIAOW GPU. The design includes a custom sparsity-aware near-memory circuit providing about 1.5 times energy savings, and a lightweight softmax circuit providing about 1.6 times energy savings. The architecture supports reconfigurable compute up to INT16 with dynamic resolution updates and scales efficiently across problem sizes. ABI-enabled MI300 and Blackwell systems achieve about 4.5 times speedup over baseline MI300 and Blackwell.
abstract_cn: 我们提出一种紧密集成的统一 GPU 近存计算架构。与 MIAOW GPU 相比，该架构在卷积神经网络、图卷积网络、线性规划、大语言模型和伊辛（Ising）计算工作负载上实现了 6 至 16 倍的加速，能耗降至基线的 1/6 至 1/13。该设计包含定制的稀疏感知近存计算电路和轻量级 softmax 电路，分别将能耗降至相应基线的约 1/1.5 和 1/1.6。该架构支持最高至 INT16 的可重配置计算，可动态调整数值精度，并能在不同问题规模下高效扩展。集成 ABI 的 MI300 和 Blackwell 系统相对于各自的基线系统实现了约 4.5 倍的加速。
takeaway: ABI 在卷积神经网络、图卷积网络、线性规划、大语言模型和伊辛计算工作负载上，相比 MIAOW GPU 实现了 6 至 16 倍的加速，能耗降至基线的 1/6 至 1/13。集成 ABI 的 MI300 和 Blackwell 系统相比各自的基线系统实现约 4.5 倍的加速。
innovation: （1）提出紧密集成的统一 GPU 近存计算架构；（2）设计定制的稀疏感知近存计算电路；（3）设计轻量级 softmax 电路；（4）支持最高至 INT16 的可重配置计算，并可动态调整数值精度。

title: PIM-FW: Hardware-Software Co-Design of All-pairs Shortest Paths in DRAM
abstract: All-pairs shortest paths (APSP) is a fundamental algorithm used for routing, logistics, and network analysis, but the cubic time complexity and heavy data movement of the canonical Floyd-Warshall (FW) algorithm severely limits its scalability on conventional CPUs or GPUs. In this paper, we propose PIM-FW, a novel co-designed hardware architecture and dataflow that leverages processing in and near memory architecture designed to accelerate blocked FW algorithm on an HBM3 stack. To enable fine-grained parallelism, we propose a massively parallel array of specialized bit-serial bank PE and channel PE designed to accelerate the core min-plus operations. Our novel dataflow complements this hardware, employing an interleaved mapping policy for superior load balancing and hybrid in and near memory computing model for efficient computation and reduction. The novel in-bank computing approach allows all distance updates to be performed and stored in memory bank, a key contribution is that eliminates the data movement bottleneck inherent in GPU-based approaches. We implement a full software and hardware co-design using a cycle-accurate simulator to simulate an 8-channel, 4-Hi HBM3 PIM stack on real road-network traces. Experimental results show that, for a 8192 x 8192 graph, PIM-FW achieves a 18.7x speedup in end-to-end execution, and consumes 3200x less DRAM energy compared to a state-of-the-art GPU-only Floyd-Warshall.
reasons: AI 加速器与可重构计算
abstract_cn: 全源最短路径（APSP）是路由、物流和网络分析中的基础算法问题。然而，经典 Floyd–Warshall（FW）算法具有立方时间复杂度，并需要大量数据搬移，严重限制了其在传统 CPU 或 GPU 上的可扩展性。本文提出 PIM-FW，通过协同设计硬件架构和数据流，利用存内计算与近存计算，在 HBM3 堆栈上加速分块 FW 算法。为实现细粒度并行，本文设计了由专用的位串行存储体处理单元（bank PE）和通道处理单元（channel PE）组成的大规模并行阵列，以加速核心的最小值加法（min-plus）运算。与该硬件配套的数据流采用交错映射策略改善负载均衡，并采用存内与近存混合计算模式，高效完成计算和归约。本文提出的存储体内计算方法使所有距离更新均可在存储体内完成，更新结果也保存在存储体内，从而消除基于 GPU 的方法固有的数据搬移瓶颈。本文实现了完整的软硬件协同设计，并使用周期精确模拟器，基于真实道路网络轨迹对具备 8 个通道、4 层堆叠（4-Hi）的 HBM3 存内计算（PIM）堆栈进行仿真。实验结果表明，对于规模为 8192 × 8192 的图，与最先进的纯 GPU Floyd–Warshall 实现相比，PIM-FW 实现了 18.7 倍的端到端加速，DRAM 能耗降至基线的 1/3200。
takeaway: PIM-FW 将所有距离更新及其结果保留在 DRAM 存储体内，以消除基于 GPU 的方法固有的数据搬移瓶颈。基于真实道路网络轨迹的周期精确仿真表明，在 8 通道、4 层堆叠的 HBM3 PIM 配置下处理 8192 × 8192 规模的图时，相较于最先进的纯 GPU Floyd–Warshall 实现，PIM-FW 获得了 18.7 倍的端到端加速，DRAM 能耗降至基线的 1/3200。
innovation: 1. 面向 HBM3 堆栈协同设计硬件架构和数据流，结合存内与近存计算加速分块 Floyd–Warshall 算法；2. 设计由专用位串行存储体 PE 和通道 PE 组成的大规模并行阵列，实现核心 min-plus 运算的细粒度并行；3. 在数据流中采用交错映射改善负载均衡，并以存内和近存混合计算高效完成计算与归约；4. 提出存储体内计算方法，在存储体内完成所有距离更新并保存更新结果。
